using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Models;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Storage;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using static System.FormattableString;

namespace TicketSalesApp.Core.Data
{
    [NotMapped]
    public class TableCheckResult
    {
        public string TableName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int RowCount { get; set; }
        public int TableCount { get; set; }
    }

    public static class DbInitializer
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, Type> RequiredTables = new()
        {
            { "Users", typeof(User) },
            { "Jobs", typeof(Job) },
            { "Employees", typeof(Employee) },
            { "Avtobusy", typeof(Avtobus) },
            { "Obsluzhivanies", typeof(Obsluzhivanie) },
            { "Marshuti", typeof(Marshut) },
            { "Bilety", typeof(Bilet) },
            { "Prodazhi", typeof(Prodazha) },
            { "Roles", typeof(Roles) },
            { "Permissions", typeof(Permission) },
            { "UserRoles", typeof(UserRole) },
            { "RolePermissions", typeof(RolePermission) },
            { "RouteSchedules", typeof(RouteSchedules) }
        };

        // Helper method for GUID conversion
        private static Guid ConvertToGuid(long value)
        {
            byte[] bytes = new byte[16];
            BitConverter.GetBytes(value).CopyTo(bytes, 0);
            return new Guid(bytes);
        }

        public static async Task InitializeAsync(AppDbContext context, string provider = "SQLite", ILogger? logger = null)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(context, nameof(context));
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(provider, nameof(provider));

            try
            {
                var dbPath = context.Database.GetDbConnection().ConnectionString;
                logger?.LogInformation("Starting database initialization with provider: {Provider}, Database path: {DbPath}", 
                    provider, dbPath);

                // Log current database state
                await LogDatabaseState(context, logger);

                // Validate database connection
                if (!await ValidateDatabaseConnectionAsync(context, logger))
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to establish database connection");
                }

                // Check if database exists
                bool dbExists = await context.Database.CanConnectAsync();
                
                if (!dbExists)
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Database does not exist. Creating new database...");
                    await context.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();
                    
                    // Apply migrations for new database
                    await ApplyMigrationsAsync(context, logger);
                    
                    // Seed initial data for new database
                    await SeedDataAsync(context, provider, logger);
                }
                else
                {
                    // For existing database, validate schema
                    var schemaValidation = await ValidateDatabaseSchemaAsync(context, logger);
                    
                    if (!schemaValidation.IsValid)
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning("Database schema validation failed: {Reasons}", 
                            string.Join(", ", schemaValidation.ValidationErrors));

                        // Check for missing tables
                        foreach (var error in schemaValidation.ValidationErrors)
                        {
                            if (error.StartsWith("Missing table:"))
                            {
                                var tableName = error.Replace("Missing table:", "").Trim();
                                if (RequiredTables.TryGetValue(tableName, out var entityType))
                                {
                                    logger?.LogInformation("Creating missing table: {TableName}", tableName);
                                    await CreateTableAsync(context, entityType, logger);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Apply any pending migrations after fixing schema
                        await ApplyMigrationsAsync(context, logger);
                    }

                    // Validate table structures without dropping existing data
                    foreach (var table in RequiredTables)
                    {
                        if (!await TableExistsAsync(context, table.Key))
                        {
                            logger?.LogWarning("Table {TableName} does not exist. Creating...", table.Key);
                            await CreateTableAsync(context, table.Value, logger);
                        }
                        else if (!await ValidateTableStructureAsync(context, table.Key, table.Value, logger))
                        {
                            logger?.LogWarning("Table {TableName} structure needs migration...", table.Key);
                            // Let migrations handle structural changes instead of recreating
                            await ApplyMigrationsAsync(context, logger);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            logger?.LogInformation("Table {TableName} structure is valid.", table.Key);
                        }
                    }

                    // Check if seeding is needed (e.g., empty tables)
                    var tableStats = await GetTableStatisticsAsync(context);
                    if (tableStats.Any(t => t.RowCount == 0))
                    {
                        logger?.LogInformation("Some tables are empty. Applying seed data...");
                        await SeedDataAsync(context, provider, logger);
                    }
                }

                logger?.LogInformation("Database initialization completed successfully.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to initialize database: {ErrorMessage}", ex.Message);
                throw new Exception($"Failed to initialize database: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        private static async Task LogDatabaseState(AppDbContext context, ILogger? logger)
        {
            if (logger == null) return;

            try
            {
                if (context.Database.IsSqlite())
                {
                    var tables = await context.Database
                        .SqlQuery<TableCheckResult>($@"
                            SELECT 
                                name as TableName, 
                                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table') as RowCount,
                                0 as TableCount
                            FROM sqlite_master 
                            WHERE type='table'")
                        .ToListAsync();

                    logger.LogInformation("Current database tables:");
                    foreach (var table in tables)
                    {
                        logger.LogInformation("Table: {TableName}, Row Count: {RowCount}", 
                            table.TableName, table.RowCount);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var tables = await context.Database
                        .SqlQuery<TableCheckResult>($@"
                            SELECT 
                                TABLE_NAME as TableName, 
                                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME) as RowCount,
                                0 as TableCount
                            FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t
                            WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo'")
                        .ToListAsync();

                    logger.LogInformation("Current database tables:");
                    foreach (var table in tables)
                    {
                        logger.LogInformation("Table: {TableName}, Column Count: {RowCount}", 
                            table.TableName, table.RowCount);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to log database state");
            }
        }

        private static async Task<bool> ValidateDatabaseConnectionAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger? logger)
        {
            try
            {
                logger?.LogInformation("Validating database connection...");
                return await context.Database.CanConnectAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Database connection validation failed");
                return false;
            }
        }

        private static async Task<(bool IsValid, List<string> ValidationErrors)> ValidateDatabaseSchemaAsync(
            AppDbContext context, ILogger? logger)
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            logger?.LogInformation("Validating database schema...");

            try
            {
                foreach (var table in RequiredTables)
                {
                    var exists = await TableExistsAsync(context, table.Key);
                    if (!exists)
                    {
                        errors.Add($"Missing table: {table.Key}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    // Get expected columns from entity
                    var entity = context.Model.FindEntityType(table.Value);
                    if (entity == null)
                    {
                        errors.Add($"Entity type not found for table: {table.Key}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    var expectedColumns = entity.GetProperties()
                        .Select(p => (Name: p.GetColumnName(), Type: p.ClrType))
                        .ToList();

                    // Get actual columns from database
                    var actualColumns = await GetTableColumnsAsync(context, table.Key);

                    // Compare column counts
                    if (expectedColumns.Count != actualColumns.Count)
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning("Table {TableName} has {ActualCount} columns but {ExpectedCount} were expected",
                            table.Key, actualColumns.Count, expectedColumns.Count);
                        continue; // Let migrations handle structural changes
                    }

                    // Compare column names and types
                    foreach (var expected in expectedColumns)
                    {
                        var actual = actualColumns.FirstOrDefault(c => 
                            string.Equals(c.Name, expected.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

                        if (actual.Name == null)
                        {
                            logger?.LogWarning("Column {ColumnName} missing in table {TableName}",
                                expected.Name, table.Key);
                            continue; // Let migrations handle structural changes
                        }
                    }
                }

                return (errors.Count == 0, errors);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Schema validation failed");
                errors.Add($"Schema validation failed: {ex.Message}");
                return (false, errors);
            }
        }

        private static async Task FixDatabaseSchemaAsync(AppDbContext context, 
            (bool IsValid, List<string> ValidationErrors) validation, ILogger? logger)
        {
            try
            {
                logger?.LogInformation("Attempting to fix database schema issues...");

                foreach (var error in validation.ValidationErrors)
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Fixing schema issue: {Error}", error);
                    if (error.StartsWith("Missing table:"))
                    {
                        var tableName = error.Replace("Missing table:", "").Trim();
                        if (RequiredTables.TryGetValue(tableName, out var entityType))
                        {
                            await CreateTableAsync(context, entityType, logger);
                        }
                    }
                    else if (error.StartsWith("Invalid table structure:"))
                    {
                        var tableName = error.Replace("Invalid table structure:", "").Trim();
                        if (RequiredTables.TryGetValue(tableName, out var entityType))
                        {
                            await DropTableIfExistsAsync(context, tableName, logger);
                            await CreateTableAsync(context, entityType, logger);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to fix schema issues");
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static async Task DropTableIfExistsAsync(AppDbContext context, string tableName, ILogger? logger)
        {
            try
            {
                if (context.Database.IsSqlite())
                {
                    await context.Database
                        .ExecuteSqlRawAsync($"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {tableName}");
                }
                else
                {
                    await context.Database
                        .ExecuteSqlRawAsync($"IF OBJECT_ID('{tableName}', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE {tableName}");
                }
                logger?.LogInformation("Dropped table {TableName}", tableName);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to drop table {TableName}", tableName);
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static async Task<bool> ValidateTableStructureAsync(
            AppDbContext context, string tableName, Type entityType, ILogger? logger)
        {
            try
            {
                var entity = context.Model.FindEntityType(entityType);
                if (entity == null) return false;

                var expectedColumns = entity.GetProperties()
                    .Select(p => new { Name = p.GetColumnName(), Type = p.GetColumnType() })
                    .ToList();

                var actualColumns = await GetTableColumnsAsync(context, tableName);

                foreach (var expected in expectedColumns)
                {
                    var actual = actualColumns.FirstOrDefault(c => 
                        string.Equals(c.Name, expected.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    
                    if (actual.Name == null)
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning("Missing column {Column} in table {Table}", expected.Name, tableName);
                        return false;
                    }

                    // SQLite type checking is less strict
                    if (!context.Database.IsSqlite() && !string.Equals(actual.Type, expected.Type, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning("Column type mismatch in {Table}.{Column}: Expected {Expected}, Found {Actual}",
                            tableName, expected.Name, expected.Type, actual.Type);
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to validate table structure for {Table}", tableName);
                return false;
            }
        }

        private static async Task<List<(string Name, string Type)>> GetTableColumnsAsync(
            AppDbContext context, string tableName)
        {
            if (context.Database.IsSqlite())
            {
                var columns = new List<(string Name, string Type)>();
                var sql = $"PRAGMA table_info({tableName})";
                using var command = context.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand();
                command.CommandText = sql;

                if (command.Connection!.State != System.Data.ConnectionState.Open)
                    await command.Connection.OpenAsync();

                using var reader = await command.ExecuteReaderAsync();
                while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                {
                    columns.Add((
                        reader.GetString(1), // name
                        reader.GetString(2)  // type
                    ));
                }
                return columns;
            }
            else
            {
                // SQL Server implementation
                var columns = new List<(string Name, string Type)>();
                var sql = @"
                    SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE 
                    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
                    WHERE TABLE_NAME = @tableName";
                
                using var command = context.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand();
                command.CommandText = sql;
                var parameter = command.CreateParameter();
                parameter.ParameterName = "@tableName";
                parameter.Value = tableName;
                command.Parameters.Add(parameter);

                if (command.Connection!.State != System.Data.ConnectionState.Open)
                    await command.Connection.OpenAsync();

                using var reader = await command.ExecuteReaderAsync();
                while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                {
                    columns.Add((
                        reader.GetString(0), // COLUMN_NAME
                        reader.GetString(1)  // DATA_TYPE
                    ));
                }
                return columns;
            }
        }

        private static async Task ApplyMigrationsAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger? logger)
        {
            try
            {
                var pending = await context.Database.GetPendingMigrationsAsync();
                if (pending.Any())
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Applying {Count} pending migrations...", pending.Count());
            await context.Database.MigrateAsync();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to apply migrations");
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static async Task<bool> TableExistsAsync(AppDbContext context, string tableName)
        {
            try
            {
                if (context.Database.IsSqlite())
                {
                    using var command = context.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand();
                    command.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = @tableName";
                    
                    var parameter = command.CreateParameter();
                    parameter.ParameterName = "@tableName";
                    parameter.Value = tableName;
                    command.Parameters.Add(parameter);

                    if (command.Connection!.State != System.Data.ConnectionState.Open)
                        await command.Connection.OpenAsync();

                    var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                    return Convert.ToInt32(result) > 0;
                }
                else
                {
                    using var command = context.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand();
                    command.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = @tableName AND TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo'";
                    
                    var parameter = command.CreateParameter();
                    parameter.ParameterName = "@tableName";
                    parameter.Value = tableName;
                    command.Parameters.Add(parameter);

                    if (command.Connection!.State != System.Data.ConnectionState.Open)
                        await command.Connection.OpenAsync();

                    var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                    return Convert.ToInt32(result) > 0;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                var loggerFactory = context.GetService<ILoggerFactory>();
                var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger(typeof(DbInitializer));
                
                logger.LogError(ex, 
                    "Error checking if table {TableName} exists. Database: {Database}, Provider: {Provider}", 
                    tableName,
                    context.Database.GetDbConnection().Database,
                    context.Database.ProviderName);
                
                return false;
            }
        }

        private static async Task CreateTableAsync(AppDbContext context, Type entityType, ILogger? logger)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(context, nameof(context));
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entityType, nameof(entityType));

            try
            {
                var entity = context.Model.FindEntityType(entityType) 
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Entity type {entityType.Name} not found in model");

                var createTableSql = context.Database.IsSqlite() 
                    ? GenerateSqliteCreateTableSql(entity)
                    : GenerateSqlServerCreateTableSql(entity);
                
                await context.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync(createTableSql);
                logger?.LogInformation("Created table for entity {EntityType}", entityType.Name);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to create table for {EntityType}", entityType.Name);
                throw;
            }
        }

                        var config = routeConfigs[routeIndex];
                        var currentDate = startDate;

                        while (currentDate <= endDate)
                        {
                            // Generate schedules for each day
                            var routeId = routes[routeIndex % routes.Length].RouteId;
                            var busType = busTypes[routeIndex % busTypes.Length];

                            // Morning schedule (every day)
                            routeSchedules.Add(new RouteSchedules

                                CreatedAt = DateTime.Now,
                                UpdatedBy = "System"
                            });

                            // Afternoon schedule (weekdays only)

                            {

                                {
                                    RouteId = routeId,
                                    StartPoint = config.start,

                                    ValidUntil = currentDate.AddDays(1),

                                    IsRecurring = true,
                                    Notes = $"Regular route {config.start} - {config.end}",
                                    CreatedAt = DateTime.Now,
                                    UpdatedBy = "System"
                                });
                            }

                            // Evening schedule (every day)
                            routeSchedules.Add(new RouteSchedules
                            {
                                RouteId = routeId,
                                StartPoint = config.start,
                                EndPoint = config.end,
                                RouteStops = config.stops,
                                DepartureTime = currentDate.AddHours(18),
                                ArrivalTime = currentDate.AddHours(19),
                                Price = config.price,
                                AvailableSeats = 42,
                                DaysOfWeek = new[] { "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday" },
                                BusTypes = new[] { busType },
                                EstimatedStopTimes = new[] { "18:00", "18:20", "18:40", "19:00" },
                                StopDistances = new[] { 0.0, 2.5, 4.8, 6.3 },
                                ValidFrom = currentDate,
                                ValidUntil = currentDate.AddDays(1),
                                IsActive = currentDate <= DateTime.Today,
                                StopDurationMinutes = 5,
                                IsRecurring = true,
                                Notes = $"Regular route {config.start} - {config.end}",
                                CreatedAt = DateTime.Now,
                                UpdatedBy = "System"
                            });

                            currentDate = currentDate.AddDays(1); // Move to next day
                        }
                    }

                    await context.RouteSchedules.AddRangeAsync(routeSchedules);
                    logger?.LogInformation($"Added {routeSchedules.Count} route schedules from {startDate:d} to {endDate:d}");
                    await context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    logger?.LogInformation("Maintenance records seeded successfully.");

                    logger?.LogInformation("All initial data seeded successfully.");
                }
                else
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Initial data already exists. Validating admin user...");
                    var adminExists = await context.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Login == "admin" && u.Role == 1);
                    if (!adminExists)
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning("Admin user not found or invalid. Recreating...");
                        await context.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync("DELETE FROM Users WHERE Login = 'admin'");
                var admin = new User
                {
                    Login = "admin",
                    PasswordHash = ComputeHash("admin"),
                            Role = 1,
                            GuidId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                            IsActive = true
                };
                        await context.Users.AddAsync(admin);
                        await context.SaveChangesAsync();
                        logger?.LogInformation("Admin user recreated successfully.");

                        // Ensure admin has proper role assignment
                        var adminRole = await context.Roles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.LegacyRoleId == 1);
                        if (adminRole != null)
                        {
                            var adminUserRole = new UserRole
                            {
                                UserId = admin.GuidId,
                                RoleId = adminRole.RoleId,
                                AssignedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                                AssignedBy = "System"
                            };
                            await context.UserRoles.AddAsync(adminUserRole);
                            await context.SaveChangesAsync();
                            logger?.LogInformation("Admin role reassigned successfully.");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex, "Failed to seed data: {ErrorMessage}", ex.Message);
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static string GenerateSqliteCreateTableSql(IEntityType entity)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entity, nameof(entity));

            var tableName = entity.GetTableName() 
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Table name not found for entity {entity.Name}");

            var properties = entity.GetProperties();
            var primaryKey = entity.FindPrimaryKey();
            var primaryKeyNames = primaryKey?.Properties.Select(p => p.Name).ToList() ?? new List<string>();
            var isCompositeKey = primaryKeyNames.Count > 1;

            var columns = properties.Select(p => 
            {
                var columnName = p.GetColumnName() 
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Column name not found for property {p.Name}");
                var isNullable = p.ClrType.IsValueType ? Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(p.ClrType) != null : true;
                var isPrimaryKey = primaryKeyNames.Contains(p.Name) && !isCompositeKey;

                return $"{columnName} {GetSqliteType(p)} {(isPrimaryKey ? "PRIMARY KEY" : "")} {(!isNullable ? "NOT NULL" : "NULL")}";
            });

            var sql = $"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {tableName} ({string.Join(", ", columns)}";

            if (isCompositeKey)
            {
                sql += $", PRIMARY KEY ({string.Join(", ", primaryKeyNames)})";
            }

            sql += ");";
            return sql;
        }

        private static string GenerateSqlServerCreateTableSql(IEntityType entity)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entity, nameof(entity));

            var tableName = entity.GetTableName() 
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Table name not found for entity {entity.Name}");

            var properties = entity.GetProperties();
            var columns = properties.Select(p => 
            {
                var columnName = p.GetColumnName() 
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Column name not found for property {p.Name}");
                var isNullable = p.ClrType.IsValueType ? Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(p.ClrType) != null : true;
                return $"{columnName} {GetSqlServerType(p)} {(p.IsKey() ? "PRIMARY KEY" : "")} {(!isNullable ? "NOT NULL" : "NULL")}";
            });

            return $"IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE name = '{tableName}') CREATE TABLE {tableName} ({string.Join(", ", columns)});";
        }

        private static string GetSqliteType(IProperty property)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(property, nameof(property));

            var type = property.ClrType;
            var underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) ?? type;

            return underlyingType.Name.ToLower() switch
            {
                "int32" or "int64" => "INTEGER",
                "decimal" => "REAL",
                "datetime" => "TEXT",
                "string" => "TEXT",
                "boolean" => "INTEGER",
                "guid" => "TEXT",
                _ => "TEXT"
            };
        }

        private static string GetSqlServerType(IProperty property)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(property, nameof(property));

            return property.ClrType.Name.ToLower() switch
            {
                "int32" => "INT",
                "int64" => "BIGINT",
                "decimal" => "DECIMAL(18,2)",
                "datetime" => "DATETIME2",
                "string" => "NVARCHAR(MAX)",
                "boolean" => "BIT",
                _ => "NVARCHAR(MAX)"
            };
        }

        private static string ComputeHash(string input)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(input, nameof(input));

            using var sha256 = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
            var bytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input);
            var hash = sha256.ComputeHash(bytes);
            return Convert.ToBase64String(hash);
        }

        private static async Task<List<TableCheckResult>> GetTableStatisticsAsync(AppDbContext context)
        {
            var results = new List<TableCheckResult>();
            foreach (var table in RequiredTables)
            {
                try
                {
                    using var command = context.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand();
                    command.CommandText = $"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table.Key}";

                    if (command.Connection!.State != System.Data.ConnectionState.Open)
                        await command.Connection.OpenAsync();

                    var count = Convert.ToInt32(await command.ExecuteScalarAsync());
                    results.Add(new TableCheckResult 
                    { 
                        TableName = table.Key, 
                        RowCount = count 
                    });
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    // If table doesn't exist or can't be counted, add it with 0 rows
                    results.Add(new TableCheckResult 
                    { 
                        TableName = table.Key, 
                        RowCount = 0 
                    });
                }
            }
            return results;
        }
    }
}

For migrating existing users and roles to SpacetimeDB, you would need to:

First create a reducer to generate SpacetimeDB Identities for existing users:
csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void MigrateExistingUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, bool isActive, string[] permissions)
{
    // Create UserProfile with SpacetimeDB Identity
    var userProfile = new UserProfile
    {
        identity = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        login = login,
        isActive = isActive,
        createdAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    userProfile.Insert();

    // Store role assignments
    foreach (var permission in permissions)
    {
        var userPermission = new UserPermission
        {
            userId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
            permission = permission,
            grantedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
        };
        userPermission.Insert();
    }
}
Create a migration script to call this reducer for each existing user:
csharp
public async Task MigrateUsersToSpacetimeDB()
{
    // Connect to SpacetimeDB
    var client = new SpacetimeDBClient();
    await client.Connect("localhost:3000", "database_name");

    // For each existing user
    foreach (var user in _context.Users)
    {
        // Get user's permissions
        var permissions = await GetUserPermissions(user.UserId);
        
        // Call reducer to create SpacetimeDB identity
        await client.CallReducer("MigrateExistingUser", 
            user.Login,
            user.IsActive,
            permissions);
    }
}
Update auth flow to use SpacetimeDB Identity:
csharp
public async Task<AuthResult> AuthenticateUser(string login, string password)
{
    // Verify credentials in existing system
    var user = await _authService.VerifyCredentials(login, password);
    if (user == null) return null;

    // Get or create SpacetimeDB identity
    var identity = await GetOrCreateSpacetimeIdentity(user);
    
    // Return auth result with SpacetimeDB identity
    return new AuthResult
    {
        Token = GenerateJwtToken(user),
        SpacetimeIdentity = identity
    };
}
Update role/permission checks to use SpacetimeDB:
csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer] 
public static bool HasPermission(ReducerContext ctx, string permission)
{
    var userPermissions = UserPermission.Query(p => 
        p.userId == ctx.CallerIdentity && 
        p.permission == permission);
    return userPermissions.Any();
}

Here's a detailed migration approach using the /identity endpoint:

First, create a migration service:
csharp
public class SpacetimeIdentityMigrationService
{
    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly string _baseUrl;
    private readonly AppDbContext _context;

    public SpacetimeIdentityMigrationService(
        string spacetimeDbUrl,
        AppDbContext context)
    {
        _httpClient = new HttpClient();
        _baseUrl = spacetimeDbUrl;
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<(string identity, string token)> CreateIdentity(string email)
    {
        var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync(
            $"{_baseUrl}/identity?email={Uri.EscapeDataString(email)}", 
            null);
            
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            throw new Exception($"Failed to create identity: {response.StatusCode}");

        var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<IdentityResponse>();
        return (result.identity, result.token);
    }

    private class IdentityResponse
    {
        public string identity { get; set; }
        public string token { get; set; }
    }
}
Create a migration method to handle all users:
csharp
public async Task MigrateAllUsers()
{
    // Get all users that need migration
    var users = await _context.Users
        .Include(u => u.UserRoles)
        .ThenInclude(ur => ur.Role)
        .ThenInclude(r => r.RolePermissions)
        .ToListAsync();

    foreach (var user in users)
    {
        try
        {
            // Create SpacetimeDB identity
            var (identity, token) = await CreateIdentity(user.Email);

            // Store the identity with the user
            user.SpacetimeIdentity = identity;
            user.SpacetimeToken = token;

            // Create UserProfile in SpacetimeDB
            await CreateUserProfile(identity, token, user);

            // Migrate roles and permissions
            await MigrateUserRolesAndPermissions(identity, token, user);

            // Save changes to local database
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Error(ex, "Failed to migrate user {UserId}", user.UserId);
        }
    }
}
Create methods to set up SpacetimeDB data:
csharp
private async Task CreateUserProfile(string identity, string token, User user)
{
    var client = new SpacetimeDBClient();
    await client.Connect(_baseUrl, "your_database", token);

    // Call reducer to create user profile
    await client.CallReducer("CreateUserProfile",
        user.Login,
        user.IsActive,
        user.CreatedAt.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds());
}

private async Task MigrateUserRolesAndPermissions(string identity, string token, User user)
{
    var client = new SpacetimeDBClient();
    await client.Connect(_baseUrl, "your_database", token);

    foreach (var userRole in user.UserRoles)
    {
        // Call reducer to assign role
        await client.CallReducer("AssignUserRole",
            userRole.RoleId,
            userRole.AssignedAt.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds());

        // Migrate role permissions
        foreach (var rolePermission in userRole.Role.RolePermissions)
        {
            await client.CallReducer("AssignPermission",
                rolePermission.PermissionId);
        }
    }
}

Create a service to handle database creation and identity management:
csharp
public class SpacetimeDbInitializationService 
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;
    private readonly AppDbContext _context;
    private readonly ILogger _logger;
    private SpacetimeDBClient _client;

    public SpacetimeDbInitializationService(
        IConfiguration config,
        AppDbContext context,
        ILogger<SpacetimeDbInitializationService> logger)
    {
        _config = config;
        _context = context;
        _logger = logger;
        _client = SpacetimeDBClient.instance;
    }

    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // 1. Create and publish module
            await PublishModule();

            // 2. Create admin identity
            var adminIdentity = await CreateAdminIdentity();

            // 3. Connect to database
            await ConnectToDatabase(adminIdentity.token);

            // 4. Migrate existing users
            await MigrateUsers();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to initialize SpacetimeDB");
            throw;
        }
    }

    private async Task PublishModule()
    {
        var moduleName = _config["SpacetimeDB:ModuleName"];
        var projectPath = _config["SpacetimeDB:ProjectPath"];

        var process = new Process
        {
            StartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
            {
                FileName = "spacetime",
                Arguments = $"publish --project-path {projectPath} {moduleName}",
                RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                UseShellExecute = false
            }
        };

        process.Start();
        await process.WaitForExitAsync();

        if (process.ExitCode != 0)
            throw new Exception("Failed to publish module");
    }

    private async Task<(string identity, string token)> CreateAdminIdentity()
    {
        var adminEmail = _config["SpacetimeDB:AdminEmail"];
        
        using var httpClient = new HttpClient();
        var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(
            $"{_config["SpacetimeDB:Host"]}/identity?email={Uri.EscapeDataString(adminEmail)}", 
            null);

        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            throw new Exception($"Failed to create admin identity: {response.StatusCode}");

        var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<IdentityResponse>();
        return (result.identity, result.token);
    }

    private async Task ConnectToDatabase(string token)
    {
        // Connect using the admin token
        _client.Connect(
            token,
            _config["SpacetimeDB:Host"],
            _config["SpacetimeDB:ModuleName"],
            true);

        var connected = false;
        _client.onConnect += () => connected = true;

        // Wait for connection
        while (!connected)
            await Task.Delay(100);
    }

    private async Task MigrateUsers()
    {
        var users = await _context.Users
            .Include(u => u.UserRoles)
            .ThenInclude(ur => ur.Role)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try
            {
                // Create identity for each user
                var (identity, token) = await CreateIdentity(user.Email);

                // Store identity in existing database
                user.SpacetimeIdentity = identity;
                user.SpacetimeToken = token;
                await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

                // Create user profile in SpacetimeDB
                _client.CallReducer("CreateUserProfile",
                    user.Login,
                    user.IsActive,
                    DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to migrate user {UserId}", user.UserId);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task<(string identity, string token)> CreateIdentity(string email)
    {
        using var httpClient = new HttpClient();
        var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(
            $"{_config["SpacetimeDB:Host"]}/identity?email={Uri.EscapeDataString(email)}", 
            null);

public static void CreateUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string passwordHash) {

Step 2: Authentication Service Migration
csharp

public class SpacetimeAuthService {
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _client;

    public async Task<bool> AuthenticateUser(string login, string password) {
        // Legacy password check (to be removed)
        var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>("login = ?", login).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        if (user == null || !VerifyPassword(password, user.passwordHash))
            return false;

        // Create Identity if not exists (during migration phase)
        if (user.identity == default) {
            var identityResponse = await CreateIdentity(login);
            user.identity = identityResponse.identity;
            await _client.Update(user);
        }

        // Track login
        var loginEntry = new LoginHistory {
            userId = user.identity,
            timestamp = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
            ipAddress = "127.0.0.1" // From request
        };
        await _client.Insert(loginEntry);

        return true;
    }

    private async Task<IdentityResponse> CreateIdentity(string email) {
        // Using /identity API (docs: https://spacetimedb.com/docs/sdks/rest-api)
        var client = new HttpClient();
        var response = await client.PostAsync(
            "http://localhost:3000/identity?email=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(email),
            null
        );
        return await response.Content.ReadAsAsync<IdentityResponse>();
    }
}

Step 2: Migrate Existing Users
csharp

public async Task MigrateUsers() {
    using var oldContext = new OldDbContext(); // Your existing SQL context

    foreach (var user in oldContext.Users) {
        var identity = await CreateIdentity(user.Email);

        await _client.CallReducerAsync(
            "CreateUser",
            user.Login,
            user.PasswordHash
        );

        // Migrate roles
        foreach (var role in user.Roles) {
            await _client.Insert(new UserRole {
                userId = identity,
                roleId = (uint)role.RoleId,
                assignedAt = user.CreatedAt.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
            });
        }
    }
}
5. Controller Adaptation Example

[ApiController]
[Route("[controller]")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase {
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _client;

    [HttpPost("login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model) {
        if (await _authService.AuthenticateUser(model.Login, model.Password)) {
            // Get Identity token
            var token = await _client.GetAuthToken(model.Login);
            return Ok(new { token = token });
        }
        return Unauthorized();
    }

    [HttpGet("profile")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetProfile() {
        var userProfile = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.identity == _client.CallerIdentity)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        return Ok(userProfile);
    }
}

Reducer for Role Assignment
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, uint roleId) {
    // Validate role exists
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.roleId == roleId)) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Invalid role");

    // Check if user already has role
    if (UserRole.Exists(u => u.userId == userId && u.roleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");

    // Create relationship
    var userRole = new UserRole {
        userId = userId,
        roleId = roleId,
        assignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}

Reducer for Granting Permissions
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void GrantPermission(ReducerContext ctx, uint roleId, uint permissionId) {
    // Validate existence
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.roleId == roleId)) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role not found");
    if (!Permission.Exists(p => p.permissionId == permissionId)) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Permission not found");

    // Check existing assignment
    if (RolePermission.Exists(rp => 
        rp.roleId == roleId && 
        rp.permissionId == permissionId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Permission already granted");

    // Create relationship
    var rolePerm = new RolePermission {
        roleId = roleId,
        permissionId = permissionId,
        grantedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    rolePerm.Insert();
}

Reducer for Creating Nested Categories
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateCategory(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint? parentId, string name) {

    // Validate parent category
    if (parentId.HasValue && 
        !Category.Exists(c => c.categoryId == parentId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Invalid parent category");

    // Create new category
    var newCat = new Category {
        categoryId = Category.GetNextId(), // Implement ID generation
        parentId = parentId,
        name = name,
        createdAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    newCat.Insert();
}
Key Considerations
Foreign Key Emulation
Use explicit reference fields (like roleId or parentId) and validate relationships in reducers 79.
Manual Referential Integrity
SpacetimeDB doesn't enforce constraints, so handle validation in reducers (e.g., checking role existence before assignment) 8.
Querying Relationships
Since there are no joins, combine queries in the client:
csharp

// Get user's roles
var userRoles = await client.Query<UserRole>()
    .Where(ur => ur.userId == targetUser)
    .ToListAsync();

// Get role details
var roles = await client.Query<Role>()
    .Where(r => userRoles.Select(ur => ur.roleId).Contains(r.roleId))
    .ToListAsync();
ID Generation
Implement custom ID generation for non-Identity primary keys (e.g., CategoryId.GetNextId()) 3.
Eventual Consistency
Use reducers for all relationship changes to maintain consistency 2.
Best Practices from Your Project Context
Migrate Existing Relationships
Use reducers like MigrateExistingUser to map legacy IDs to SpacetimeDB's Identity type [[from chat context]].
Granular Permissions
Extend the Permission table to store specific actions (e.g., "read:user", "delete:ticket") and enforce checks in reducers [[from chat context]].
Audit Trails
Track changes in junction tables with timestamps (e.g., assignedAt and grantedAt) [[from messagespacetime.txt]].

### Key Relationships
1. **User ↔ Role** via **UserRole** (many-to-many)
2. **Role ↔ Permission** via **RolePermission** (many-to-many)
3. **Employee ↔ Job** via `jobId` (foreign key)
4. **Bus ↔ Maintenance** via `busId` (foreign key)
5. **Route ↔ RouteSchedule** via `routeId` (foreign key)
6. **Ticket ↔ Sale** via `ticketId` (foreign key)
7. **UserProfile ↔ AdminActionLog** via `userId` (foreign key)

### Notes
- **Primary Keys**: Use `uint` or `Identity` types (SpacetimeDB's built-in identity system).
- **Timestamps**: Use `ulong` to store Unix milliseconds since epoch.
- **Arrays**: Supported for simple types (e.g., `string[]`, `double[]`).
- **Foreign Keys**: Explicitly defined via reference fields (e.g., `userId`, `roleId`).
- **Navigation Properties**: Not supported; use explicit joins in reducers/queries.

This structure mirrors the tables and relationships described in **messagespacetime.txt**, with adjustments for SpacetimeDB’s requirements (no ORM-like navigation properties, explicit primary keys, etc.). Let me know if you need further details!

Here's a step-by-step implementation of the authentication API using SpacetimeDB based on your context and documentation:

```csharp
// 1. Define reducers in your SpacetimeDB module (spacetime-module.cs)
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static AuthResult AuthenticateUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string passwordHash)
{
    // Validate credentials against your existing system
    var user = UserProfile.Query(u => u.login == login).FirstOrDefault();
    if (user == null || user.passwordHash != passwordHash)
        return new AuthResult { success = false };

    // Fetch roles and permissions
    var roles = UserRole.Query(ur => ur.userId == user.identity)
        .Join(Role.Query(), ur => ur.roleId, r => r.roleId, (ur, r) => r)
        .Where(r => r.isActive)
        .Select(r => new RoleResult { id = r.roleId, name = r.name });

    var permissions = RolePermission.Query(rp => rp.roleId.In(roles.Select(r => r.id)))
        .Join(Permission.Query(), rp => rp.permissionId, p => p.permissionId, (rp, p) => p)
        .Where(p => p.isActive)
        .Select(p => p.name);

    return new AuthResult
    {
        success = true,
        identity = user.identity,
        roles = roles.ToArray(),
        permissions = permissions.ToArray()
    };
}

// 2. Create AuthResult structure
public partial struct AuthResult
{
    public bool success;
    public Identity identity;
    public RoleResult[] roles;
    public string[] permissions;
}

public partial struct RoleResult
{
    public uint id;
    public string name;
}

// 3. Configure SpacetimeDB client in your API
public class Startup
{
    public void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Initialize SpacetimeDB client
        services.AddSingleton<SpacetimeDBClient>(sp =>
        {
            var client = new SpacetimeDBClient();
            client.Connect(
                "http://localhost:3000", // From [[5]]
                "your_database_name",
                "admin_token" // From /identity endpoint [[4]]
            );
            return client;
        });

        // Add authentication services
        services.AddAuthentication(options =>
        {
            options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
        }).AddJwtBearer(options =>
        {
            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("your-secret-key")),
                ValidateIssuer = false,
                ValidateAudience = false
            };
        });
    }
}

// 4. Update AuthController
[ApiController]
[Route("api/auth")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _client;
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;

    public AuthController(SpacetimeDBClient client, IConfiguration config)
    {
        _client = client;
        _config = config;
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            // Call authentication reducer
            var result = await _client.CallReducer<AuthResult>(
                "AuthenticateUser",
                model.Login,
                HashPassword(model.Password) // Implement password hashing
            );

            if (!result.success)
                return Unauthorized();

            // Generate JWT with claims
            var claims = new[]
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, result.identity.ToString()),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, model.Login),
                new Claim("roles", string.Join(",", result.roles.Select(r => r.name))),
                new Claim("permissions", string.Join(",", result.permissions))
            };

            var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_config["Jwt:Key"]));
            var creds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

            var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
                expires: DateTime.Now.AddHours(1),
                claims: claims,
                signingCredentials: creds
            );

            return Ok(new { token = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token) });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Handle exceptions [[7]]
            return StatusCode(500, $"Internal server error: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    // 5. Add authorization middleware
    [Authorize]
    [HttpGet("profile")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetProfile()
    {
        var identity = GetCurrentUserIdentity();

        var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.identity == identity)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        return Ok(new 
        {
            user.login,
            roles = await GetUserRoles(identity)
        });
    }

    private Identity GetCurrentUserIdentity()
    {
        var identityClaim = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
        return Identity.Parse(identityClaim.Value);
    }

    private async Task<RoleResult[]> GetUserRoles(Identity userIdentity)
    {
        return await _client.Query<UserRole>()
            .Where(ur => ur.userId == userIdentity)
            .Join(_client.Query<Role>(), ur => ur.roleId, r => r.roleId, (ur, r) => r)
            .Where(r => r.isActive)
            .Select(r => new RoleResult { id = r.roleId, name = r.name })
            .ToArrayAsync();
    }
}

// 6. Implement password hashing
private string HashPassword(string password)
{
    // Use PBKDF2 or bcrypt (example with SHA256 for simplicity)
    using (SHA256 sha256 = SHA256.Create())
    {
        byte[] bytes = sha256.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password));
        return BitConverter.ToString(bytes).Replace("-", "").ToLowerInvariant();
    }
}
```

### Key Components Explained:

1. **Reducers** [[7]]:
   - `AuthenticateUser`: Validates credentials and returns identity + roles/permissions
   - Uses SpacetimeDB's query capabilities to join UserRole and Role tables

2. **JWT Integration** [[2]]:
   - Stores SpacetimeDB Identity in the JWT's `nameid` claim
   - Includes role names and permission names for API authorization

3. **Client Configuration**:
   - Connects to the database using the C# SDK [[5]]
   - Uses the admin token obtained from `/identity` endpoint [[4]]

4. **Security Practices**:
   - Stores password hashes (not plain text) [[1]]
   - Uses claims-based authorization for role checks
   - Maintains existing JWT authentication flow while integrating SpacetimeDB

### Usage Workflow:

1. **User Login**:
   - Calls `/api/auth/login` with username/password
   - Reducer validates credentials against UserProfile table
   - Returns JWT containing SpacetimeDB Identity and role/permission claims

2. **Protected Endpoint**:
   - `/api/auth/profile` requires `Authorization` header
   - Uses `GetCurrentUserIdentity()` to get SpacetimeDB Identity from JWT
   - Queries SpacetimeDB for user details using the Identity

### Migration Considerations:

- **Identity Mapping**:
  - Use the `spacetime identity new` CLI command [[4]] to create initial Identities
  - Migrate existing users by calling `CreateIdentity` service [[7]]

- **Role/Permission Checks**:
  ```csharp

  ```

### Security Notes:

- **Password Storage**:
  - Never store passwords in plain text (use bcrypt/PBKDF2)
  - Consider deprecating legacy password fields once migrated to Identity system

- **Token Management**:
  - Use short-lived JWT tokens (1 hour) with refresh tokens
  - Store sensitive data (tokens/keys) in secure vaults [[2]]

This implementation maintains your existing authentication workflow while integrating SpacetimeDB's Identity system, roles, and permissions. The reducers handle core authentication logic, and the API acts as a facade to provide JWT compatibility.

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string email) {

        spacetimeIdentity = ctx.CallerIdentity, // Assigned via SpacetimeDB

ID Generation :
Use a separate counter table to track the next userId:
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct UserIdCounter {
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string key = "userId"; // Singleton record
    public uint nextId;
}

private static uint GenerateNextUserId() {
    var counter = UserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new UserIdCounter { nextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.nextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.nextId;
}

Modify your controller to use userId for queries while retaining spacetimeIdentity internally:

[ApiController]
[Route("api/users")]
public class UserController : ControllerBase {
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _client;

    [HttpGet("{userId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetUser(uint userId) {
        var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.userId == userId)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (user == null) return NotFound();

        return Ok(new {
            userId = user.userId,
            login = user.login,
            email = user.email
        });
    }
}

Давайте разберёмся с секцией userId = GenerateNextUserId() в контексте миграции на SpacetimeDB и генерации уникальных ID. Это критически важно для сохранения совместимости с вашим существующим кодом, который использует числовые UserId.

Что делает строка userId = GenerateNextUserId()?
Эта строка назначает новому пользователю уникальный численный userId, который будет использоваться в вашем старом коде (например, в UserController для поиска пользователей по long UserId).

Почему это нужно?
Совместимость с существующим кодом :
В вашем старом коде из messagespacetime.txt используется long UserId (например, в User модели EF Core):
csharp

public class User {
    [Key]
    public long UserId { get; set; }
    // Другие поля
}
SpacetimeDB использует Identity (строковый UUID) в качестве первичного ключа, но ваш код ожидает числовые ID для запросов (например, GET /api/users/{userId}).
Уникальность :
Нужно гарантировать, что userId не повторяется и увеличивается последовательно, как это было в SQL Server.
Как работает GenerateNextUserId()?
Этот метод реализует атомарный счетчик , чтобы избежать коллизий ID в многопоточной среде.

Шаги реализации :
Создайте таблицу для отслеживания счетчика :
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct UserIdCounter {
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string key = "userId"; // Уникальный ключ для синглтона
    public uint currentId; // Текущее значение счетчика
}
Реализуйте метод GenerateNextUserId() :
csharp

private static uint GenerateNextUserId() {
    // 1. Получаем текущее значение счетчика
    var counter = UserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    
    if (counter == null) {
        // Если таблица пуста — инициализируем начальное значение (например, 1)
        counter = new UserIdCounter {
            currentId = 1
        };
        counter.Insert(); // Сохраняем в SpacetimeDB
    } else {
        // 2. Увеличиваем счетчик на 1
        counter.currentId++;
        counter.Update(); // Обновляем значение в БД
    }
    
    return counter.currentId;
}
Почему такой подход безопасен?
Атомарность :
В SpacetimeDB операции Insert и Update атомарны, поэтому одновременные запросы не приведут к дублирующимся ID 17.
Однозначность :
Таблица UserIdCounter хранит единственную запись (key = "userId"), что гарантирует, что счетчик всегда один 48.
Как это интегрируется в миграцию?
Миграция существующих пользователей :
При миграции данных из SQL Server в SpacetimeDB начальное значение currentId должно быть установлено на максимальное значение UserId из старой базы. Например:
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer(ReducerKind.Init)]
public static void InitializeDatabase(ReducerContext ctx) {
    // Инициализируем счетчик на основе старой базы
    var maxOldUserId = GetMaxUserIdFromOldDatabase(); // Реализация зависит от вашей миграции
    
    var counter = new UserIdCounter {
        currentId = maxOldUserId + 1 // Чтобы избежать коллизий
    };
    counter.Insert();
}
Создание новых пользователей :
При вызове CreateUser в редьюсере:
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string email) {
    var newUser = new UserProfile {
        spacetimeIdentity = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        userId = GenerateNextUserId(), // Вызываем метод
        login = login,
        email = email,
        createdAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    newUser.Insert();
}
Альтернативы и их недостатки
UUID в виде чисел :
Можно использовать Guid.NewGuid().GetHashCode(), но это может привести к коллизиям 56.
Внешние генераторы :
Например,雪花ID (Snowflake), но это усложнит интеграцию с SpacetimeDB 78.
Избегание проблем
Конкурентные запросы :
Метод GenerateNextUserId() использует атомарное обновление счетчика, поэтому параллельные вызовы не дадут одинаковые userId.
Безопасность :
Счетчик хранится в SpacetimeDB, поэтому его невозможно подделать извне 110.

Key Points
It seems likely that converting a SQL Server API server to SpacetimeDB involves defining tables as C# structs, creating reducers for operations, and integrating with client code.
Research suggests that all tables from the existing SQL Server schema, including User, Roles, Permissions, Bus, Maintenance, Route, Employee, Job, Ticket, Sale, and RouteSchedules, need to be converted.
The evidence leans toward using SpacetimeDB's C# SDK for client interactions, with data types like uint for IDs and ulong for timestamps.
Table Definitions
The conversion process starts by mapping SQL Server tables to SpacetimeDB structs. Each table is defined with a primary key (typically uint) and appropriate data types, such as ulong for timestamps and string for text fields. For example, the User table in SQL Server with fields like UserId (long) and CreatedAt (DateTime) becomes a SpacetimeDB struct with UserId as uint and CreatedAt as ulong.

Reducers and Operations
Reducers handle database modifications, such as registering a user or assigning roles. These are static methods with the [Reducer] attribute, ensuring transactional consistency. For instance, a RegisterUser reducer checks for existing logins and inserts new user data, including timestamp conversions.

Integration and Migration
After defining tables and reducers, compile and publish the module using the SpacetimeDB CLI, then generate client code for API integration. Data migration from SQL Server to SpacetimeDB can involve exporting to CSV and importing via scripts, ensuring data consistency.

Step 1: Define Tables in SpacetimeDB
In SpacetimeDB, tables are defined as C# partial structs with attributes from the SpacetimeDB namespace. We map each SQL Server table, converting data types as follows:

Primary keys (long or Guid) to uint.
Timestamps (DateTime) to ulong for Unix timestamps.
Relationships handled via foreign keys (uint) instead of navigation properties.

Note: For tables like RouteSchedules with arrays, SpacetimeDB supports array types, which is an unexpected detail given SQL Server’s lack of native array support, requiring additional handling in reducers for calculated fields like TotalTravelTime.

Step 2: Define Reducers for Database Operations
Reducers are transactional methods that modify the database state. We need reducers for CRUD operations and relationship management, such as user registration, role assignment, and schedule creation. Below are sample reducers:

cs

Свернуть

Перенос

Копировать
[Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, RegisterUserInput input)
{
    var existingUser = User.FindOne(u => u.Login == input.Login);
    if (existingUser != null)
    {
        throw new Exception("Login already exists");
    }

    var userId = User.NewId();
    var newUser = new User
    {
        UserId = userId,
        Login = input.Login,
        PasswordHash = input.PasswordHash,
        CreatedAt = GetCurrentTimestamp(),
        LastLoginAt = null,
        IsActive = true,
        PhoneNumber = input.PhoneNumber,
        Email = input.Email
    };
    newUser.Insert();

    var role = Roles.FindOne(r => r.LegacyRoleId == input.Role);
    if (role != null)
    {
        new UserRole { UserId = userId, RoleId = role.RoleId }.Insert();
    }
}

[Struct]
public partial struct RegisterUserInput
{
    public string Login;
    public string PasswordHash;
    public int Role;
    public string? PhoneNumber;
    public string? Email;
}

private static ulong GetCurrentTimestamp()
{
    return (ulong)(DateTime.UtcNow - new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalSeconds;
}

{
    if (input.RouteStops == null || input.RouteStops.Length == 0)
    {
        throw new Exception("Route stops must be provided");
    }

    int totalStops = input.RouteStops.Length;
    string totalTravelTime = CalculateTravelTime(input.RouteStops); // Implement based on business logic
    bool isCurrentlyValid = CheckValidity(input); // Implement based on conditions

    var scheduleId = RouteSchedules.NewId();
    var newSchedule = new RouteSchedules
    {
        ScheduleId = scheduleId,
        RouteId = input.RouteId,
        RouteStops = input.RouteStops,
        DaysOfWeek = input.DaysOfWeek,
        BusTypes = input.BusTypes,
        TotalTravelTime = totalTravelTime,
        TotalStops = totalStops,
        IsCurrentlyValid = isCurrentlyValid
    };
    newSchedule.Insert();
}

Considerations and Notes
Authentication and Authorization: SpacetimeDB uses identities and tokens for authentication, replacing SQL Server’s role-based checks. Reducers can verify sender roles using the UserRole table.
Complex Relationships: Many-to-many relationships (e.g., User-Roles, Roles-Permissions) are handled via junction tables (UserRole, RolePermission), managed through reducers.
Performance and Scalability: SpacetimeDB’s in-memory, distributed nature offers real-time updates, a significant shift from SQL Server, potentially improving latency for ticket sales applications.

Based on the GitHub issues, row-level security and permissions are actively being worked on:

Current Status:
Private tables can be created by using a _ prefix or marking them as non-public 1
Non-module-owner clients are restricted from accessing private tables
Upcoming Features:
Row-level permissions are in active development with several weeks of design work already completed
There are plans to implement SQL-style EXISTS clauses for defining permissions 2

The SpacetimeDB team acknowledges this is a complex feature with security and performance implications, and they want to ensure it's implemented correctly 1. While there's no specific release date mentioned, it's actively being worked on.

ok you gaslit yourself into string type for identity  
 

Based on the documentation, here's the proper way to define a UserProfile table with Identity:

```csharp
[Table(Name = "player", Public = true)]
public partial struct Player
{
    [PrimaryKey]
    public Identity identity;
    [Unique, AutoInc]
    public uint player_id;
    public string name;
}
```
 [(1)](https://spacetimedb.com/docs/modules/c-sharp/quickstart#define-tables) 

String would never be valid for Identity because:

1. Identity is a built-in SpacetimeDB type specifically designed for authentication and identification 

2. The Identity is automatically provided by SpacetimeDB when a client connects, as shown in the Connect reducer:

```csharp
[Reducer(ReducerKind.ClientConnected)]
public static void Connect(ReducerContext ctx)
{
    Log.Info($"{ctx.CallerIdentity} just connected.");
}
```
 [(2)](https://spacetimedb.com/docs/unity/part-2#create-a-server-module) 

3. The Identity is used by SpacetimeDB to track who calls reducers and validate permissions  [(1)](https://spacetimedb.com/docs/modules/c-sharp/quickstart#define-tables) 

So Identity must use SpacetimeDB's built-in Identity type to work with the authentication system - a string would not provide the security and functionality needed for proper authentication and authorization.

Based on the provided knowledge base and best practices from SpacetimeDB documentation and community discussions, here are the best practices for managing relationships between tables in SpacetimeDB :

1. Use Explicit References Instead of Foreign Keys
Why : SpacetimeDB does not enforce foreign key constraints , so relationships must be managed explicitly through IDs and application logic 58.
How :
Define unique identifiers (e.g., Identity, uint, or Guid) for related tables.
Use these IDs as reference fields in junction tables or related entities.
Example:
csharp

// User-Role relationship
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct UserRole {
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public Identity userId; // References UserProfile.identity
    public uint roleId;     // References Role.roleId
    public ulong assignedAt;
}
2. Validate Relationships in Reducers
Why : Ensure data integrity by enforcing business rules programmatically 258.
How :
Use reducers to check existence of referenced records before inserting/updating.
Example for role assignment:
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, uint roleId) {
    // Validate existence of user and role
    if (!UserProfile.Exists(u => u.identity == userId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("User does not exist");
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.roleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role does not exist");
    
    var userRole = new UserRole { userId = userId, roleId = roleId };
    userRole.Insert();
}
3. Avoid Navigation Properties
Why : SpacetimeDB does not support ORM-like navigation properties 910.
How :
Use explicit joins in reducers or client-side queries.
Example to get a user's roles:

    .Where(ur => ur.userId == targetUserIdentity)
    .Join(client.Query<Role>(), ur => ur.roleId, r => r.roleId, (ur, r) => r)
    .ToListAsync();

How :
Create a junction table for relationships like UserRole or RolePermission.
Example for role-permission relationships:
csharp

5. Leverage Atomic Counters for ID Generation

How :

csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Table]

    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string key = "userId"; // Singleton record
    public uint nextId;
}
Use reducers to atomically increment the counter:
csharp

private static uint GenerateNextUserId() {
    var counter = UserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new UserIdCounter { nextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.nextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.nextId;
}

By following these practices, you can achieve robust relationships in SpacetimeDB while leveraging its high-performance architecture. Let me know if you need further clarification!

The blog post example you linked is using SQL syntax for illustrative purposes and does not reflect SpacetimeDB's actual implementation. Here's a detailed explanation based on the provided sources:

Key Clarifications from Sources
SpacetimeDB Does Not Support Traditional Foreign Keys
The blog example uses SQL syntax to explain entity relationships conceptually, but SpacetimeDB's data model does not enforce foreign key constraints at the database level 245.
Foreign keys are considered "business rules" that should be implemented in reducers or application logic, not the database 26.
How Relationships Are Handled in SpacetimeDB
Relationships are maintained through explicit references (e.g., Identity or numeric IDs) and manual validation in reducers 18.
Example from your tables:
csharp

// UserRole table
public partial struct UserRole {
    public Identity userId; // References UserProfile.identity
    public uint roleId;     // References Role.roleId
    ...
}
Validation in reducers :
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, uint roleId) {
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.roleId == roleId)) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Invalid role"); // Manual FK check
    ...
}
Why Foreign Keys Are Avoided
SpacetimeDB prioritizes data-oriented design , which avoids rigid schema constraints for scalability and performance 18.
Foreign keys can introduce locking and performance overhead during writes, which SpacetimeDB's architecture avoids 108.
Example Migration of Your Tables
Original SQL Table with Foreign Keys
sql

CREATE TABLE UserRole (
    userId INT PRIMARY KEY,
    roleId INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES UserProfile(userId),
    FOREIGN KEY (roleId) REFERENCES Role(roleId)
);
SpacetimeDB Equivalent
csharp

[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct UserRole {
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public Identity userId; // References UserProfile.identity
    public uint roleId;     // References Role.roleId (no FK constraint)
    public ulong assignedAt;
}

// Reducer to enforce relationships
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, uint roleId) {
    // Validate existence of referenced records
    if (!UserProfile.Exists(u => u.identity == userId)) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("User does not exist");
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.roleId == roleId)) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role does not exist");
    
    var userRole = new UserRole {
        userId = userId,
        roleId = roleId,
        assignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
Advantages of This Approach
Full Control Over Relationships
Business rules (e.g., "user must exist before assigning a role") are explicitly defined in reducers 26.
Performance Optimization
No automatic constraint checks during writes, which improves throughput 108.
Schema Flexibility
Relationships can be adjusted without altering database constraints 15.
When to Use This Pattern
Mandatory Relationships :
Validate references in reducers before inserting/updating records.
Optional Relationships :
Allow null values and handle them in application logic.
Conclusion
While the blog post uses SQL syntax to illustrate entity relationships, SpacetimeDB requires manual enforcement of relationships through reducers and explicit checks. This aligns with its design philosophy of keeping business logic in the application layer 268. For your migration, focus on implementing these checks in reducers rather than relying on database-level constraints.

### **2. Key Optimizations**
#### **A. Use Composite Primary Keys**
- **Why**: Ensures uniqueness for role-permission pairs [[2]][[8]].
- **Implementation**:
  ```csharp

  }
  ```

#### **B. Timestamps as `ulong`**
- **Why**: Reduces storage overhead compared to `DateTime` [[7]][[8]].
- **Conversion**:
  ```csharp
  public ulong CreatedAt => (ulong)DateTime.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
  ```

#### **C. Atomic Updates via Reducers**
- **Why**: Ensures consistency during permission updates [[5]][[8]].
- **Example Reducer for Updating Permissions**:
  ```csharp
  [SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
  public static void UpdateRolePermissions(ReducerContext ctx, 
      Guid roleId, 
      List<Guid> newPermissionIds)
  {
      // Step 1: Delete existing permissions
      var existing = RolePermission.Query()
          .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId)
          .ToList();
      existing.DeleteAll();
      
      // Step 2: Insert new permissions
      foreach (var permissionId in newPermissionIds)
      {
          var newRp = new RolePermission
          {
              RoleId = roleId,
              PermissionId = permissionId,
              GrantedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString(),
              GrantedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
          };
          newRp.Insert();
      }
  }
  ```

### **3. Robustness Improvements**
#### **A. Validation in Reducers**
- **Why**: SpacetimeDB doesn't enforce foreign keys, so validation is manual [[2]][[6]].

  ```csharp
  [SpacetimeDB.Reducer]

          throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role name must be unique");
      
      if (model.PermissionIds?.Any(p => !Permission.Exists(rp => rp.PermissionId == p)) ?? false)
          throw new SpacetimeDBException("Invalid permission ID");
  ```
