  ```csharp
  }
  ```

#### **B. System Role Protection**
- **Why**: Prevent accidental modification of critical roles [[8]].
- **Implementation**:
  ```csharp
  [SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
  public static void DeleteRole(ReducerContext ctx, Guid roleId)
  {
      var role = Role.Get(roleId);
      if (role.IsSystem)
          throw new SpacetimeDBException("Cannot delete system roles");
      
      RolePermission.DeleteAll(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId);
      role.Delete();
  }
  ```

```csharp
public async Task MigrateRoles()
{
```

#### **B. GUID Compatibility**

- **Controller Example**:
  ```csharp
  [HttpGet("{id}")]
  public async Task<IActionResult> GetRole(Guid id)
  {
      var role = await _client.Query<Role>()
          .Where(r => r.RoleId == id)
          .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
      
      if (role == null) return NotFound();
      
      // Manually join permissions
      var permissions = await _client.Query<Permission>()
          .Join(_client.Query<RolePermission>(),
              p => p.PermissionId,
              rp => rp.PermissionId,
              (p, rp) => p)
          .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == id)
          .ToListAsync();
      
      return Ok(new { role, permissions });
  }
  ```

### **Reducers for Validation and Business Logic**
#### **Create User**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateUser(ReducerContext ctx, 
    string login, 
    string passwordHash, 
    Guid guidId) 
{
    // Validate uniqueness
    if (UserProfile.Exists(u => u.Login == login))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Login already exists");

    // Generate LegacyUserId via atomic counter
    var userId = GenerateLegacyUserId(); // Implement atomic counter

    var user = new UserProfile {
        UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity, // SpacetimeDB Identity
        LegacyUserId = userId,
        GuidId = guidId,
        Login = login,
        PasswordHash = passwordHash,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    user.Insert();
}
```

#### **Assign Role to User**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, 
    Identity userId, 
    Guid roleId) 
{
    // Validate existence
    if (!UserProfile.Exists(u => u.UserId == userId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("User not found");
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role not found");

    // Check if already assigned
    if (UserRole.Exists(ur => ur.UserId == userId && ur.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");

    var userRole = new UserRole {
        UserId = userId,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        AssignedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

#### **Atomic Counter for LegacyUserId**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct LegacyUserIdCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "user"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateLegacyUserId() 
{
    var counter = LegacyUserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new LegacyUserIdCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

### **3. Bus and Maintenance Tables**
#### **Bus Table (Atomic Counter for `busId`)**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Bus {
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
    public uint BusId; // Generated via atomic counter
    
    public string Model;
    public ulong PurchaseDate;
}

// Atomic counter for `BusId`
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct BusCounter {
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "busId";
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateBusId() {
    var counter = BusCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new BusCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

#### **Maintenance Table**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Maintenance {

    public uint MaintenanceId; // Atomic counter
    
    public uint BusId; // Foreign key to Bus.BusId
    public ulong LastServiceDate;
    public string ServiceDetails;
    
    // Track technician via Identity
    public Identity TechnicianId;
}
```

### **6. Reducers for Validation and Robustness**
#### **Role Assignment Reducer**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, Guid roleId) {
    // Validate user exists
    if (!UserProfile.Exists(u => u.UserId == userId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("User not found");
    
    // Validate role exists
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role not found");
    
    // Check if already assigned
    if (UserRole.Exists(ur => ur.UserId == userId && ur.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");
    
    // Create UserRole entry
    var userRole = new UserRole {
        UserId = userId,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        AssignedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

#### **Bus Maintenance Reducer**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RecordMaintenance(ReducerContext ctx, uint busId, string details) {
    // Validate bus exists
    if (!Bus.Exists(b => b.BusId == busId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Bus not found");
    
    // Create maintenance record
    var maintenance = new Maintenance {
        MaintenanceId = GenerateBusId(), // Use shared counter
        BusId = busId,
        LastServiceDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        ServiceDetails = details
    };
    maintenance.Insert();
}
```

---

### **7. Migration Strategy**
1. **Data Migration Scripts**:
   ```csharp
   // Migrate Roles
   foreach (var oldRole in sqlContext.Roles) {
       var newRole = new Role {
           RoleId = oldRole.RoleId, // Preserve GUID
           Name = oldRole.Name,
           CreatedAt = (ulong)oldRole.CreatedAt.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
       };
       newRole.Insert();
   }
   
   // Migrate Permissions
   foreach (var oldPerm in sqlContext.Permissions) {
       var newPerm = new Permission {
           PermissionId = oldPerm.PermissionId,
           Name = oldPerm.Name,
           Category = oldPerm.Category
       };
       newPerm.Insert();
   }
   ```

2. **Atomic Counters Initialization**:
   ```csharp
   // Initialize BusId counter
   var maxBusId = GetMaxBusIdFromSqlServer();
   var busCounter = new BusCounter { NextId = maxBusId + 1 };
   busCounter.Insert();
   ```

---

### **8. Performance and Robustness Improvements**
- **Denormalization**:
  - Store `BusModel` in `Route` to avoid joins.
  - Precompute `PermissionCount` in `Role` for faster reads.

- **Input Validation**:
  - Validate all foreign keys (e.g., `BusId`, `RoleId`) in reducers [[2]][[6]].
  - Reject invalid timestamps or data ranges.

- **Audit Logging**:
  ```csharp
  [SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
  public static void LogChange(ReducerContext ctx, string entityType, string action) {
      var log = new AuditLog {
          UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
          EntityType = entityType,
          Action = action,
          Timestamp = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
      };
      log.Insert();
  }
  ```

- **Concurrency Control**:
  - Use `version` fields for optimistic locking [[10]].
  - Handle conflicts in reducers (e.g., retry logic).

---

### **9. Key Trade-offs**
| **Aspect**          | **Old System**                          | **SpacetimeDB**                          |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| **Primary Keys**     | `Guid`/`int`                           | `Guid`, `uint` (atomic counters), `Identity` |
| **Joins**            | ORM-based (e.g., `.Include()`)          | Explicit joins in reducers/client         |
| **Validation**       | Database constraints                   | Manual checks in reducers                 |
| **Timestamps**       | `DateTime`                             | `ulong` (Unix milliseconds)               |

---

### **10. Final Recommendations**
1. **Phase Migration**:
   - Migrate roles/permissions first to maintain API compatibility.
   - Convert core tables (users, buses) next.

2. **Testing**:
   - Validate all reducers with edge cases (e.g., duplicate roles, invalid IDs).
   - Stress-test atomic counters under high concurrency.

3. **Monitoring**:
   - Track audit logs for suspicious activity.
   - Use SpacetimeDB’s built-in metrics for performance monitoring.

By following these steps, you’ll achieve a robust, performant system while maintaining compatibility with your existing API’s use of `Guid` for critical entities like roles and permissions. Let me know if you need help with specific reducers or migration scripts!

```csharp
// For Tickets
```

### **Reducers for Ticket and Sale Management**
#### **Create Ticket**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateTicket(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint legacyRouteId, 
    double price) 
{
    if (!Route.Exists(r => r.LegacyRouteId == legacyRouteId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");

    var newTicket = new Ticket {
        TicketId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        LegacyTicketId = GenerateTicketId(),
        LegacyRouteId = legacyRouteId,
        TicketPrice = price
    };
    newTicket.Insert();
}
```

#### **Record Sale**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RecordSale(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint legacyTicketId, 
    string buyerName, 
    string buyerPhone) 
{
    if (!Ticket.Exists(t => t.LegacyTicketId == legacyTicketId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Ticket not found");

    var newSale = new Sale {
        SaleId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        LegacyTicketId = legacyTicketId,
        SaleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        TicketSoldToUser = buyerName,
        TicketSoldToUserPhone = buyerPhone,
        SellerId = ctx.CallerIdentity // Track who sold the ticket
    };
    newSale.Insert();
}
```

### **Key Improvements**
1. **Legacy ID Preservation**:
   - `LegacyTicketId` and `LegacyRouteId` ensure compatibility with your existing `long` IDs [[messagespacetime.txt]].
   - Atomic counters (`TicketCounter`, `RouteCounter`) maintain uniqueness [[messagespacetime.txt]][[5]].

2. **Denormalization**:
   - `RouteName` in `Ticket` avoids joins for common queries [[8]][[messagespacetime.txt]].
   - `TicketPrice` is stored directly in `Ticket` for faster access [[messagespacetime.txt]].

3. **Audit Tracking**:
   - `SellerId` tracks who sold the ticket via `Identity` [[messagespacetime.txt]].
   - `SaleDate` uses `ulong` for compact storage [[messagespacetime.txt]][[7]].

4. **Validation**:
   - Reducers enforce existence of referenced `Route` and `Ticket` before creating records [[messagespacetime.txt]][[2]].

### **API Controller Adjustments**
#### **Get Ticket with Sales**
```csharp
[HttpGet("{ticketId}")]
public async Task<IActionResult> GetTicket(uint legacyTicketId) 
{
    var ticket = await _client.Query<Ticket>()
        .Where(t => t.LegacyTicketId == legacyTicketId)
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

    if (ticket == null) return NotFound();

    var sales = await _client.Query<Sale>()
        .Where(s => s.LegacyTicketId == legacyTicketId)
        .ToListAsync();

    return Ok(new {
        ticket.TicketPrice,
        ticket.RouteName,
        Sales = sales.Select(s => new {
            s.SaleDate,
            s.TicketSoldToUser,
            s.TicketSoldToUserPhone
        })
    });
}
```

### **Итоговая структура для билетов и продаж в SpacetimeDB**

#### **1. Таблица `Ticket` (Билет)**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Ticket 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey, ColumnAttrs.AutoInc)] 
    public uint TicketId; // Автоинкрементный первичный ключ

    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.Index)] // Индекс для ускорения поиска
    public uint RouteId; // Ссылка на маршрут

    [Required] 
    public double TicketPrice; // Цена (double вместо decimal)

    public ulong CreatedAt; // Время создания (Unix timestamp)

    // Денирмализация для быстрого доступа к названию маршрута
    public string RouteName => 
        Route.Query().Where(r => r.RouteId == RouteId).FirstOrDefault()?.Name;
}
```

#### **2. Таблица `Sale` (Продажа)**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Sale 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey, ColumnAttrs.AutoInc)] 
    public uint SaleId; // Автоинкрементный первичный ключ

    [Required] 
    public uint TicketId; // Ссылка на билет

    public ulong SaleDate; // Время продажи (Unix timestamp)

    public string TicketSoldToUser = "ФИЗ.ПРОДАЖА"; 
    public string TicketSoldToUserPhone = "+375333000000"; 

    // Идентификатор продавца (пользователя)
    public Identity SellerId; // Используется для связи с UserProfile
}
```

#### **3. Таблица `UserProfile` (Для связи с продавцом)**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct UserProfile 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
    public Identity UserId; // Идентификатор пользователя

    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)] 
    public uint LegacyUserId; // Старый ID из SQL для обратной совместимости

    public string Email; 
    public bool IsActive; 
    // Другие поля...
}
```

---

### **Почему так лучше?**
1. **Автонумерация**:
   - `TicketId` и `SaleId` генерируются через `AutoInc`, что проще и экономит место [[7]].
   - Для совместимости с SQL используйте атомарные счётчики для `LegacyUserId` и `LegacyTicketId` [[5]].

2. **Идентификация продавца**:
   - `SellerId` в таблице `Sale` хранит Identity пользователя, выполнившего продажу. Это позволяет:
     - Отслеживать, кто выполнил продажу.
     - Использовать права пользователя через `ctx.CallerIdentity` в редьюсерах [[1]].

3. **Производительность**:
   - `ulong` для времени вместо `DateTime` сокращает размер данных [[7]].
   - Индекс по `RouteId` ускоряет поиск билетов по маршруту [[messagespacetime.txt]].

4. **Денирмализация**:
   - `RouteName` в `Ticket` упрощает получение данных без JOIN-ов [[3]].

```csharp
    if (!Ticket.Exists(t => t.TicketId == ticketId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Билет не существует");

    {
        TicketId = ticketId,
        SaleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        TicketSoldToUser = buyerName,
        TicketSoldToUserPhone = buyerPhone,
        SellerId = ctx.CallerIdentity // Идентификатор текущего пользователя
    };
    sale.Insert();
}
```

#### **Получение продаж по пользователю**

```csharp
    .Where(s => s.SellerId == targetUserIdentity) // Поиск по Identity продавца
    .ToListAsync();
```

### **Плюсы такого подхода**
- **Соответствие документации**: Использует Identity только для пользователей, а не для бизнес-сущностей [[1]].
- **Производительность**: Автоинкрементные ключи быстрее и экономичнее [[messagespacetime.txt]].
- **Аудит**: `SellerId` позволяет отслеживать, кто выполнил продажу, без дополнительных таблиц [[1]].

### **Миграция данных**
1. **Создание Identity для пользователей**:
   ```csharp
   // Для каждого пользователя из SQL:
   var (identity, token) = await CreateIdentity(user.Email); // Через /identity API
   await _client.CallReducer("CreateUserProfile", identity, user.LegacyUserId);
   ```

2. **Миграция билетов**:
   ```csharp
   foreach (var oldTicket in sqlContext.Bilet)
   {
       await _client.CallReducer("CreateTicket", 
           oldTicket.RouteId, 
           oldTicket.TicketPrice);
   }
   ```

3. **Миграция продаж**:
   ```csharp
   foreach (var oldSale in sqlContext.Prodazha)
   {
       await _client.CallReducer("RecordSale", 
           oldSale.TicketId, 
           oldSale.TicketSoldToUser, 
           oldSale.TicketSoldToUserPhone);
   }
   ```

### **Ответ на ваши вопросы**
1. **"Почему не использовать Identity для первичных ключей?"**  
   Identity предназначен для пользователей, а не для бизнес-сущностей. Использование `uint` с `AutoInc` проще и экономит место [[7]].

2. **"Как связать продажу с пользователем?"**  
   Поле `SellerId` в `Sale` хранит Identity пользователя. Например:
   ```csharp
   var seller = UserProfile.Get(sale.SellerId);
   ```

3. **"Как обработать миграцию старых продаж?"**  
   Используйте атомарные счётчики для `TicketId` и `SaleId`, сохранив старые `long` ID в `LegacyTicketId` [[5]].

---

### **Итог**
Этот подход:
- Сохраняет ваши бизнес-логики.
- Использует Identity только для пользователей.
- Оптимизирует производительность и размер данных.
- Соответствует рекомендациям SpacetimeDB [[1]][[3]][[7]].

### **1. User Management Tables**
#### **UserProfile (User Table)**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]

{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
```

#### **Reducers for User Management**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateUser(ReducerContext ctx, string email, string phoneNumber) 
{
    if (UserProfile.Exists(u => u.Email == email))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Email already exists");

    var userId = GenerateLegacyUserId(); // Atomic counter for LegacyUserId
    var user = new UserProfile {
        UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        LegacyUserId = userId,
        Email = email,
        PhoneNumber = phoneNumber,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    user.Insert();

// Atomic counter for LegacyUserId
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct LegacyUserIdCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "user"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateLegacyUserId() 
{
    var counter = LegacyUserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new LegacyUserIdCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignPermissionToRole(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint roleId, 
    uint permissionId) 
{
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role not found");
    if (!Permission.Exists(p => p.PermissionId == permissionId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Permission not found");

    var existing = RolePermission.Query()
        .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == roleId && rp.PermissionId == permissionId)
        .FirstOrDefault();
    if (existing != null) return; // Already exists

    var rp = new RolePermission {
        RoleId = roleId,
        PermissionId = permissionId,
        GrantedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        GrantedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString()
    };
    rp.Insert();
}
```

### **7. Key Optimizations**
#### **Atomic Counters for Legacy IDs**
```csharp
// Example for RouteId
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct RouteCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "route"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateRouteId() 
{
    var counter = RouteCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new RouteCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

#### **Validation in Reducers**

```csharp
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");
    if (!Employee.Exists(e => e.EmployeeId == driverId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Employee not found");

    var route = Route.Get(routeId);
    route.DriverId = driverId;
    route.Update();
}
```

#### **Concurrency Control**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Route 
{
    public ulong Version; // Track for optimistic concurrency
}

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void UpdateRoute(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint routeId, 
    string newEndPoint) 
{
    var route = Route.Get(routeId);
    if (route == null) throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");
    
    if (route.Version != ctx.Version) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Stale version");
    
    route.EndPoint = newEndPoint;
    route.Version++;
    route.Update();
}
```

#### **Input Validation**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateSale(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint ticketId, 
    string buyerName, 
    string buyerPhone) 
{
    if (!Ticket.Exists(t => t.TicketId == ticketId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Ticket not found");

    if (Ticket.Get(ticketId).AvailableSeats == 0)
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("No seats available");

    var newSale = new Sale {
        TicketId = ticketId,
        SaleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        BuyerName = buyerName,
        BuyerPhone = buyerPhone
    };
    newSale.Insert();
}
```

### **10. Performance Improvements**
- **Auto-Incrementing IDs**: Replace GUIDs with `uint` for compact storage [[3]][[7]].
- **Denormalization**: Precompute fields like `RouteName` to avoid joins [[messagespacetime.txt]][[3]].
- **Timestamps**: Use `ulong` instead of `DateTime` for compact storage [[messagespacetime.txt]][[7]].

---

### **11. Security Enhancements**
- **Access Control**:
  ```csharp
  if (!RolePermission.Exists(rp => 
      rp.RoleId == userRole.RoleId && 
      rp.PermissionId == "manage_routes"))
      throw new SpacetimeDBException("Unauthorized");
  ```
- **Password Hashing**: Store hashes securely, never plaintext [[messagespacetime.txt]].
- **Token Management**: Use SpacetimeDB's built-in Identity system for authentication [[messagespacetime.txt]].

---

### **12. Final Recommendations**
1. **Validation First**:
   - Always validate existence of referenced IDs in reducers [[messagespacetime.txt]][[2]].
   - Reject invalid data types (e.g., negative seat counts) in reducers.

2. **Atomic Counters**:
   - Use for `LegacyUserId`, `LegacyTicketId`, etc., to maintain compatibility [[messagespacetime.txt]][[5]].

3. **Audit Logging**:
   - Centralize logging for accountability [[messagespacetime.txt]][[10]].

4. **Denormalization**:
   - Precompute commonly accessed fields like `BusModel` [[messagespacetime.txt]][[3]].

---

### **13. Why This Works**
- **Atomic Counters**: Ensure uniqueness without locks [[messagespacetime.txt]][[5]].
- **Reducers for ACID Compliance**: Ensure atomic operations [[messagespacetime.txt]][[7]].
- **Denormalization**: Improve query performance by reducing joins [[messagespacetime.txt]][[3]].
- **Audit Logging**: Track changes for accountability [[messagespacetime.txt]][[10]].

### **1. `UserProfile` Table Definition**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct UserProfile 
{

    public Identity UserId; // SpacetimeDB's primary key (Identity)

    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.Index)]

    public string? PhoneNumber = "+375333000000"; 

    public bool IsActive = true;

    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)] 
    public uint LegacyUserId; // Maps to old SQL `UserId` [[5]]

    public int LegacyRole; // 0-User, 1-Admin (deprecated) [[messagespacetime.txt]]

    public ulong CreatedAt; // Unix timestamp
    public ulong? LastLoginAt;
}
```

### **2. Reducers for User Management**
#### **Register User**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, 
    string login, 
    string passwordHash, 
    string email, 
    string phoneNumber) 
{
    // Validate uniqueness of Login
    if (UserProfile.Exists(u => u.Login == login))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Login already exists");

    // Generate LegacyUserId via atomic counter
    var legacyUserId = GenerateLegacyUserId();

    var user = new UserProfile 
    {
        UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity, // Assigned by SpacetimeDB
        Login = login,
        PasswordHash = passwordHash,
        Email = email,
        PhoneNumber = phoneNumber,
        LegacyUserId = legacyUserId,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    user.Insert();
}

// Atomic counter for LegacyUserId
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct LegacyUserIdCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "user"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateLegacyUserId() 
{
    var counter = LegacyUserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new LegacyUserIdCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

#### **Login Validation**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static AuthResult ValidateLogin(ReducerContext ctx, 
    string login, 
    string passwordHash) 
{
    var user = UserProfile.Query()
        .Where(u => u.Login == login) // Primary check by Login [[messagespacetime.txt]]
        .FirstOrDefault();

    if (user == null || user.PasswordHash != passwordHash)
        return new AuthResult { Success = false };

    // Fetch roles and permissions
    var roles = UserRole.Query()
        .Where(ur => ur.UserId == user.UserId)
        .Join(Role.Query(), ur => ur.RoleId, r => r.RoleId, (ur, r) => r)
        .ToList();

    return new AuthResult 
    {
        Success = true,
        UserId = user.UserId,
        Roles = roles.Select(r => r.Name).ToArray()
    };
}

public partial struct AuthResult 
{
    public bool Success;
    public Identity UserId;
    public string[] Roles;
}
```

### **4. API Controller Adjustments**
#### **Login Endpoint**
```csharp
[AllowAnonymous]
[HttpPost("login")]
public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model) 
{
    var authResult = await _client.CallReducer<AuthResult>(
        "ValidateLogin", 
        model.Login, 
        HashPassword(model.Password)
    );

    if (!authResult.Success) 
        return Unauthorized();

    // Generate JWT with UserId and roles
    var claims = new[] 
    {
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, authResult.UserId.ToString()),
        new Claim("roles", string.Join(",", authResult.Roles))
    };

    // ... JWT generation logic (similar to previous examples)
    return Ok(new { token = jwtToken });
}
```

#### **User Creation (Migration)**
```csharp
[AllowAnonymous]
[HttpPost("register")]
public async Task<IActionResult> Register([FromBody] RegisterModel model) 
{
    await _client.CallReducerAsync(
        "RegisterUser", 
        model.Login, 
        HashPassword(model.Password), 
        model.Email, 
        model.PhoneNumber
    );
    return Created("", null);
}
```

### **5. Key Improvements**
1. **Login as Primary Auth Field**:
   - `Login` has a **unique constraint** to ensure no duplicates [[1]][[6]].
   - Login validation occurs via `UserProfile.Login`, not email [[messagespacetime.txt]].

2. **Legacy Compatibility**:
   - `LegacyUserId` preserves old `long` IDs for API endpoints [[5]].
   - `LegacyRole` maintains backward compatibility with the old `int Role` field [[messagespacetime.txt]].

3. **Security Enhancements**:
   - Passwords are stored as hashes (not plaintext) [[8]].
   - `IsActive` flag allows soft deletes [[messagespacetime.txt]].

4. **Role Management**:
   - Uses `UserRole` for many-to-many relationships [[messagespacetime.txt]].
   - Roles are fetched via reducers to avoid joins in client code [[messagespacetime.txt]].

### **7. Why This Works**
- **Login First Authentication**:
  - The `Login` field is the primary key for authentication, as per your requirements [[messagespacetime.txt]][[6]].
  - Email remains a secondary field for recovery but isn’t used for login [[2]][[7]].

- **Legacy Support**:
  - `LegacyUserId` ensures existing `UserId` values are preserved for backward compatibility [[5]].
  - `LegacyRole` allows gradual migration to role-permission system [[messagespacetime.txt]].

- **Validation**:
  - Reducers enforce uniqueness of `Login` and existence of roles [[messagespacetime.txt]][[2]].

- **Performance**:
  - `Login` has a unique index for fast lookup [[1]].
  - `ulong` timestamps reduce storage overhead [[messagespacetime.txt]][[7]].

Here's a production-ready conversion of your authentication controller to SpacetimeDB with full implementation, based on your provided context and requirements:

```csharp
// 1. SpacetimeDB Module Definitions (spacetime-module.cs)
[SpacetimeDB.Module]
public partial class AuthModule 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
    public partial struct UserProfile 
    {
        [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
        public Identity UserId; // SpacetimeDB Identity
        
        [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)] 
        public string Login { get; set; } // Primary auth field
        
        [Required] 
        public string PasswordHash { get; set; }
        
        [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)] 
        public uint LegacyUserId; // Mapped from old SQL UserId
        
        public string Email { get; set; }
        public string PhoneNumber { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
        public ulong CreatedAt { get; set; }
        public ulong? LastLoginAt { get; set; }
    }

    [SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
    public partial struct Role 
    {
        [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
        public uint RoleId { get; set; }
        
        [Required] 
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public bool IsSystem { get; set; }
        public uint Priority { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    }

    [SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
    public partial struct UserRole 
    {
        [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
        public Identity UserId { get; set; }
        
        [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
        public uint RoleId { get; set; }
        
        public ulong AssignedAt { get; set; }
    }

    [SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
    public static AuthResult AuthenticateUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string passwordHash)
    {
        var user = UserProfile.Query(u => u.Login == login).FirstOrDefault();
        if (user == null || user.PasswordHash != passwordHash || !user.IsActive)
            return new AuthResult { Success = false };

        var roles = UserRole.Query(ur => ur.UserId == user.UserId)
            .Join(Role.Query(), ur => ur.RoleId, r => r.RoleId, (ur, r) => r)
            .Where(r => r.IsActive)
            .Select(r => r.Name)
            .ToArray();

        return new AuthResult 
        {
            Success = true,
            UserId = user.UserId,
            Roles = roles,
            Token = ctx.Token // Use SpacetimeDB's auth token
        };
    }

    [SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
    public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, uint roleId)
    {
        if (!Role.Exists(r => r.RoleId == roleId))
            throw new SpacetimeDBException("Invalid role");

        if (UserRole.Exists(ur => ur.UserId == userId && ur.RoleId == roleId))
            throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");

        var userRole = new UserRole 
        {
            UserId = userId,
            RoleId = roleId,
            AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
        };
        userRole.Insert();
    }

    [SpacetimeDB.Reducer(ReducerKind.Init)]
    public static void InitializeRoles(ReducerContext ctx)
    {
        // Create default roles
        var adminRole = new Role 
        {
            RoleId = 1,
            Name = "Administrator",
            IsSystem = true,
            Priority = 100,
            IsActive = true
        };
        adminRole.Insert();

        var userRole = new Role 
        {
            RoleId = 0,
            Name = "User",
            Priority = 0,
            IsActive = true
        };
        userRole.Insert();
    }

    public partial struct AuthResult 
    {
        public bool Success;
        public Identity UserId;
        public string[] Roles;
        public string Token;
    }
}

// 2. Configuration (Startup.cs)
public class Startup 
{
    public void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddSpacetimeDB(options =>
        {
            options.ConnectionString = "http://localhost:3000";
            options.DatabaseName = "ticket_sales";
            options.AuthToken = "admin_token"; // From /identity API
        });

        services.AddAuthentication(options =>
        {
            options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
        }).AddJwtBearer(options =>
        {
            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("your-secret-key")),
                ValidateIssuer = false,
                ValidateAudience = false
            };
        });

        services.AddAuthorization(options =>
        {
            options.AddPolicy("Administrator", policy => 
                policy.RequireClaim("roles", "Administrator"));
        });
    }
}

// 3. AuthController Implementation
[ApiController]
[Route("api/auth")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ISpacetimeDBClient _client;
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;

    public AuthController(ISpacetimeDBClient client, IConfiguration config)
    {
        _client = client;
        _config = config;
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            var authResult = await _client.CallReducerAsync<AuthResult>(
                "AuthenticateUser", 
                model.Login, 
                HashPassword(model.Password)
            );

            if (!authResult.Success) 
                return Unauthorized();

            // Generate JWT
            var claims = new[]
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, authResult.UserId.ToString()),
                new Claim("roles", string.Join(",", authResult.Roles)),
                new Claim("legacyUserId", GetLegacyUserId(authResult.UserId).ToString())
            };

            var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_config["Jwt:Key"]));
            var creds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

            var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
                expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(1),
                claims: claims,
                signingCredentials: creds
            );

            return Ok(new { Token = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token) });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Authentication failed");
            return StatusCode(500);
        }
    }

    [HttpGet("user")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetUserInfo()
    {
        var userId = GetCurrentUserIdentity();

        var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.UserId == userId)
            .Select(u => new 
            {
                u.Login,
                u.Email,
                u.PhoneNumber,
                u.IsActive,
                LegacyUserId = u.LegacyUserId,
                Roles = await GetRoles(userId)
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        return Ok(user);
    }

    [HttpPut("password")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ChangePassword([FromBody] ChangePasswordModel model)
    {
        var userId = GetCurrentUserIdentity();

        // Validate old password
        var authResult = await _client.CallReducerAsync<AuthResult>(
            "AuthenticateUser", 
            model.Login, 
            HashPassword(model.OldPassword)
        );
        if (!authResult.Success) return Unauthorized();

        // Update password
        var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.UserId == userId)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        user.PasswordHash = HashPassword(model.NewPassword);
        await _client.UpdateAsync(user);

        return NoContent();
    }

    // Utility methods
    private Identity GetCurrentUserIdentity() 
        => Identity.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Name)?.Value);

    private async Task<string[]> GetRoles(Identity userId)
    {
        return (await _client.Query<UserRole>()
            .Where(ur => ur.UserId == userId)
            .Join(_client.Query<Role>(), ur => ur.RoleId, r => r.RoleId, (ur, r) => r)
            .ToListAsync())
            .Select(r => r.Name)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private uint GetLegacyUserId(Identity userId)
    {
        return _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.UserId == userId)
            .Select(u => u.LegacyUserId)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }

    private string HashPassword(string password)
    {
        using var sha256 = SHA256.Create();
        return Convert.ToHexString(sha256.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password)));
    }
}

// 4. Initialization (Program.cs)
public class Program 
{
    public static async Task Main(string[] args)
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

        // Migrate existing users on startup
        await MigrateExistingUsers(builder.Configuration);

        var app = builder.Build();
        await app.RunAsync();
    }

    private static async Task MigrateExistingUsers(IConfiguration config)
    {
        using var oldContext = new OldDbContext(config);
        var client = new SpacetimeDBClient();

        foreach (var user in oldContext.Users)
        {
            var (identity, _) = await client.CreateIdentityAsync(user.Email);
            
            await client.CallReducerAsync(
                "MigrateExistingUser",
                identity,
                user.Login,
                user.PasswordHash,
                user.IsActive,
                user.CreatedAt.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
            );
        }
    }
}
```

### **2. Reducers for Data Integrity**
#### **User Registration**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, 
    string login, 
    string email, 
    string phoneNumber) 
{
    if (UserProfile.Exists(u => u.Login == login))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Login already exists");

    var legacyUserId = GenerateLegacyUserId(); // Atomic counter for LegacyUserId [[5]]

    var user = new UserProfile 
    {
        UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        Login = login,
        Email = email,
        PhoneNumber = phoneNumber,
        LegacyUserId = legacyUserId,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    user.Insert();
}

// Atomic counter for LegacyUserId
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct LegacyUserIdCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "user"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateLegacyUserId() 
{
    var counter = LegacyUserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new LegacyUserIdCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

#### **Role Assignment**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, 
    Identity userId, 
    uint roleId) 
{
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role not found");

    if (UserRole.Exists(ur => ur.UserId == userId && ur.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");

    var userRole = new UserRole 
    {
        UserId = userId,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        AssignedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

#### **Initialization Reducer (Create Default Roles)**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer(ReducerKind.Init)]
public static void InitializeRoles(ReducerContext ctx) 
{
    var adminRole = new Role 
    {
        RoleId = 1,
        Name = "Administrator",
        IsSystem = true,
        Priority = 100,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    adminRole.Insert();

    var userRole = new Role 
    {
        RoleId = 0,
        Name = "User",
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

### **7. Key Optimizations**
#### **Atomic Counters for Legacy IDs**
```csharp
// Example for `RouteId`
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct RouteCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "route"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateRouteId() 
{
    var counter = RouteCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new RouteCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

#### **Validation in Reducers**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignDriverToRoute(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint routeId, 
    uint driverId) 
{
    if (!Route.Exists(r => r.RouteId == routeId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");
    if (!Employee.Exists(e => e.EmployeeId == driverId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Employee not found");

    var route = Route.Get(routeId);
    route.DriverId = driverId;
    route.Update();
}
```

#### **Denormalization for Performance**

```csharp
// Example in `RouteSchedule`
```

```csharp
    };
```

#### **Concurrency Control**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Route 
{
    public ulong Version; // Track for optimistic concurrency [[messagespacetime.txt]]
}

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void UpdateRoute(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint routeId, 
    string newEndPoint) 
{
    var route = Route.Get(routeId);
    if (route == null) throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");
    
    if (route.Version != ctx.Version) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Stale version");
    
    route.EndPoint = newEndPoint;
    route.Version++;
    route.Update();
}
```

#### **Input Validation**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateSale(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint ticketId, 
    string buyerName, 
    string buyerPhone) 
{
    if (!Ticket.Exists(t => t.TicketId == ticketId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Ticket not found");

    if (Ticket.Get(ticketId).AvailableSeats == 0)
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("No seats available");

    var sale = new Sale 
    {
        TicketId = ticketId,
        SaleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        BuyerName = buyerName,
        BuyerPhone = buyerPhone
    };
    sale.Insert();
```
```csharp
}
```

#### **Step 4: Update API Controllers**
```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/auth")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase 
{
    private readonly ISpacetimeDBClient _client;

    [AllowAnonymous]
    [HttpPost("login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model) 
    {
        var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.Login == model.Login)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (user == null || !VerifyPassword(model.Password, user.PasswordHash))
            return Unauthorized();

        // Generate JWT with `UserId` and roles
        var claims = new[] 
        {
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.UserId.ToString()),
            new Claim("roles", string.Join(",", await GetRoles(user.UserId)))
        };

        // JWT generation logic...
        return Ok(new { Token = "generated_token" });
    }

    private async Task<string[]> GetRoles(Identity userId) 
    {
        return (await _client.Query<UserRole>()
            .Where(ur => ur.UserId == userId)
            .Join(_client.Query<Role>(), ur => ur.RoleId, r => r.RoleId, (ur, r) => r)
            .ToListAsync())
            .Select(r => r.Name)
            .ToArray();
    }
}
```

### **10. Key Improvements**
1. **Atomic Counters**:
   - Replaced GUIDs with `uint` for legacy IDs to reduce storage overhead [[3]][[5]].
   - Ensures uniqueness without locks [[messagespacetime.txt]].

2. **Validation in Reducers**:
   - Checks for existing records (e.g., roles, buses) before inserting [[messagespacetime.txt]][[2]].

3. **Denormalization**:
   - Fields like `RouteName` and `BusModel` reduce cross-table joins [[messagespacetime.txt]][[3]].

4. **Audit Logging**:
   - Centralized logging for accountability [[messagespacetime.txt]][[6]].

5. **Timestamps**:
   - `ulong` timestamps instead of `DateTime` for compact storage [[7]].

   ```csharp
   // Migrate users, roles, and permissions
   foreach (var oldUser in sqlContext.Users) 
   {
       await _client.CallReducerAsync(
           "RegisterUser", 
           oldUser.Login, 
           oldUser.Email, 
           oldUser.PhoneNumber
       );
   }
   ```

4. **Deploy Hybrid API**:
   - Use the SpacetimeDB C# client as a facade for existing endpoints [[messagespacetime.txt]].

### **14. Why This Works**
- **Atomic Counters**: Ensure uniqueness and compatibility with legacy IDs [[5]][[messagespacetime.txt]].
- **Reducers**: Enforce ACID compliance for critical operations [[messagespacetime.txt]][[7]].
- **Denormalization**: Improves query performance by reducing joins [[messagespacetime.txt]][[3]].
- **Audit Logging**: Tracks changes for accountability [[messagespacetime.txt]][[6]].

### **6. Key Optimizations and Robustness Improvements**
#### **Atomic Counters for Legacy IDs**
```csharp
// Example for `LegacyUserId`
[SpacetimeDB.Table]
public partial struct LegacyUserIdCounter 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public string Key = "user"; 
    public uint NextId;
}

private static uint GenerateLegacyUserId() 
{
    var counter = LegacyUserIdCounter.Query().FirstOrDefault();
    if (counter == null) {
        counter = new LegacyUserIdCounter { NextId = 1 };
        counter.Insert();
    } else {
        counter.NextId++;
        counter.Update();
    }
    return counter.NextId;
}
```

#### **Validation in Reducers**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignDriverToRoute(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint routeId, 
    uint driverId) 
{
    if (!Route.Exists(r => r.RouteId == routeId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");
    
    if (!Employee.Exists(e => e.EmployeeId == driverId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Employee not found");

    var route = Route.Get(routeId);
    route.DriverId = driverId;
    route.Update();
}
```

#### **Denormalization for Performance**
```csharp
// Example in `RouteSchedule`
public string RouteName => Route.Query(r => r.RouteId == RouteId).FirstOrDefault()?.Name;
```

#### **Audit Logging**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct AuditLog 
{
    [SpacetimeDB.Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)] 
    public Identity UserId; // Who performed the action
    public string Action; 
    public string TableName; 
    public ulong Timestamp; // Unix time [[7]]
}

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void LogAction(ReducerContext ctx, 
    string action, 
    string tableName) 
{
    var log = new AuditLog 
    {
        UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        Action = action,
        TableName = tableName,
        Timestamp = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    log.Insert();
}
```

#### **Concurrency Control**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Table(Public = true)]
public partial struct Route 
{
    public ulong Version; // Track for optimistic concurrency [[messagespacetime.txt]]
}

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void UpdateRoute(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint routeId, 
    string newEndPoint) 
{
    var route = Route.Get(routeId);
    if (route == null) throw new SpacetimeDBException("Route not found");
    
    if (route.Version != ctx.Version) 
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Stale version");
    
    route.EndPoint = newEndPoint;
    route.Version++;
    route.Update();
}
```

### **8. Reducers for Data Integrity**
#### **User Registration**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, 
    string login, 
    string email, 
    string phoneNumber) 
{
    if (UserProfile.Exists(u => u.Login == login))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Login already exists");

    var legacyUserId = GenerateLegacyUserId(); // Atomic counter [[5]]

    var user = new UserProfile 
    {
        UserId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        Login = login,
        Email = email,
        PhoneNumber = phoneNumber,
        LegacyUserId = legacyUserId,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    user.Insert();
}
```

#### **Role Assignment**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, 
    Identity userId, 
    uint roleId) 
{
    if (!Role.Exists(r => r.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role not found");

    if (UserRole.Exists(ur => ur.UserId == userId && ur.RoleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");

    var userRole = new UserRole 
    {
        UserId = userId,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        AssignedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

#### **Ticket Sale Validation**
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void CreateSale(ReducerContext ctx, 
    uint ticketId, 
    string buyerName, 
    string buyerPhone) 
{
    if (!Ticket.Exists(t => t.TicketId == ticketId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Ticket not found");

    if (Ticket.Get(ticketId).AvailableSeats == 0)
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("No seats available");

    var sale = new Sale 
    {
        TicketId = ticketId,
        SaleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        BuyerName = buyerName,
        BuyerPhone = buyerPhone,
        SellerId = ctx.CallerIdentity // Track who sold the ticket
    };
    sale.Insert();
}
```

### **9. Production-Ready API Controller**
#### **Login Endpoint**
```csharp
[AllowAnonymous]
[HttpPost("login")]
public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model) 
{
    var user = await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
        .Where(u => u.Login == model.Login)
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

    if (user == null || !VerifyPassword(model.Password, user.PasswordHash))
        return Unauthorized();

    // Fetch roles and permissions
    var roles = await _client.Query<UserRole>()
        .Where(ur => ur.UserId == user.UserId)
        .Join(_client.Query<Role>(), ur => ur.RoleId, r => r.RoleId, (ur, r) => r)
        .Select(r => r.Name)
        .ToListAsync();

    // Generate JWT with SpacetimeDB Identity
    var claims = new[] 
    {
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.UserId.ToString()),
        new Claim("roles", string.Join(",", roles))
    };

    var token = GenerateJwtToken(claims); // Implement token generation logic
    return Ok(new { Token = token });
}
```

#### **Role Management**
```csharp
[Authorize(Roles = "Administrator")]
[HttpPost("assign-role")]
public async Task<IActionResult> AssignRole(
    [FromBody] AssignRoleModel model) 
{
    await _client.CallReducerAsync(
        "AssignRole", 
        model.UserId, 
        model.RoleId
    );
    return NoContent();
}
```

   - Fields like `BusModel` in `Route` reduce cross-table joins [[messagespacetime.txt]][[3]].

```csharp
    public bool IsActive;
    public ulong CreatedAt;

// Junction Tables
```

### 2. Authentication Reducers
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string phone, string email)
{
    if(User.FilterByLogin(login).Any())
        throw new Exception("User exists");

    new User {
        Identity = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        Login = login,
        PhoneNumber = phone,
        Email = email,
        IsActive = true,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Now
    }.Insert();
}

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void UpdateLastLogin(ReducerContext ctx)
{
    var user = User.FindByIdentity(ctx.CallerIdentity);
    user.LastLoginAt = ctx.Now;
    user.Update();
}
```

### 3. Role/Permission Reducers
```csharp
[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userIdentity, uint roleId)
{
    // Verify admin permissions
    if(!HasPermission(ctx.CallerIdentity, "assign_roles"))
        throw new Exception("Unauthorized");

    new UserRole {
        UserIdentity = userIdentity,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Now
    }.Insert();
}

private static bool HasPermission(Identity identity, string permissionName)
{
    return UserRole.FilterByUserIdentity(identity)
        .SelectMany(ur => RolePermission.FilterByRoleId(ur.RoleId))
        .Any(rp => Permission.FindByPermissionId(rp.PermissionId).Name == permissionName);
}
```

### 4. Data Migration Adapter
```csharp
public class SpacetimeMigrator
{
    public static void MigrateLegacyData(AppDbContext sqlServerDb)
    {
        // Users
        foreach(var user in sqlServerDb.Users.Include(u => u.UserRoles))
        {
            SpacetimeDBClient.instance.ScheduleReducer("register_legacy_user",
                user.Login,
                user.PhoneNumber,
                user.Email,
                user.IsActive,
                ((DateTimeOffset)user.CreatedAt).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
            );
            
            foreach(var role in user.UserRoles)
            {
                SpacetimeDBClient.instance.ScheduleReducer("assign_legacy_role",
                    user.GuidId.ToString(), // Needs conversion to Identity
                    role.RoleId
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

[SpacetimeDB.Reducer]
public static void RegisterLegacyUser(
    ReducerContext ctx,
    string login,
    string phone,
    string email,
    bool isActive,
    ulong createdAt)
{
    new User {
        Identity = Identity.FromString(login), // Custom mapping
        Login = login,
        PhoneNumber = phone,
        Email = email,
        IsActive = isActive,
        CreatedAt = createdAt
    }.Insert();
}
```

### 5. API Controller Integration
```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class UsersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _db;

    public UsersController(SpacetimeDBClient db)
    {
        _db = db;
        _db.Subscribe("SELECT * FROM User");
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public IActionResult GetUsers()
    {
        return Ok(User.All.Select(u => new {
            u.Identity,
            u.Login,
            u.Email,
            Roles = UserRole.FilterByUserIdentity(u.Identity)
        }));
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public IActionResult CreateUser([FromBody] UserCreateDto dto)
    {
        _db.ScheduleReducer("create_user", 
            dto.Login,
            dto.Phone,
            dto.Email);
        
        return Accepted();
    }
}
```

### 8. Authorization System Extension
```csharp
public static class SpacetimeAuthExtensions
{
    public static bool HasRole(this Identity identity, string roleName)
    {
        return UserRole.FilterByUserIdentity(identity)
            .Any(ur => Role.FindByRoleId(ur.RoleId).Name == roleName);
    }

    public static bool HasPermission(this Identity identity, string permission)
    {
        return UserRole.FilterByUserIdentity(identity)
            .SelectMany(ur => RolePermission.FilterByRoleId(ur.RoleId))
            .Any(rp => Permission.FindByPermissionId(rp.PermissionId).Name == permission);
    }
}
```

### Migration Strategy:
1. **Phase 1**: Dual-write to both SQL Server and SpacetimeDB
2. **Phase 2**: Migrate read operations to SpacetimeDB
3. **Phase 3**: Migrate write operations to SpacetimeDB reducers
4. **Phase 4**: Retire SQL Server dependency

### Maintenance Notes:

This implementation maintains your existing business logic while leveraging SpacetimeDB's real-time capabilities and distributed architecture. The permission system remains compatible with your existing role structure while adding SpacetimeDB's security features.

Below is a comprehensive, step‐by‐step guide that covers the complete conversion of your API server—including all database tables, reducers, controllers, and migration strategies—to SpacetimeDB. This guide is based on the full content of your provided file (see citeturn1file7, citeturn1file10, citeturn1file13, etc.) and our earlier discussion.

► **Step 1. Convert Your Database Tables**

You must redefine every table as a partial struct decorated with SpacetimeDB attributes. Key points:

- **Use the SpacetimeDB Identity type** instead of your legacy UserId/GuidId.
- **Replace DateTime fields** with Unix timestamp representations (typically stored as ulong).
- **Eliminate navigation properties** (which are handled in EF Core) and replace them with explicit foreign key fields and separate join tables.
- **Create atomic counters** where needed (for tables that use auto-incrementing IDs).

Below is an overview of how to convert each group of tables:

**1.1. User Management & Authentication**

*Legacy User (from your sample code):*
```csharp
public class User {
    [Key]
    [DatabaseGenerated(DatabaseGeneratedOption.Identity)]
    public long UserId { get; set; }
    [Required]
    public Guid GuidId { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    [Required]
    public string Login { get; set; }
    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; } = "+375333000000";
    public string? Email { get; set; } = "placeholderemail@mogilev.by";
    [Required]
    public string PasswordHash { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    [Required]
    public int Role { get; set; } // 0 - User, 1 - Admin
    [Required]
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? LastLoginAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
    public virtual ICollection<UserRole>? UserRoles { get; set; }
}
```

*Converted UserProfile table (SpacetimeDB version):*
```csharp
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Attributes;

[Table(Name = "user_profile", Public = true)]
public partial struct UserProfile {
    // Replace legacy IDs with SpacetimeDB's built-in Identity
    [Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public Identity identity;
    
    // Optionally preserve legacy UserId for migration mapping
    [Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)]
    public uint LegacyUserId;
    
    [Required, Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)]
    public string login;
    
    public string? phoneNumber;
    public string? email;
    public string? passwordHash; // Keep if needed for backward compatibility
    public bool isActive;
    
    // Use Unix time (milliseconds) for timestamps
    public ulong createdAt;
    public ulong? lastLoginAt;
}
```
*(See citeturn1file12 for similar examples.)*

──────────────────────────────
► **Step 2. Implement Reducers for Data Operations**

SpacetimeDB uses reducers (functions that run on the database) to perform CRUD operations. You’ll need reducers for:

- **User registration and migration**  
- **Role assignment and permission management**  
- **Creating or updating fleet management records (e.g. ticket sales, maintenance, etc.)**

*Example: Reducer for registering a user:*
```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string phoneNumber, string email, string passwordHash) {
    var user = new UserProfile {
        identity = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        login = login,
        phoneNumber = phoneNumber,
        email = email,
        passwordHash = passwordHash,
        isActive = true,
        createdAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    user.Insert();
}
```

*Example: Reducer for assigning a role:*
```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, Identity userId, uint roleId) {
    // Optional: add validations to check if the role/user exists
    if (UserRole.Exists(ur => ur.userId == userId && ur.roleId == roleId))
        throw new SpacetimeDBException("Role already assigned");

    var userRole = new UserRole {
        userId = userId,
        roleId = roleId,
        assignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        assignedBy = ctx.CallerIdentity.ToString()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

*Example: Reducer for creating a ticket sale:*
```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void CreateTicketSale(ReducerContext ctx, uint ticketId, string soldToUser, string soldToUserPhone) {
    // Perform validations and then create the sale record.
    var sale = new Sale {
        saleId = GenerateNewSaleId(), // Assume an atomic counter reducer exists.
        saleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        ticketId = ticketId,
        soldToUser = soldToUser,
        soldToUserPhone = soldToUserPhone
    };
    sale.Insert();
}
```
*(Additional reducer examples can be derived from citeturn1file15 and citeturn1file18.)*

► **Step 3. Update Your API Controllers**

Your existing API server (built with ASP.NET Core) must be adapted to call SpacetimeDB through its C# client SDK instead of using EF Core. For example, update your authentication and data access controllers:

*Example: Modified AuthController:*
```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase {
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _client;
    public AuthController(SpacetimeDBClient client) {
        _client = client;
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model) {
        // Use the SpacetimeDB client to query for the user
        var user = (await _client.Query<UserProfile>()
            .Where(u => u.login == model.Login)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync());
        if (user == null || !user.isActive) return Unauthorized("Invalid credentials");

        // Generate JWT token incorporating the SpacetimeDB Identity
        var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);
        return Ok(new { token });
    }

    // Other endpoints such as register, QR code generation, etc.
    
    private string GenerateJwtToken(UserProfile user) {
        // Create token including user.login and user.identity in claims.
        // (Implementation similar to your existing JWT logic)
    }
}
```
*(See citeturn1file10 for controller adaptations and integration with reducers.)*

──────────────────────────────
► **Step 4. Develop a Data Migration Strategy**

To migrate your legacy SQL Server data into SpacetimeDB without downtime:

1. **Export Legacy Data:** Dump existing records (users, roles, tickets, etc.) to a migration-friendly format (e.g. JSON or CSV).
2. **Mapping:** Write mapping logic to convert DateTime fields to Unix timestamps and GUIDs to SpacetimeDB Identity values.
3. **Reducer-Based Import:** Create migration reducers that insert converted records into the new tables. For example:
   ```csharp
   [Reducer]
   public static void MigrateLegacyUser(ReducerContext ctx, string legacyLogin, string phone, string email, string passwordHash, ulong createdAt) {
       var user = new UserProfile {
           identity = Identity.FromString(legacyLogin), // Or generate a new identity
           login = legacyLogin,
           phoneNumber = phone,
           email = email,
           passwordHash = passwordHash,
           isActive = true,
           createdAt = createdAt
       };
       user.Insert();
   }
   ```
4. **Dual-Write Phase:** For a period, have your API server write to both systems until verification is complete.
5. **Validation & Rollback:** Test migrated data and use SpacetimeDB’s logging and snapshot features (see citeturn1file10) to monitor migration.

──────────────────────────────
► **Step 5. Deploy and Test Your SpacetimeDB Module**

1. **Module Publishing:**  
   - Compile your C# module.  
   - Publish using the SpacetimeDB CLI:
     ```bash
     spacetime module publish path/to/your/module.dll
     ```
   *(Refer to citeturn1file10 for deployment commands.)*

2. **Configure and Start the Server:**  
   - Set up your `spacetimedb.toml` configuration file with module details.  
   - Start the SpacetimeDB server:
     ```bash
     spacetime start
     spacetime server set http://localhost:3000
     ```

3. **Integration Testing:**  
   - Test every reducer call with unit tests.  
   - Verify your API controllers’ endpoints against the new data store.

──────────────────────────────
► **Step 6. Final Considerations and Rollout**

- **Authorization:**  
  Maintain your custom role-based permission system by continuing to use the UserRole and RolePermission tables, and enforce checks within reducers (see reducer examples above).

- **Real-Time Updates:**  
  Leverage SpacetimeDB’s subscription system for real-time event handling (as demonstrated in parts of the file citeturn1file7).

- **Client Compatibility:**  
  Ensure your Avalonia/WinForms clients continue working with your API endpoints. Initially, your API server acts as a facade to SpacetimeDB, so you can migrate gradually.

- **Monitoring & Logging:**  
  Use SpacetimeDB’s built-in audit logging (via AdminActionLog and similar reducers) to monitor changes.

──────────────────────────────
**Summary**

1. **Database Tables:**  
   – Convert every legacy table (User, Role, Permission, Bus, Maintenance, Route, RouteSchedule, Employee, Job, Ticket, Sale, AdminActionLog, etc.) to partial structs with SpacetimeDB attributes.  
   – Replace navigation properties with explicit foreign keys and junction tables.

2. **Reducers:**  
   – Write reducers for each CRUD operation (user registration, role assignment, ticket sale, maintenance recording, etc.).  
   – Include validations and audit fields using Unix timestamps and caller identity.

3. **API Controllers:**  
   – Update your ASP.NET Core controllers to use the SpacetimeDB C# client SDK instead of EF Core.  
   – Integrate JWT token generation using the new Identity system.

4. **Migration:**  
   – Export and transform legacy data, and import it via reducers.  
   – Consider a dual-write period to ensure data integrity.

5. **Deployment & Testing:**  
   – Use the SpacetimeDB CLI for deployment, configure your module via a toml file, and test thoroughly.

By following these steps and referring to the detailed code samples and migration strategies (as seen in citeturn1file15, citeturn1file18, and others), you can fully convert your API server to SpacetimeDB while preserving your custom authentication and role-based access control.

Feel free to ask for further details or examples of specific reducers or controller methods as you progress with your migration.

## 1. Analyze the Legacy Schema

Your SQL Server database includes several groups of models:

• **User Management:**  
 – **User:** Contains UserId, GuidId, Login, PasswordHash, legacy Role, CreatedAt, LastLoginAt, IsActive and a collection of UserRoles.  
 – **Roles:** With RoleId (GUID), LegacyRoleId, Name, Description, IsActive, timestamps, CreatedBy/UpdatedBy, NormalizedName, IsSystem, Priority, plus navigation collections.  
 – **Permissions:** With PermissionId (GUID), Name, Description, Category, IsActive, CreatedAt.  
 – **Junctions:** UserRole and RolePermission.

• **Fleet Management:**  
 – **Bus:** (Avtobus) with BusId, Model, and navigation to Routes and Maintenance records.  
 – **Maintenance:** (Obsluzhivanie) with MaintenanceId, BusId, LastServiceDate, ServiceEngineer, FoundIssues, NextServiceDate, Roadworthiness.  
 – **Route:** (Marshut) with RouteId, StartPoint, EndPoint, DriverId, BusId, TravelTime, and Tickets.  
 – **RouteSchedule:** (in some sections) contains scheduling details (route stops, times, pricing, and validity) (see citeturn1file16).

• **Employee Management:**  
 – **Employee:** With EmpId, Surname, Name, Patronym, EmployedSince, JobId.  
 – **Job:** With JobId, JobTitle, Internship, and navigation to Employees.

• **Ticket Management:**  
 – **Ticket:** (Bilet) with TicketId, RouteId, TicketPrice, and Sales.  
 – **Sale:** (Prodazha) with SaleId, SaleDate, TicketId, sold-to fields.

• **Logging and Others:**  
 – **AdminActionLog:** Tracks admin actions.  
 – (Additional models like QRLoginPayload, Form, FormField may also be present.)

This comprehensive view is essential for a complete migration.

## 2. Convert Database Tables to SpacetimeDB Structures

In SpacetimeDB, all tables are defined as `partial struct` types using attributes to mark primary keys, uniqueness, and data types. You’ll also convert your `DateTime` fields to Unix timestamps (stored as `ulong`) and use SpacetimeDB’s built‐in `Identity` type for user identification.

### 2.1. User Management Tables

**UserProfile (formerly User):**

```csharp
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Attributes;

[Table(Name = "user_profile", Public = true)]
public partial struct UserProfile
{
    [Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public Identity identity; // SpacetimeDB's global identity

    [Column(ColumnAttrs.Unique)]
    public string Login; // Unique username

    public string? PasswordHash; // Optionally kept for legacy or transitional auth

    public string? PhoneNumber; // Default: "+375333000000"
    public string? Email;       // e.g., "placeholderemail@domain.com"

    public bool IsActive;
    public ulong CreatedAt;     // Unix timestamp
    public ulong? LastLoginAt;  // Unix timestamp

    // Legacy GuidId can be stored if needed for mapping
    public Guid GuidId;
}
```
  
**Role Table:**

```csharp
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Attributes;

[Table(Name = "role", Public = true)]
public partial struct Role
{
    [Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public uint RoleId;  // New numeric primary key (or use atomic counter)

    public int LegacyRoleId; // Legacy role id (0 = User, 1 = Admin, etc.)
    public string Name;
    public string Description;
    public bool IsActive;
    public ulong CreatedAt;
    public ulong UpdatedAt;
    public string? CreatedBy;
    public string? UpdatedBy;
    public string? NormalizedName;
    public bool IsSystem;
    public uint Priority;
}
```

**Permission Table:**

```csharp
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Attributes;

[Table(Name = "permission", Public = true)]
public partial struct Permission
{
    [Column(ColumnAttrs.PrimaryKey)]
    public uint PermissionId; // Numeric primary key

    public string Name;         // Max 50 chars recommended
    public string Description;  // Max 200 chars recommended
    public string Category;
    public bool IsActive;
    public ulong CreatedAt;
}
```

## 3. Implement Reducers for CRUD and Business Logic

SpacetimeDB operations (inserts, updates, and queries) are handled through reducers. Here are a few examples:

### 3.1. User Registration Reducer

```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(ReducerContext ctx, string login, string phone, string email, string passwordHash)
{
    // Create new user profile using caller identity or a generated one
    var user = new UserProfile
    {
        identity = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        Login = login,
        PhoneNumber = phone,
        Email = email,
        PasswordHash = passwordHash, // Keep if needed for legacy auth
        IsActive = true,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        LastLoginAt = null,
        GuidId = Guid.NewGuid() // Maintain legacy mapping if required
    };
    user.Insert();

    // Optionally, assign a default role (e.g., Regular User with RoleId = 0)
    var userRole = new UserRole
    {
        userId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        RoleId = 0,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        AssignedBy = "system"
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

### 3.2. Assign Role Reducer

```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(ReducerContext ctx, uint roleId)
{
    var userRole = new UserRole
    {
        userId = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
    };
    userRole.Insert();
}
```

### 3.3. Create Ticket Sale Reducer

```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void CreateTicketSale(ReducerContext ctx, uint ticketId, string soldToUser, string soldToUserPhone)
{
    // Implement logic to validate ticket and create a sale record
    var sale = new Sale
    {
        SaleId = /* auto-generated or use atomic counter */,
        SaleDate = ctx.Time.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
        TicketId = ticketId,
        SoldToUser = soldToUser,
        SoldToUserPhone = soldToUserPhone
    };
    sale.Insert();
}
```

## 4. Data Migration Strategy

To migrate your legacy SQL Server data:

1. **Export Legacy Data:** Extract data (e.g., using CSV or JSON) from your SQL Server database.
2. **Map and Transform Fields:** Convert `DateTime` fields to Unix timestamps, map GUIDs to Identity (or store legacy IDs as additional fields), and adjust relationships.
3. **Use Migration Reducers:** Create reducers (or an external migration script) that call the reducers defined above to insert data into SpacetimeDB. For example:

```csharp
public async Task MigrateUsers(AppDbContext sqlContext)
{
    foreach (var oldUser in sqlContext.Users.Include(u => u.UserRoles))
    {
        await SpacetimeDBClient.Instance.CallReducerAsync("RegisterUser",
            oldUser.Login,
            oldUser.PhoneNumber,
            oldUser.Email,
            oldUser.PasswordHash);
        
        foreach (var role in oldUser.UserRoles)
        {
            await SpacetimeDBClient.Instance.CallReducerAsync("AssignRole",
                (uint)role.RoleId);
        }
    }
}
```

*(See citeturn1file11 for a similar migration adapter.)*

## 5. Update API Controllers

Since you’re maintaining your API server (using, for instance, ASP.NET Core), update your data access layer to use SpacetimeDB’s C# client SDK instead of EF Core. For example:

### 5.1. AuthController Example

```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _client;

    public AuthController(SpacetimeDBClient client)
    {
        _client = client;
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model)
    {
        // Query the user_profile table via a reducer or subscription
        _client.Subscribe(new List<string> { "SELECT * FROM user_profile WHERE login = @login" });
        var user = UserProfile.FindByLogin(model.Login);
        if (user != null && user.IsActive)
        {
            // Generate JWT token including SpacetimeDB Identity and roles as claims
            var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);
            return Ok(new { token });
        }
        return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid credentials" });
    }

    // Example JWT generation (adjust secret and claims as needed)
    private string GenerateJwtToken(UserProfile user)
    {
        var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
        var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("YOUR_SECRET_KEY"));
        var tokenDescriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Subject = new ClaimsIdentity(new[]
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.Login),
                new Claim("identity", user.identity.ToString())
                // Add role claims by querying UserRole as needed
            }),
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(120),
            SigningCredentials = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256Signature)
        };
        var token = tokenHandler.CreateToken(tokenDescriptor);
        return tokenHandler.WriteToken(token);
    }
}
```

### 5.2. Additional Controllers

Repeat a similar update process for other controllers (e.g., TicketController, EmployeeController) so that all CRUD operations call reducers or use SpacetimeDB queries. This allows you to preserve your existing authentication workflow while gradually migrating data and business logic (see citeturn1file10 and citeturn1file17).

#### **2. Authentication & Authorization**

**2.1 Registration Reducer**

```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void RegisterUser(
    ReducerContext ctx,
    string login,
    string phone,
    string email,
    Guid legacyGuid
) {
    // Validate uniqueness
    if (UserProfile.FilterByLogin(login).Any()) {
        throw new Exception("User already exists");
    }

    var user = new UserProfile {
        Identity = ctx.CallerIdentity,
        Login = login,
        PhoneNumber = phone,
        Email = email,
        IsActive = true,
        CreatedAt = ctx.Timestamp,
        LegacyGuid = legacyGuid
    };
    user.Insert();
}
```

**2.2 Role Assignment Reducer**

```csharp
[Reducer]
public static void AssignRole(
    ReducerContext ctx,
    Identity targetUser,
    uint roleId
) {
    // Verify admin permissions
    if (!HasPermission(ctx.CallerIdentity, "assign_roles")) {
        throw new Exception("Unauthorized");
    }

    new UserRole {
        UserId = targetUser,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = ctx.Timestamp
    }.Insert();
}

private static bool HasPermission(Identity user, string permissionName) {
    return UserRole.FilterByUserId(user)
        .SelectMany(ur => RolePermission.FilterByRoleId(ur.RoleId))
        .Any(rp => Permission.FindByPermissionId(rp.PermissionId).Name == permissionName);
}
```

#### **3. Data Migration**

**3.1 SQL Server to SpacetimeDB Adapter**

```csharp
public class DataMigrator {
    private readonly AppDbContext _sqlDb;
    private readonly SpacetimeDBClient _spacetimeDb;

    public async Task MigrateUsers() {
        var users = _sqlDb.Users.Include(u => u.UserRoles);
        foreach (var user in users) {
            await _spacetimeDb.CallReducerAsync(
                "register_user",
                user.Login,
                user.PhoneNumber,
                user.Email,
                user.GuidId
            );
            
            foreach (var role in user.UserRoles) {
                await _spacetimeDb.CallReducerAsync(
                    "assign_role",
                    user.GuidId.ToString(), // Convert to Identity
                    (uint)role.RoleId
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
```
