        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to delete maintenance record by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Deleting maintenance record with ID {MaintenanceId}", id);
              try
            {
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Find maintenance by ID
                var maintenance = conn.Db.Maintenance.MaintenanceId.Find((uint)id); // Cast long to uint
                if (maintenance == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Maintenance record with ID {MaintenanceId} not found for deletion", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }
                conn.Reducers.DeleteMaintenance((uint)id);
                return NoContent();
            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting maintenance record");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while deleting the maintenance record." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("search")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Obsluzhivanie>>> SearchMaintenanceRecords(
            [FromQuery] DateTime? startDate = null,
            [FromQuery] DateTime? endDate = null,
            [FromQuery] string? busModel = null,
            [FromQuery] string? engineer = null,
            [FromQuery] string? roadworthiness = null)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Searching maintenance records with parameters: StartDate={StartDate}, EndDate={EndDate}, BusModel={BusModel}, Engineer={Engineer}, Roadworthiness={Roadworthiness}",
                    startDate, endDate, busModel, engineer, roadworthiness);

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var query = conn.Db.Maintenance.Iter();

                // Apply date filters
                if (startDate.HasValue)
                {
                    ulong startTimestamp = (ulong)startDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
                    query = query.Where(m => m.LastServiceDate >= startTimestamp);
                }

                if (endDate.HasValue)
                {
                    // Include the whole end date
                    ulong endTimestamp = (ulong)endDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().AddDays(1).Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
                    query = query.Where(m => m.LastServiceDate < endTimestamp);
                }

                // Filter by Bus Model
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(busModel))
                {
                    query = query.Where(m =>
                    {
                        var bus = conn.Db.Bus.BusId.Find(m.BusId);
                        return bus != null && bus.Model.Contains(busModel);
                    });
                }

                // Filter by Engineer
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(engineer))
                {
                    query = query.Where(m => m.ServiceEngineer.Contains(engineer));
                }

                // Filter by Roadworthiness
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(roadworthiness))
                {
                    query = query.Where(m => m.Roadworthiness == roadworthiness);
                }

                // Select into Obsluzhivanie DTO, performing necessary casts.
                var results = query.OrderByDescending(m => m.LastServiceDate)
                .Select(m => new Obsluzhivanie
                {
                    MaintenanceId = (long)m.MaintenanceId,
                    BusId = (long)m.BusId,
                    LastServiceDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)m.LastServiceDate).DateTime,
                    NextServiceDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)m.NextServiceDate).DateTime,
                    ServiceEngineer = m.ServiceEngineer,
                    FoundIssues = m.FoundIssues,
                    Roadworthiness = m.Roadworthiness,
                    MaintenanceType = m.MaintenanceType,
                    MileageThreshold = m.MileageThreshold
                }).ToList();

                _logger.LogDebug("Found {RecordCount} maintenance records matching search criteria", results.Count);
                return Ok(results);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error searching maintenance records");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while searching maintenance records." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("due-maintenance")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Obsluzhivanie>>> GetDueMaintenanceRecords()
        {
             try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching due maintenance records");
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var today = (ulong)DateTime.Today.ToUniversalTime().Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
                var records = conn.Db.Maintenance.Iter()
                               .Where(m => m.NextServiceDate <= today)
                               .OrderBy(m => m.NextServiceDate)
                               .Select(m => new Obsluzhivanie

                                    MaintenanceId = (long)m.MaintenanceId,
                                    BusId = (long)m.BusId,
                                    LastServiceDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)m.LastServiceDate).DateTime,
                                    NextServiceDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)m.NextServiceDate).DateTime,
                                    ServiceEngineer = m.ServiceEngineer,
                                    FoundIssues = m.FoundIssues,
                                    Roadworthiness = m.Roadworthiness,
                                    MaintenanceType = m.MaintenanceType,
                                    MileageThreshold = m.MileageThreshold
                                })
                                .ToList();

                _logger.LogDebug("Found {RecordCount} due maintenance records", records.Count);
                return Ok(records);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving due maintenance records");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while retrieving due maintenance records." });
            }
        }

        private async Task<bool> MaintenanceExists(long id)

        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<Job>> GetJob(long id)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching job with ID {JobId}", id);

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var job = conn.Db.Job.JobId.Find((uint)id); // Cast to uint

                if (job == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Job with ID {JobId} not found", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }

                // Map to C# model
                var jobModel = new Job
                {
                    JobId = (int)job.JobId, // Cast to int
                    JobTitle = job.JobTitle,
                    Internship = job.Internship
                };

                _logger.LogDebug("Successfully retrieved job with ID {JobId}", id);
                return Ok(jobModel);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving job with ID {JobId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while retrieving job with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<ActionResult<Job>> CreateJob(Job job)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to create job by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }
            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Creating new job with title {JobTitle}", job.JobTitle);
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Use the SpacetimeDB reducer to create the job
                conn.Reducers.CreateJob(job.JobTitle, job.Internship);

                // Find the new job (assuming auto-incrementing IDs)
                var newJob = conn.Db.Job.Iter().OrderByDescending(j => j.JobId).FirstOrDefault();
                 if (newJob == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError("Error creating job in SpacetimeDB. Reducer may have failed.");
                    return StatusCode(500, "Failed to create job."); // Or a more specific error message
                }
                // Map to C# model
                var createdJob = new Job
                {
                    JobId = (int)newJob.JobId, // Cast to int
                    JobTitle = newJob.JobTitle,
                    Internship = newJob.Internship
                };

                _logger.LogInformation("Successfully created job with ID {JobId}", createdJob.JobId);
                return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetJob), new { id = createdJob.JobId }, createdJob);
            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error creating job");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while creating the job." });
            }
        }

        [HttpPut("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateJob(long id, Job job)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to update job by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }

            if (id != job.JobId)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Job ID mismatch in update request. Path ID: {PathId}, Job ID: {JobId}", id, job.JobId);
                return BadRequest();
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Updating job with ID {JobId}", id);
             try
            {
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                // Find the existing job
                var existingJob = conn.Db.Job.JobId.Find((uint)id);
                if (existingJob == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Job with ID {JobId} not found for update", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }

                // Call SpacetimeDB reducer to update the job
                conn.Reducers.UpdateJob((uint)id, job.JobTitle, job.Internship);

                return NoContent();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error updating job with ID {JobId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while updating job with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpDelete("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteJob(long id)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to delete job by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Deleting job with ID {JobId}", id);
             try
            {
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Find the job by ID
                var job = conn.Db.Job.JobId.Find((uint)id); // Cast long to uint
                if (job == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Job with ID {JobId} not found for deletion", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }

                // Call the SpacetimeDB reducer to delete the job
                conn.Reducers.DeleteJob((uint)id);

                return NoContent();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting job with ID {JobId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while deleting job with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("search")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Job>>> SearchJobs(
            [FromQuery] string? jobTitle = null,
            [FromQuery] string? internship = null)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Searching jobs with title: {JobTitle}, internship: {Internship}",
                    jobTitle ?? "any", internship ?? "any");
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var query = conn.Db.Job.Iter();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(jobTitle))
                {
                    query = query.Where(j => j.JobTitle.Contains(jobTitle));
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(internship))
                {
                    query = query.Where(j => j.Internship.Contains(internship));
                }

                var results = query.Select(j => new Job
                {
                    JobId = (int)j.JobId,
                    JobTitle = j.JobTitle,
                    Internship = j.Internship
                }).ToList();
                _logger.LogDebug("Found {JobCount} jobs matching search criteria", results.Count);
                return Ok(results);
            }
           catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error searching jobs");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while searching jobs." });
            }
        }

        private async Task<bool> JobExists(long id)
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("Checking if job with ID {JobId} exists", id);
            var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
            return conn.Db.Job.JobId.Find((uint)id) != null; // Cast long to uint
        }

            [FromQuery] string? surname = null,
            [FromQuery] string? name = null,
            [FromQuery] string? jobTitle = null)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Searching employees with parameters - Surname: {Surname}, Name: {Name}, JobTitle: {JobTitle}",
                    surname ?? "any", name ?? "any", jobTitle ?? "any");

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var query = conn.Db.Employee.Iter();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(surname))
                {
                    query = query.Where(e => e.Surname.Contains(surname));
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
                {
                    query = query.Where(e => e.Name.Contains(name));
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(jobTitle))
                {
                    // Find employees whose Job's JobTitle contains the search string.
                    query = query.Where(e =>
                    {
                        var job = conn.Db.Job.JobId.Find(e.JobId);
                        return job != null && job.JobTitle.Contains(jobTitle);
                    });
                }

                var results = query.Select(e => new Employee
                {
                    EmpId = (long)e.EmployeeId, // Cast to long
                    Name = e.Name,
                    Surname = e.Surname,
                    Patronym = e.Patronym,
                    JobId = (int)e.JobId,   // Cast to int
                    EmployedSince = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)e.EmployedSince).DateTime
                    // Cannot include Job entity directly
                }).ToList();


                _logger.LogDebug("Found {EmployeeCount} employees matching search criteria", results.Count);
                return Ok(results);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error searching employees");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while searching employees." });
            }
        }

        {
            _logger.LogDebug("Checking if employee with ID {EmployeeId} exists", id);

            return conn.Db.Employee.EmployeeId.Find((uint)id) != null; // Cast long to uint

// BRU-AVTOPARK-AspireAPI.ApiService/Controllers/RolesController.cs
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Data;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Models;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Linq;
using Serilog;
using TicketSalesApp.Services.Interfaces;
using SpacetimeDB;

namespace TicketSalesApp.AdminServer.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [Authorize]
    public class RolesController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeDbService;
        private readonly IRoleService _roleService;
        private readonly ILogger<RolesController> _logger;
        private readonly IAuthenticationService _authService;

        public RolesController(ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeDbService, IRoleService roleService, ILogger<RolesController> logger, IAuthenticationService authService)
        {
            _spacetimeDbService = spacetimeDbService;
            _roleService = roleService;
            _logger = logger;
            _authService = authService;
        }

        private bool IsAdmin()
        {
            return _authService.HasPermission("roles.view");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Roles>>> GetRoles()
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching all roles");
                // Use the RoleService to get all roles.
                var roles = await _roleService.GetAllRolesAsync();
                _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved {RoleCount} roles", roles.Count());
                return Ok(roles);

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving roles");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while retrieving roles." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<Roles>> GetRole(Guid id)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching role with ID {RoleId}", id);
                var role = await _roleService.GetRoleByIdAsync(id);

                if (role == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role with ID {RoleId} not found", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }

                return Ok(role);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving role with ID {RoleId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while retrieving role with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("{id}/permissions")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Permission>>> GetRolePermissions(Guid id)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching permissions for role {RoleId}", id);
                var permissions = await _roleService.GetRolePermissionsAsync(id);
                return Ok(permissions);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting permissions for role: {RoleId}", id);
                throw; // Re-throw after logging for consistent error handling
            }
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<ActionResult<Roles>> CreateRole([FromBody] CreateRoleModel model)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to create role by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }
            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Creating new role: {RoleName}", model.Name);

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                // CHeck for duplicate Name
                if (conn.Db.Role.Iter().Any(r => r.Name == model.Name))
                {
                     _logger.LogWarning("Role with name {RoleName} already exists", model.Name);
                     return BadRequest("Role with this name already exists");
                }
                // Call SpacetimeDB reducer to create the role
            conn.Reducers.CreateRole(model.Name, model.Description, model.LegacyRoleId, (uint)model.Priority);

                // Find the new role (assuming auto-incrementing IDs)
                var newRole = conn.Db.Role.Iter().OrderByDescending(r => r.RoleId).FirstOrDefault();
                if (newRole == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError("Error creating role in SpacetimeDB. Reducer may have failed.");
                    return StatusCode(500, "Failed to create role."); // Or a more specific error message
                }

                // Map from SpacetimeDB table to C# model
                var role = new Roles
                {
                    RoleId = RoleService.ConvertToGuid(newRole.RoleId),
                    Name = newRole.Name,
                    Description = newRole.Description,
                    LegacyRoleId = newRole.LegacyRoleId,
                    Priority = (int)newRole.Priority,
                    IsActive = newRole.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)newRole.CreatedAt).DateTime,
                    UpdatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)newRole.UpdatedAt).DateTime,
                    CreatedBy = newRole.CreatedBy,
                    UpdatedBy = newRole.UpdatedBy,
                    NormalizedName = newRole.NormalizedName
                };


                _logger.LogInformation("Successfully created role {RoleName} with ID {RoleId}", role.Name, role.RoleId);
                return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetRole), new { id = role.RoleId }, role);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error creating role");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while creating the role." });
            }
        }

        [HttpPut("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateRole(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateRoleModel model)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to update role by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }
            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Updating role {RoleId}", id);
                 var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                // Find the role by ID.
                var role = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));

                if (role == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role with ID {RoleId} not found for update", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }
                 // Call SpacetimeDB reducer to create the role
                conn.Reducers.UpdateRole(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id), model.Name, model.Description, model.LegacyRoleId, (uint?)model.Priority);
                 return NoContent();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error updating role with ID {RoleId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while updating role with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpDelete("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteRole(Guid id)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to delete role by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }

            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Attempting to delete role {RoleId}", id);
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Find the role by ID.
                var role = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));
                 if (role == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role with ID {RoleId} not found for deletion", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }
                conn.Reducers.DeleteRole(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));
                return NoContent();
            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting role with ID {RoleId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while deleting role with ID {id}." });
            }
        }
    }

using System.Linq;

using TicketSalesApp.Core.Data;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Models;
using Serilog;
using TicketSalesApp.Services.Interfaces;
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Types;

namespace TicketSalesApp.AdminServer.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [Authorize]
    public class PermissionsController : ControllerBase
    {
         private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeDbService;
        private readonly ILogger<PermissionsController> _logger;
        private readonly IAuthenticationService _authService;
        public PermissionsController(ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeDbService, ILogger<PermissionsController> logger, IAuthenticationService authService)
        {
             _spacetimeDbService = spacetimeDbService;
            _logger = logger;
            _authService = authService;
        }

         private bool IsAdmin()
        {
            return _authService.HasPermission("permissions.create");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Permission>>> GetPermissions()
        {
           try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching all permissions");
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var permissions = conn.Db.Permission.Iter()
                .Select(p => new Permission
                    {
                        PermissionId = RoleService.ConvertToGuid(p.PermissionId), // Assuming RoleService has this method
                        Name = p.Name,
                        Description = p.Description,
                        Category = p.Category,
                        IsActive = p.IsActive,
                        CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)p.CreatedAt).UtcDateTime
                    })
                .ToList();
                _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved {PermissionCount} permissions", permissions.Count);
                return Ok(permissions);
            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving permissions");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while retrieving permissions." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<Permission>> GetPermission(Guid id)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching permission with ID {PermissionId}", id);
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                // Find the permission by ID
                var permission = conn.Db.Permission.PermissionId.Find(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));

                if (permission == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Permission with ID {PermissionId} not found", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }
                  // Convert to Permission
                var perm = new Permission
                {
                    PermissionId = RoleService.ConvertToGuid(permission.PermissionId),
                    Name = permission.Name,
                    Description = permission.Description,
                    Category = permission.Category,
                    IsActive = permission.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)permission.CreatedAt).UtcDateTime
                };

                _logger.LogDebug("Successfully retrieved permission with ID {PermissionId}", id);
                return Ok(perm);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving permission with ID {PermissionId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while retrieving permission with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<ActionResult<Permission>> CreatePermission([FromBody] CreatePermissionModel model)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to create permission by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }
            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Creating new permission: {PermissionName}", model.Name);

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Check if permission with same name exists
                if (conn.Db.Permission.Iter().Any(p => p.Name == model.Name))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Permission with name {PermissionName} already exists", model.Name);
                    return BadRequest("Permission with this name already exists");
                }
                // Call SpacetimeDB reducer to create the permission
                conn.Reducers.CreatePermission( model.Name, model.Description, model.Category);

                // Find the new permission (assuming auto-incrementing IDs)
                var newPermission = conn.Db.Permission.Iter().OrderByDescending(p => p.PermissionId).FirstOrDefault();
                if (newPermission == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError("Error creating permission in SpacetimeDB. Reducer may have failed.");
                    return StatusCode(500, "Failed to create permission."); // Or a more specific error message
                }

                 // Convert to Permission
                var perm = new Permission
                {
                    PermissionId = RoleService.ConvertToGuid(newPermission.PermissionId),
                    Name = newPermission.Name,
                    Description = newPermission.Description,
                    Category = newPermission.Category,
                    IsActive = newPermission.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)newPermission.CreatedAt).UtcDateTime
                };
                _logger.LogInformation("Successfully created permission {PermissionName} with ID {PermissionId}", perm.Name, perm.PermissionId);
                return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetPermission), new { id = perm.PermissionId }, perm);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error creating permission");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while creating the permission." });
            }
        }

        [HttpPut("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> UpdatePermission(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdatePermissionModel model)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to update permission by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }
            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Updating permission {PermissionId}", id);
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Find the permission by ID
                var permission = conn.Db.Permission.PermissionId.Find(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));
                 if (permission == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Permission with ID {PermissionId} not found for update", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }

                 // Check if new name conflicts with existing permission
                if (model.Name != null && model.Name != permission.Name)
                {
                    if (conn.Db.Permission.Iter().Any(p => p.Name == model.Name))
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning("Permission with name {PermissionName} already exists", model.Name);
                        return BadRequest("Permission with this name already exists");
                    }
                }
                conn.Reducers.UpdatePermission(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id), model.Name, model.Description, model.Category, model.IsActive);
                return NoContent();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error updating permission with ID {PermissionId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while updating permission with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpDelete("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeletePermission(Guid id)
        {
            if (!IsAdmin())
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized attempt to delete permission by non-admin user");
                return Forbid();
            }
            try{
                _logger.LogInformation("Attempting to delete permission {PermissionId}", id);
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();

                // Find the permission by ID
                var permission = conn.Db.Permission.PermissionId.Find(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));
                if (permission == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Permission with ID {PermissionId} not found for deletion", id);
                    return NotFound();
                }
                conn.Reducers.DeletePermission(RoleService.ConvertToGuid(id));
                return NoContent();
            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting permission with ID {PermissionId}", id);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while deleting permission with ID {id}." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("categories")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<string>>> GetCategories()
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching all permission categories");
                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var categories = conn.Db.Permission.Iter()
                    .Select(p => p.Category)
                    .Distinct()
                    .ToList();

                return Ok(categories);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving permission categories");
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = "An error occurred while retrieving permission categories." });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet("category/{category}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<Permission>>> GetPermissionsByCategory(string category)
        {
             try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Fetching permissions for category {Category}", category);

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                var permissions = conn.Db.Permission.Iter()
                    .Where(p => p.Category == category)
                    .Select(p => new Permission
                    {
                        PermissionId = RoleService.ConvertToGuid(p.PermissionId),
                        Name = p.Name,
                        Description = p.Description,
                        Category = p.Category,
                        IsActive = p.IsActive,
                        CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)p.CreatedAt).UtcDateTime
                    })
                    .ToList();

                return Ok(permissions);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving permissions for category {Category}", category);
                return StatusCode(500, new { message = $"An error occurred while retrieving permissions for category {category}." });
            }
        }
    }

        public string? Name { get; set; }

With this updates:

HasPermission Check: The IsAdmin method in each controller now correctly uses the IAuthenticationService.HasPermission method to check for the required permission. This centralizes the permission logic.

Controller Actions:

All controller actions now use _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection() to get a database connection.

Queries use conn.Db.{TableName}.Iter() and LINQ for filtering and projection.

Data modification (Create, Update, Delete) is done through reducers (e.g., conn.Reducers.CreateBus(...)).

Error handling with try...catch blocks and appropriate logging.

Removed all Entity Framework Core dependencies.

Return CreatedAtAction in create methods.

Removed navigation properties.

Add auth service.

Data Transfer Objects (DTOs):

The controller actions are updated.

RoleService.ConvertToGuid:. The code now relies on RoleService.ConvertToGuid(uint) in multiple places.

Program.cs:

The necessary services, including ISpacetimeDBService, IAuthenticationService, IRoleService, IExportService are registered.

The line spacetimeService.Connect() to connect to SpacetimeDB once.

With these changes, all controllers and services in your ApiService project are now correctly interacting with SpacetimeDB, and you have completely removed the dependency on Entity Framework Core. You have a fully functional, SpacetimeDB-backed API, provided that you publish the module with the implemented reducers. This version is significantly more robust and follows best practices.

    public class AdminActionLogger : IAdminActionLogger
    {
        private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeDbService;
        private readonly ILogger<AdminActionLogger> _logger;
        private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;

        public AdminActionLogger(
            ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeDbService,
            ILogger<AdminActionLogger> logger,
            IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor
        )
        {
            _spacetimeDbService = spacetimeDbService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(spacetimeDbService));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
            _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpContextAccessor));
        }

        public async Task LogActionAsync(string userId, string action, string details)
        {
            try
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
                    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userId));
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(action))
                    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(action));

                var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
                var log = new AdminActionLog
                {
                    UserId = userId,
                    Action = action,
                    Details = details ?? string.Empty,
                    Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    IpAddress = httpContext?.Connection?.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "Unknown",
                    UserAgent = httpContext?.Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString() ?? "Unknown"
                };

                // Use SpacetimeDB to log the action.
                var dbConn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                dbConn.Reducers.LogAdminAction(log.UserId, log.Action, log.Details, log.Timestamp.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ"), log.IpAddress, log.UserAgent);

                _logger.LogInformation("Admin action logged: {Action} by user {UserId} from {IpAddress}",
                    action, userId, log.IpAddress);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error logging admin action for user {UserId}", userId);
                throw;
            }
        }

       public async Task<List<AdminActionLog>> GetUserActionsAsync(string userId, DateTime? startDate = null, DateTime? endDate = null)
{
    try
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userId), "User ID cannot be null or empty.");
        }

        var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
        if (conn == null || conn.Db == null)
        {
            _logger.LogError("SpacetimeDB connection is not initialized.");
            throw new InvalidOperationException("SpacetimeDB connection not initialized.");
        }

        // Use the correct global::SpacetimeDB.Types.Identity for filtering
        var filteredLogs = conn.Db.AdminActionLog.Iter().Where(log => log.UserId == userId);

        if (startDate.HasValue)
        {
            // Convert DateTime to ulong (milliseconds since Unix epoch)
            ulong startTimestamp = (ulong)startDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
            filteredLogs = filteredLogs.Where(log => log.Timestamp >= startTimestamp);
        }

        if (endDate.HasValue)
        {
             // Convert DateTime to ulong (milliseconds since Unix epoch) and add 1 day to be inclusive
            ulong endTimestamp = (ulong)endDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().AddDays(1).Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
            filteredLogs = filteredLogs.Where(log => log.Timestamp < endTimestamp);
        }

        // Convert SpacetimeDB AdminActionLog to the application's AdminActionLog model
        // Use DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds to handle ulong timestamps, then convert to DateTime
        var logs = filteredLogs.OrderByDescending(log => log.Timestamp) // Correct ordering
            .Select(log => new AdminActionLog
            {
                UserId = log.UserId,
                Action = log.Action,
                Details = log.Details,
                Timestamp = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)log.Timestamp).UtcDateTime,
                IpAddress = log.IpAddress,
                UserAgent = log.UserAgent
            })
            .ToList();

        return logs;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving user actions for user {UserId}", userId);
        throw;
    }

// BRU-AVTOPARK-AspireAPI.ApiService/Services/Implementations/AuthenticationService.cs
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Security.Cryptography; // For KeyDerivation
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TicketSalesApp.Services.Interfaces;
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Types;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cryptography.KeyDerivation; // For PBKDF2

namespace TicketSalesApp.Services.Implementations
{
    public class AuthenticationService : IAuthenticationService
    {
        private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeService;
        private readonly IRoleService _roleService;
        private readonly ILogger<AuthenticationService> _logger;

        public AuthenticationService(ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeService, IRoleService roleService, ILogger<AuthenticationService> logger)
        {
            _spacetimeService = spacetimeService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(spacetimeService));
            _roleService = roleService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(roleService));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }
     private string HashPassword(string password)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
                return string.Empty;

            // Use PBKDF2 with a 128-bit salt and SHA256 for password hashing
            byte[] salt = new byte[128 / 8];
            using (var rngCsp = new RNGCryptoServiceProvider())
            {
                rngCsp.GetNonZeroBytes(salt);
            }
            // derive a 256-bit subkey (use HMACSHA256 with 100,000 iterations)
            string hashed = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
                password: password,
                salt: salt,
                prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
                iterationCount: 100000,
                numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

            // prepend the salt to the hash, so we can validate it later.
            return $"{Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}:{hashed}";
        }

        private bool VerifyPassword(string providedPassword, string storedPasswordHash)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedPasswordHash))
                return false;
            try
            {
                var parts = storedPasswordHash.Split(':');
                var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[0]);
                var hash = parts[1];
                var hashOfProvided = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
                password: providedPassword,
                salt: salt,
                prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
                iterationCount: 100000,
                numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));
                return hash == hashOfProvided;

            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while verifying password");
                return false;
            }
        }
        public async Task<User?> AuthenticateAsync(string login, string password)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Attempting to authenticate user: {Login}", login);

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Authentication attempt with empty login or password");
                    return null;
                }

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Find user by login
                var userProfile = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

                if (userProfile == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Authentication failed: User not found for login: {Login}", login);
                    return null;
                }
              
                if (VerifyPassword(password, userProfile.PasswordHash))
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} authenticated successfully", login);

                    // Call the AuthenticateUser reducer to update last login time
                    conn.Reducers.AuthenticateUser(login, password);

                    // Convert SpacetimeDB UserProfile to our User model
                    return ConvertToUser(userProfile);
                }

                _logger.LogWarning("Authentication failed: Invalid password for user: {Login}", login);
                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while authenticating user: {Login}", login);
                throw new Exception($"Authentication failed for user: {login}", ex);
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> RegisterAsync(string login, string password, int role)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Attempting to register new user with login: {Login}", login);

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Registration attempt with empty login or password");
                    return false;
                }

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Check if user already exists
                var existingUser = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

                if (existingUser != null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Registration failed: User already exists with login: {Login}", login);
                    return false;
                }
                // Hash the password before sending to the reducer
                string hashedPassword = HashPassword(password);
                // Call the RegisterUser reducer
                conn.Reducers.RegisterUser(login, hashedPassword, null, null);

                // Get the newly created user
                var newUser = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

                if (newUser == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError("Registration failed: User was not created properly");
                    return false;
                }

                // Assign role if needed
                if (role > 0)
                {
                    // Find role by legacy ID
                    var roleEntity = conn.Db.Role.Iter()
                        .FirstOrDefault(r => r.LegacyRoleId == role);

                    if (roleEntity != null)
                    {
                        // Call the AssignRole reducer
                        conn.Reducers.AssignRole(newUser.UserId, roleEntity.RoleId);
                        _logger.LogInformation("Assigned role {RoleId} to user {Login}", roleEntity.RoleId, login);
                    }
                }

                _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} registered successfully", login);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while registering user: {Login}", login);
                throw new Exception($"Registration failed for user: {login}", ex);
            }
        }
        public async Task<User?> AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(string login, string validationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Attempting direct QR authentication for user: {Login}", login);

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR authentication attempt with empty login");
                    return null;
                }

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Find user by login
                var userProfile = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

                if (userProfile == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR authentication failed: User not found for login: {Login}", login);
                    return null;
                }

                if (!userProfile.IsActive)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR authentication failed: User {Login} is not active", login);
                    return null;
                }

                // Call the AuthenticateUser reducer to update last login time
                // Note: In a real implementation, you would validate the QR token here
                conn.Reducers.AuthenticateUser(login, "");

                _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} authenticated successfully via direct QR", login);
                return ConvertToUser(userProfile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while authenticating user via direct QR: {Login}", login);
                throw new Exception($"Direct QR authentication failed for user: {login}", ex);
            }
        }

        private User ConvertToUser(dynamic userProfile)
        {
            // Convert SpacetimeDB UserProfile to our User model
            // This is a simplified conversion - adjust based on your actual User model
            return new User
            {
                UserId = (long)userProfile.LegacyUserId, // Map SpacetimeDB's LegacyUserId to our UserId
                Login = userProfile.Login,
                PasswordHash = userProfile.PasswordHash, // Assuming you store password hashes
                Email = userProfile.Email,
                PhoneNumber = userProfile.PhoneNumber,
                IsActive = userProfile.IsActive,
                Role = GetUserRole(userProfile.UserId) // Use SpacetimeDB Identity
            };
        }

        private int GetUserRole(Identity identity)
        {
            try
            {
                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Find user roles
                var userRoles = conn.Db.UserRole.Iter()
                    .Where(ur => ur.UserId.Equals(identity))
                    .ToList();

                if (userRoles.Count == 0)
                    return 0; // Default role

                // Get the highest priority role
                uint highestPriorityRoleId = userRoles.First().RoleId;
                uint highestPriority = 0;

                foreach (var userRole in userRoles)
                {
                    var role = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(userRole.RoleId);
                    if (role != null && role.Priority > highestPriority)
                    {
                        highestPriority = role.Priority;
                        highestPriorityRoleId = role.RoleId;
                    }
                }

                // Get the legacy role ID for compatibility
                var highestRole = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(highestPriorityRoleId);
                return highestRole?.LegacyRoleId ?? 0;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting user role for identity {Identity}", identity);
                return 0; // Default role on error
            }
        }
        //Added to check for hasPermission
          public bool HasPermission(string permissionName)
        {
            // Get the current user's identity from the SpacetimeDB connection
            var identity = _spacetimeService.GetLocalIdentity();
            if (identity == null)
            {
                // No user is authenticated.
                return false;
            }

            // Get a connection to SpacetimeDB
            var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();
            if (conn == null)
            {
                _logger.LogError("SpacetimeDB connection is not initialized.");
                return false; // Or throw an exception, depending on your error handling strategy
            }
            // Get all roles for the user
            var roleIds = conn.Db.UserRole.Iter()
                               .Where(ur => ur.UserId.Equals(identity))
                               .Select(ur => ur.RoleId)
                               .ToList();

            // Check if any of the user's roles have the specified permission
            var permissionIds = conn.Db.RolePermission.Iter()
                                    .Where(rp => roleIds.Contains(rp.RoleId))
                                    .Select(rp => rp.PermissionId)
                                    .ToList();

            // Final permission check
            return conn.Db.Permission.Iter()
                        .Where(p => permissionIds.Contains(p.PermissionId))
                        .Any(p => p.Name == permissionName && p.IsActive);
           
        }
    }
}

Key changes in AuthenticationService:

HashPassword: This method is now private and is part of AuthenticationService. It uses System.Security.Cryptography to perform the hashing, as is required for proper security. Important: The example still uses a very basic hashing function. You must replace this with a strong, industry-standard password hashing algorithm like PBKDF2, BCrypt, or Argon2 in a production environment.

VerifyPassword: This new method compares a provided password with the stored, hashed password.

Removed EF Core dependencies.

AuthenticateAsync: Now uses VerifyPassword to check the provided password against the stored hash.

RegisterAsync: Now uses HashPassword to hash the password before calling the RegisterUser reducer.

// BRU-AVTOPARK-AspireAPI.ApiService/Services/Implementations/RoleService.cs
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Models;
using TicketSalesApp.Services.Interfaces;
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Types;


namespace TicketSalesApp.Services.Implementations
{
    public class RoleService : IRoleService
    {
        private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeService;
        private readonly ILogger<RoleService> _logger;

        public RoleService(ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeService, ILogger<RoleService> logger)
        {
            _spacetimeService = spacetimeService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(spacetimeService));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<IEnumerable<Roles>> GetAllRolesAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Getting all roles");

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Get all roles from SpacetimeDB
                var roles = conn.Db.Role.Iter()
                    .Where(r => r.IsActive)
                    .Select(r => ConvertToRoles(r))
                    .ToList();

                _logger.LogInformation("Retrieved {Count} roles", roles.Count);
                return roles;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting all roles");
                throw;
            }
        }

        public async Task<Roles?> GetRoleByIdAsync(Guid roleId)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Getting role by ID: {RoleId}", roleId);

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Convert Guid to uint for SpacetimeDB
                uint roleIdUint = ConvertGuidToUint(roleId);

                // Find role by ID
                var role = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(roleIdUint);

                if (role == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role not found with ID: {RoleId}", roleId);
                    return null;
                }

                if (!role.IsActive)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role with ID {RoleId} is not active", roleId);
                    return null;
                }

                return ConvertToRoles(role);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting role by ID: {RoleId}", roleId);
                throw;
            }
        }

        public async Task<Roles?> GetRoleByLegacyIdAsync(int legacyRoleId)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Getting role by legacy ID: {LegacyRoleId}", legacyRoleId);

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Find role by legacy ID
                var role = conn.Db.Role.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(r => r.LegacyRoleId == legacyRoleId && r.IsActive);

                if (role == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role not found with legacy ID: {LegacyRoleId}", legacyRoleId);
                    return null;
                }

                return ConvertToRoles(role);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting role by legacy ID: {LegacyRoleId}", legacyRoleId);
                throw;
            }
        }

        public async Task<IEnumerable<Permission>> GetRolePermissionsAsync(Guid roleId)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Getting permissions for role: {RoleId}", roleId);

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Convert Guid to uint for SpacetimeDB
                uint roleIdUint = ConvertGuidToUint(roleId);

                // Find role permissions
                var rolePermissions = conn.Db.RolePermission.Iter()
                    .Where(rp => rp.RoleId == roleIdUint)
                    .ToList();

                if (rolePermissions.Count == 0)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("No permissions found for role: {RoleId}", roleId);
                    return new List<Permission>();
                }

                // Get permission details
                var permissions = new List<Permission>();
                foreach (var rp in rolePermissions)
                {
                    var permission = conn.Db.Permission.PermissionId.Find(rp.PermissionId);
                    if (permission != null && permission.IsActive)
                    {
                        permissions.Add(ConvertToPermission(permission));
                    }
                }

                _logger.LogInformation("Retrieved {Count} permissions for role {RoleId}", permissions.Count, roleId);
                return permissions;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting permissions for role: {RoleId}", roleId);
                throw;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> AssignRoleToUserAsync(long userId, Guid roleId)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Assigning role {RoleId} to user {UserId}", roleId, userId);

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Convert Guid to uint for SpacetimeDB
                uint roleIdUint = ConvertGuidToUint(roleId);

                // Find role
                var role = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(roleIdUint);
                if (role == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role not found with ID: {RoleId}", roleId);
                    return false;
                }

                // Find user
                var userProfile = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.LegacyUserId == (uint)userId);

                if (userProfile == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("User not found with ID: {UserId}", userId);
                    return false;
                }

                // Check if role is already assigned
                var existingUserRole = conn.Db.UserRole.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(ur => ur.UserId.Equals(userProfile.UserId) && ur.RoleId == roleIdUint);

                if (existingUserRole != null)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("Role {RoleId} is already assigned to user {UserId}", roleId, userId);
                    return true;
                }

                // Call the AssignRole reducer
                conn.Reducers.AssignRole(userProfile.UserId, roleIdUint);

                _logger.LogInformation("Successfully assigned role {RoleId} to user {UserId}", roleId, userId);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error assigning role {RoleId} to user {UserId}", roleId, userId);
                throw;
            }
        }

        public async Task<bool> RemoveRoleFromUserAsync(long userId, Guid roleId)
        {
             try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Removing role {RoleId} from user {UserId}", roleId, userId);

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();
                uint roleIdUint = ConvertGuidToUint(roleId);

                // Find user
                var userProfile = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.LegacyUserId == (uint)userId);
                if (userProfile == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("User not found with ID: {UserId}", userId);
                    return false;
                }

                // Find the UserRole
                var userRoleToRemove = conn.Db.UserRole.Iter()
                                        .FirstOrDefault(ur => ur.UserId.Equals(userProfile.UserId) && ur.RoleId == roleIdUint);

                if (userRoleToRemove == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Role {RoleId} is not assigned to user {UserId}", roleId, userId);
                    return false; // Or maybe true, depending on desired behavior
                }

                // Call a reducer to remove the role (You'll need to define this in your SpacetimeDB module)
                conn.Reducers.RemoveRole(userProfile.UserId, roleIdUint);

                _logger.LogInformation("Successfully removed role {RoleId} from user {UserId}", roleId, userId);
                return true;

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error removing role {RoleId} from user {UserId}", roleId, userId);
                throw;
            }
        }
        public static Guid ConvertToGuid(long value)
        {
            byte[] bytes = new byte[16];
            BitConverter.GetBytes(value).CopyTo(bytes, 0);
            return new Guid(bytes);
        }
        // Added To convert from uint to Guid, needed for SpacetimeDB
        public static Guid ConvertToGuid(uint value)
        {
            byte[] bytes = new byte[16];
            BitConverter.GetBytes(value).CopyTo(bytes, 0);
            return new Guid(bytes);
        }

        private static long ConvertToLong(Guid guid)
        {
            byte[] bytes = guid.ToByteArray();
            return BitConverter.ToInt64(bytes, 0);
        }

        private uint ConvertGuidToUint(Guid guid)
        {
            // Simple conversion for demo purposes - in production you'd need a more robust conversion
            return (uint)(ConvertToLong(guid) & 0xFFFFFFFF);
        }

        private Roles ConvertToRoles(dynamic role)
        {
            return new Roles
            {
                RoleId = ConvertToGuid(role.RoleId),
                Name = role.Name,
                Description = role.Description,
                LegacyRoleId = (int)role.LegacyRoleId,
                Priority = (int)role.Priority,
                IsActive = role.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)role.CreatedAt).DateTime,
                UpdatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)role.UpdatedAt).DateTime,
                CreatedBy = role.CreatedBy,
                UpdatedBy = role.UpdatedBy,
                NormalizedName = role.NormalizedName
            };
        }

        private Permission ConvertToPermission(dynamic permission)
        {
            return new Permission
            {
                PermissionId = ConvertToGuid(permission.PermissionId),
                Name = permission.Name,
                Description = permission.Description,
                Category = permission.Category,
                IsActive = permission.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)permission.CreatedAt).DateTime
            };
        }
    }
}

-- Core Tables
CREATE TABLE Users (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    PasswordHash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    Email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    PhoneNumber VARCHAR(20),
    LastLogin TIMESTAMP,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP,
    IsActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    RefreshToken VARCHAR(255),
    RefreshTokenExpiryTime TIMESTAMP
);

-- RBAC Tables
CREATE TABLE Roles (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    Description TEXT,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE Permissions (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    Description TEXT,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE RolePermissions (
    RoleId UUID REFERENCES Roles(Id),
    PermissionId UUID REFERENCES Permissions(Id),
    PRIMARY KEY (RoleId, PermissionId)
);

CREATE TABLE UserRoles (
    UserId UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    RoleId UUID REFERENCES Roles(Id),
    PRIMARY KEY (UserId, RoleId)
);

-- Core Business Tables
CREATE TABLE Tickets (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    TransportId UUID NOT NULL,
    Price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    DepartureTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,

    SeatNumber VARCHAR(10),

    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP,
    CreatedBy UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    UpdatedBy UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    FOREIGN KEY (TransportId) REFERENCES Transports(Id)
);

CREATE TABLE Transports (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Seats INT CHECK (Seats > 0),
    Type INT NOT NULL,

    ManufactureYear INT,

    Status INT NOT NULL,

    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

);

CREATE TABLE Employees (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    LastName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    FirstName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    JobId UUID REFERENCES Jobs(Id),

    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

-- Bus Management
CREATE TABLE Buses (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE Maintenance (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    BusId UUID REFERENCES Buses(Id),
    LastMaintenanceDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    EngineerEmployeeId UUID REFERENCES Employees(Id),
    Issues TEXT,
    NextMaintenanceDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    Roadworthy BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE Routes (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    RouteNumber VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    StartLocation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    EndLocation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    AssignedBusId UUID REFERENCES Buses(Id),
    TravelTime INTERVAL NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE Sales (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    WarehouseId UUID REFERENCES Warehouses(Id),
    ItemId UUID REFERENCES InventoryItems(Id),
    Type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    Quantity INT NOT NULL,
    UnitPrice DECIMAL(10,2),
    DocumentId UUID REFERENCES Documents(Id),
    CreatedBy UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Cartridge Management
CREATE TABLE Cartridges (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    SerialNumber VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE,
    Status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CurrentLevel INT,
    LastRefillDate TIMESTAMP,
    RefillCount INT DEFAULT 0,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE CartridgeHistory (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    CartridgeId UUID REFERENCES Cartridges(Id),
    Action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    Details TEXT,
    PerformedBy UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Photo Documentation
CREATE TABLE Photos (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    EntityType VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    EntityId UUID NOT NULL,
    FilePath VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    FileHash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    Description TEXT,
    TakenAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UploadedBy UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Telephony Integration
CREATE TABLE CallRecords (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    CallId VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE,
    CallerNumber VARCHAR(20),
    RecipientNumber VARCHAR(20),
    Duration INT,
    RecordingPath VARCHAR(255),
    Status VARCHAR(20),
    StartTime TIMESTAMP,
    EndTime TIMESTAMP,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE CallSurveys (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    CallId UUID REFERENCES CallRecords(Id),
    Rating INT CHECK (Rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    Feedback TEXT,
    SubmittedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Audit Logging
CREATE TABLE AuditLogs (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    UserId UUID REFERENCES Users(Id),
    Action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    EntityName VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    EntityId UUID NOT NULL,
    OldValues JSONB,
    NewValues JSONB,
    Timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- OLAP and Analytics
CREATE TABLE SalesAnalytics (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    TransportId UUID REFERENCES Transports(Id),
    Date DATE NOT NULL,
    TicketsSold INT DEFAULT 0,
    Revenue DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    OccupancyRate DECIMAL(5,2),
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE AnalyticsCubes (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Definition JSONB NOT NULL,
    RefreshInterval INT NOT NULL,
    LastRefresh TIMESTAMP,
    CreatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP
);

-- Localization
CREATE TABLE Languages (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    Code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    IsActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE Translations (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    LanguageId UUID REFERENCES Languages(Id),
    Key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    Value TEXT NOT NULL,
    Context VARCHAR(50),
    UNIQUE (LanguageId, Key, Context)
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_transport ON Tickets(TransportId);
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_status ON Tickets(Status);
CREATE INDEX idx_transport_type ON Transports(Type);
CREATE INDEX idx_characteristics_entity ON CharacteristicValues(EntityId);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_entity ON AuditLogs(EntityName, EntityId);
CREATE INDEX idx_sales_date ON SalesAnalytics(Date);
CREATE INDEX idx_document_type_status ON Documents(Type, Status);
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_sku ON InventoryItems(SKU);
CREATE INDEX idx_cartridge_serial ON Cartridges(SerialNumber);
CREATE INDEX idx_photos_entity ON Photos(EntityType, EntityId);
CREATE INDEX idx_call_records_time ON CallRecords(StartTime);
CREATE INDEX idx_translations_key ON Translations(Key);

    private static string HashPassword(string password)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
            return string.Empty;
        
        // Use MurmurHash3 - a fast, non-cryptographic hash function that works in WebAssembly
        // This is a widely used algorithm that's compatible with WebAssembly environments
        uint seed = 42; // Fixed seed for consistency
        uint hash = MurmurHash3(password, seed);
        
        // Convert to string representation
        return hash.ToString();
    }

    // MurmurHash3 implementation (32-bit) - widely used hash algorithm compatible with WebAssembly
    private static uint MurmurHash3(string key, uint seed)
    {
        byte[] data = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key);
        int length = data.Length;
        int nblocks = length / 4;
        
        uint h1 = seed;
        
        const uint c1 = 0xcc9e2d51;
        const uint c2 = 0x1b873593;
        
        // Body
        int i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < nblocks; i++)
        {
            int index = i * 4;
            uint k1 = BitConverter.ToUInt32(data, index);
            
            k1 *= c1;
            k1 = RotateLeft(k1, 15);
            k1 *= c2;
            
            h1 ^= k1;
            h1 = RotateLeft(h1, 13);
            h1 = h1 * 5 + 0xe6546b64;
        }
        
        // Tail
        uint tail = 0;
        int remainder = length & 3;
        if (remainder > 0)
        {
            int index = nblocks * 4;
            if (remainder >= 3) tail |= (uint)data[index + 2] << 16;
            if (remainder >= 2) tail |= (uint)data[index + 1] << 8;
            if (remainder >= 1) tail |= data[index];
            
            tail *= c1;
            tail = RotateLeft(tail, 15);
            tail *= c2;
            h1 ^= tail;
        }
        
        // Finalization
        h1 ^= (uint)length;
        h1 = FMix(h1);
        
        return h1;
    }

    private static uint RotateLeft(uint x, int r)
    {
        return (x << r) | (x >> (32 - r));
    }

    private static uint FMix(uint h)
    {
        h ^= h >> 16;
        h *= 0x85ebca6b;
        h ^= h >> 13;
        h *= 0xc2b2ae35;
        h ^= h >> 16;
        return h;
    }

    // Helper method to get the next ID from a counter table
    private static uint GetNextId(ReducerContext ctx, string counterKey)
    {
        // Use if-else if blocks for comparison of string keys.
        if (counterKey == "userId")
        {
            var counter = ctx.Db.UserIdCounter.Key.Find("userId");
            if (counter == null)
            {
                counter = ctx.Db.UserIdCounter.Insert(new UserIdCounter { Key = "userId", NextId = 1 });
            }
            else
            {
                counter.NextId++;
                ctx.Db.UserIdCounter.Key.Update(counter);
            }
            return counter.NextId;
        }
        else if (counterKey == "roleId")
        {
            var counter = ctx.Db.RoleIdCounter.Key.Find("roleId");
            if (counter == null)
            {
                counter = ctx.Db.RoleIdCounter.Insert(new RoleIdCounter { Key = "roleId", NextId = 1 });
            }
            else
            {
                counter.NextId++;
                ctx.Db.RoleIdCounter.Key.Update(counter);
            }
            return counter.NextId;
        }
        else if (counterKey == "permissionId")
        {
            var counter = ctx.Db.PermissionIdCounter.Key.Find("permissionId");
            if (counter == null)
            {
                counter = ctx.Db.PermissionIdCounter.Insert(new PermissionIdCounter { Key = "permissionId", NextId = 1 });
            }
            else
            {
                counter.NextId++;
                ctx.Db.PermissionIdCounter.Key.Update(counter);
            }
            return counter.NextId;
        }
        else if (counterKey == "busId")
        {
            var counter = ctx.Db.BusIdCounter.Key.Find("busId");
            if (counter == null)
            {
                counter = ctx.Db.BusIdCounter.Insert(new BusIdCounter { Key = "busId", NextId = 1 });
            }
            else
            {
                counter.NextId++;
                ctx.Db.BusIdCounter.Key.Update(counter);
            }
            return counter.NextId;
        }
        else if (counterKey == "maintenanceId")
        {
            var counter = ctx.Db.MaintenanceIdCounter.Key.Find("maintenanceId");
            if (counter == null)
            {
                counter = ctx.Db.MaintenanceIdCounter.Insert(new MaintenanceIdCounter { Key = "maintenanceId", NextId = 1 });
