// BRU-AVTOPARK-AspireAPI.ApiService/Services/Implementations/QRAuthenticationService.cs
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using QRCoder;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Models;
using TicketSalesApp.Services.Interfaces;
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Types;

namespace TicketSalesApp.Services.Implementations
{
    public class QRAuthenticationService : IQRAuthenticationService
    {
        private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
        private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeDbService; // Use SpacetimeDB
        private readonly ILogger<QRAuthenticationService> _logger;
        private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
        private readonly IAuthenticationService _authService; // Inject IAuthenticationService

        public QRAuthenticationService(
            IConfiguration configuration,
            ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeDbService, // Inject ISpacetimeDBService
            ILogger<QRAuthenticationService> logger,
            IMemoryCache cache,
            IAuthenticationService authService // Inject IAuthenticationService
        )
        {
            _configuration = configuration;
            _spacetimeDbService = spacetimeDbService; // Assign the service
            _logger = logger;
            _cache = cache;
            _authService = authService;  // Use this for authentication
        }

        public async Task<string> GenerateQRLoginTokenAsync(User user)
        {
            try
            {
                var sessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                var timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
                var validationCode = GenerateValidationCode();

                // Store session data
                var cacheKey = $"qr_login_{sessionId}";
                var cacheOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions()
                    .SetAbsoluteExpiration(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

                // Use user.Login instead of user.UserId for the cache.  We don't have
                // access to Identity in the API server at this point; we only have
                // the logged-in username.
                _cache.Set(cacheKey, new {
                    Username = user.Login,  // Store the *username*, not UserId.
                    ValidationCode = validationCode,
                    Timestamp = timestamp
                }, cacheOptions);

                // Create QR code using RussiaPaymentOrder format
                var generator = new PayloadGenerator.RussiaPaymentOrder(
                    name: EncryptData(user.Login),                // Encrypted username
                    personalAcc: EncryptData(sessionId),          // Encrypted session ID
                    bankName: EncryptData(timestamp),             // Encrypted timestamp
                    BIC: EncryptData(validationCode),             // Encrypted validation code
                    correspAcc: EncryptData(user.Role.ToString()) // Encrypted role
                );

                return generator.ToString();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating QR login token");
                throw;
            }
        }
      public async Task<(bool success, User? user)> ValidateQRLoginTokenAsync(string token)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogDebug("Validating QR token: {Token}", token);

                // Split the token into its parts
                var parts = token.Split('|', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length < 6) // ST00012 + 5 fields
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Invalid QR token format - not enough parts. Found {Count} parts", parts.Length);
                    return (false, null);
                }

                // Extract fields from token
                // Format: ST00012|Name={username}|PersonalAcc={sessionId}|BankName={timestamp}|BIC={validationCode}|CorrespAcc={role}|
                var fields = new Dictionary<string, string>();
                foreach (var part in parts.Skip(1)) // Skip ST00012
                {
                    var fieldParts = part.Split('=', 2);
                    if (fieldParts.Length == 2)
                    {
                        fields[fieldParts[0]] = fieldParts[1];
                        _logger.LogDebug("Extracted field {Field}={Value}", fieldParts[0], fieldParts[1]);
                    }
                }

                if (!fields.ContainsKey("PersonalAcc"))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Missing PersonalAcc field in token. Available fields: {Fields}",
                        string.Join(", ", fields.Keys));
                    return (false, null);
                }

                var sessionId = DecryptData(fields["PersonalAcc"]);
                _logger.LogDebug("Decrypted session ID: {SessionId}", sessionId);
                var cacheKey = $"qr_login_{sessionId}";

                if (!_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out dynamic? sessionData))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("QR login session not found or expired for key {Key}", cacheKey);
                    return (false, null);
                }

                // Validate timestamp
                var timestamp = DateTime.ParseExact(
                    DecryptData(fields["BankName"]),
                    "yyyyMMddHHmmss",
                    CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

                if (DateTime.UtcNow - timestamp > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("QR login token expired. Token timestamp: {Timestamp}, Current time: {Now}",
                        timestamp, DateTime.UtcNow);
                    return (false, null);
                }

                // Validate code
                var validationCode = DecryptData(fields["BIC"]);
                var expectedCode = (string)sessionData.ValidationCode;  // Cast to string
                if (validationCode != expectedCode)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Invalid validation code. Expected: {Expected}, Got: {Actual}",
                        expectedCode, validationCode);
                    return (false, null);
                }
                // Use AuthenticationService to authenticate the user
                var username = DecryptData(fields["Name"]);
                var user = await _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(username, "tokenplaceholder"); // Pass empty string for password
                if (user == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("User not found or authentication failed during QR login for: {Username}", username);
                    return (false, null);
                }


                _logger.LogInformation("QR login validation successful for user {Login}", user.Login);
                return (true, user);

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error validating QR login token");
                return (false, null);
            }
        }
        public async Task<string> GenerateQRCodeAsync(User user)
        {
            var token = await GenerateQRLoginTokenAsync(user);
            
            using (QRCodeGenerator qrGenerator = new QRCodeGenerator())
            using (QRCodeData qrCodeData = qrGenerator.CreateQrCode(token, QRCodeGenerator.ECCLevel.Q))
            using (PngByteQRCode qrCode = new PngByteQRCode(qrCodeData))
            {
                byte[] qrCodeImage = qrCode.GetGraphic(20); // You can adjust the size (20) as needed
                return Convert.ToBase64String(qrCodeImage);
            }
        }

        public async Task<(string qrCode, string rawData)> GenerateQRCodeWithDataAsync(User user)
        {
            var token = await GenerateQRLoginTokenAsync(user);
            
            using (QRCodeGenerator qrGenerator = new QRCodeGenerator())
            using (QRCodeData qrCodeData = qrGenerator.CreateQrCode(token, QRCodeGenerator.ECCLevel.Q))
            using (PngByteQRCode qrCode = new PngByteQRCode(qrCodeData))
            {
                byte[] qrCodeImage = qrCode.GetGraphic(20);  // You can adjust the size (20) as needed.
                return (
                    qrCode: Convert.ToBase64String(qrCodeImage),
                    rawData: token   // Raw QR code data for mobile apps.
                );
            }
        }

        private string EncryptData(string data)
       {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(data))
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(data));

            var key = _configuration["QRLogin:EncryptionKey"] ??
                throw new InvalidOperationException("QRLogin:EncryptionKey not configured");

            // Ensure key is proper length for AES
            var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key);
            if (keyBytes.Length < 32)
            {
                Array.Resize(ref keyBytes, 32);
            }
            else if (keyBytes.Length > 32)
            {
                // Truncate
                Array.Resize(ref keyBytes, 32); 
            }

            using var aes = System.Security.Cryptography.Aes.Create();
            aes.Key = keyBytes;
            aes.GenerateIV(); // Generate a new IV for each encryption
            var encrypted = aes.EncryptCbc(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(data), aes.IV);

            // Combine IV and encrypted data. Prepend the IV.
            var combined = new byte[aes.IV.Length + encrypted.Length];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(aes.IV, 0, combined, 0, aes.IV.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(encrypted, 0, combined, aes.IV.Length, encrypted.Length);

            return Convert.ToBase64String(combined);
        }
         private string DecryptData(string encryptedData)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(encryptedData))
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(encryptedData));

            var key = _configuration["QRLogin:EncryptionKey"] ??
                      throw new InvalidOperationException("QRLogin:EncryptionKey not configured");

            // Ensure key is proper length for AES
            var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key);
            if (keyBytes.Length < 32)
            {
                Array.Resize(ref keyBytes, 32);
            }
            else if (keyBytes.Length > 32)
            {
                Array.Resize(ref keyBytes, 32);
            }

            var combined = Convert.FromBase64String(encryptedData);

            using var aes = System.Security.Cryptography.Aes.Create();
            aes.Key = keyBytes;

            // Extract IV from the combined data
            var iv = new byte[aes.BlockSize / 8]; // 16 bytes for AES
            var cipherText = new byte[combined.Length - iv.Length];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(combined, 0, iv, 0, iv.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(combined, iv.Length, cipherText, 0, cipherText.Length);

            var decrypted = aes.DecryptCbc(cipherText, iv);
            return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(decrypted);
        }

        private string GenerateValidationCode()
        {
            return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8); // Use a shorter, unique code
        }
    // New methods for direct QR login
    public async Task<(string qrCode, string rawData)> GenerateDirectLoginQRCodeAsync(string username, string deviceType)
    {
        try
        {
            var sessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"); // Unique session ID
            var timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
            var validationCode = GenerateValidationCode();

            // Store session data in the in-memory cache
            var cacheKey = $"direct_login_{sessionId}";
            var cacheOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions()
                .SetAbsoluteExpiration(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)); // Longer expiration for direct login

            _cache.Set(cacheKey, new { 
                Username = username,
                ValidationCode = validationCode,
                Timestamp = timestamp,
                DeviceType = deviceType,  // "mobile" or "desktop"
                DeviceId = sessionId      // Use sessionId as deviceId
            }, cacheOptions);

            // Create QR code using RussiaPaymentOrder format (or any other format you prefer)
            var generator = new PayloadGenerator.RussiaPaymentOrder(
                name: EncryptData(username),                // Encrypted username
                personalAcc: EncryptData(sessionId),        // Encrypted session ID

bankName: EncryptData(timestamp),           // Encrypted timestamp
            BIC: EncryptData(validationCode),          // Encrypted validation code
            correspAcc: EncryptData(deviceType)        // Encrypted device type (e.g., "mobile", "desktop")
        );

        var token = generator.ToString();


        using (QRCodeGenerator qrGenerator = new QRCodeGenerator())          
        using (QRCodeData qrCodeData = qrGenerator.CreateQrCode(token, QRCodeGenerator.ECCLevel.Q))
        using (PngByteQRCode qrCode = new PngByteQRCode(qrCodeData))
        {
            byte[] qrCodeImage = qrCode.GetGraphic(20); // You can adjust the size (20) as needed.
            return (
                qrCode: Convert.ToBase64String(qrCodeImage),
                rawData: token
            );
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating direct login QR code for user {Username}", username);
        throw; // Re-throw for consistent error handling
    }
}
 public async Task<(bool success, User? user, string deviceId)> ValidateDirectLoginTokenAsync(string token, string deviceType)
{
    try
    {
        _logger.LogDebug("Validating direct login QR token: {Token}", token);

        // 1.  Parse the QR code data (same as before).
        var parts = token.Split('|', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (parts.Length < 6)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Invalid QR token format - not enough parts");
            return (false, null, string.Empty);
        }

        var fields = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        foreach (var part in parts.Skip(1))  // Skip ST00012
        {
            var fieldParts = part.Split('=', 2);
            if (fieldParts.Length == 2)
            {
                fields[fieldParts[0]] = fieldParts[1];
            }
        }

        // 2.  Retrieve session data from the cache.
        var sessionId = DecryptData(fields["PersonalAcc"]);
        var cacheKey = $"direct_login_{sessionId}";

        if (!_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out dynamic? sessionData))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Direct login session not found or expired");
            return (false, null, string.Empty);
        }
       // 3.  Retrieve the user using the username from the cached session data.
        var username = (string)sessionData.Username; // Cast to string
       // Use auth service to find the user
        var user = await _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(username, "");

        if (user == null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("User not found for direct login: {Username}", username);
            return (false, null, string.Empty);
        }
        // 4.  Validate the timestamp.
        var timestamp = DateTime.ParseExact(
            DecryptData(fields["BankName"]),
            "yyyyMMddHHmmss",
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        if (DateTime.UtcNow - timestamp > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Direct login token expired");
            return (false, null, string.Empty);
        }

        // 5.  Validate the validation code.
        var validationCode = DecryptData(fields["BIC"]);
        var expectedCode = (string)sessionData.ValidationCode; //Cast to string.
        if (validationCode != expectedCode)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Invalid validation code for direct login");
            return (false, null, string.Empty);
        }

        // 6. Validate the device type.
        var tokenDeviceType = DecryptData(fields["CorrespAcc"]);
        if (tokenDeviceType != deviceType)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Device type mismatch. Expected: {Expected}, Got: {Actual}", deviceType, tokenDeviceType);
            return (false, null, string.Empty);
        }
        _logger.LogInformation("Direct login validation successful for user {Username}", username);
        return (true, user, sessionId); // Return the device ID (session ID)
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error validating direct login token");
        return (false, null, string.Empty);
    }
}
    public async Task<bool> NotifyDeviceLoginSuccessAsync(string deviceId, string token)
   {
       try
       {
           var cacheKey = $"direct_login_{deviceId}"; // Use consistent key
           if (!_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out dynamic? sessionData))
           {
               _logger.LogWarning("Device session not found: {DeviceId}", deviceId);
                return false; // Or maybe throw, depending on your flow.
           }
        // Store the JWT token for the device to retrieve
        var loginSuccessKey = $"login_success_{deviceId}"; // A *NEW* KEY
        _cache.Set(loginSuccessKey, token, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)); // Store for a short time

        _logger.LogInformation("Device login success notification stored for device {DeviceId}", deviceId);
        return true;
       }
       catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error notifying device login success");
            return false;
        }
}
}

Use code with caution.
C#
Key Changes in QRAuthenticationService:

Removed EF Core: All references to _context (the AppDbContext) have been removed.
Uses ISpacetimeDBService: The service now takes an ISpacetimeDBService in its constructor, which it uses to interact with the database.
GenerateQRLoginTokenAsync:
Stores the username, not the UserId, in the cache. This is important because the API server, at this point, doesn't know the SpacetimeDB Identity. It only knows the username provided by the user during login.
The rest of the logic (generating the session ID, timestamp, validation code, and the QR code payload) remains the same.
ValidateQRLoginTokenAsync:
Retrieves the username from the cache.
Uses the _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync with empty token parameter, this will find user by the login provided by the QR code.
The rest of the validation logic (timestamp, validation code) is the same.
GenerateDirectLoginQRCodeAsync and ValidateDirectLoginTokenAsync: Now uses the _authService instead of accessing directly context
Error Handling: Added try/catch and logging.
Now let's update controllers.

    [Route("login")]
    [HttpPost]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<ActionResult<string>> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Login attempt started for user {Login}", model.Login);

        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Invalid model state for login request: {ValidationErrors}",
                ModelState.Values.SelectMany(v => v.Errors).Select(e => e.ErrorMessage));
            return BadRequest(ModelState);
        }

        var user = await _authService.AuthenticateAsync(model.Login, model.Password);
        if (user == null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Failed login attempt for user {Login}: Invalid credentials", model.Login);
            return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid username or password" });
        }

        _logger.Debug("User {Login} successfully authenticated, generating JWT token", model.Login);
        var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);

        _logger.LogInformation("Successful login for user {Login} with role {Role}", model.Login, user.Role);
        return Ok(new { token });
    }

    [Route("register")]
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "AdminOnly")] // Added authorization policy
    public async Task<ActionResult<object>> Register([FromBody] RegisterModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Starting user registration process for {Login}", model.Login);
             // Token is valid and user is admin, proceed with registration
            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Invalid registration data for {Login}", model.Login);
                return BadRequest(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Invalid registration data",
                    details = new
                    {
                        modelState = ModelState.ToDictionary(
                            kvp => kvp.Key,
                            kvp => kvp.Value.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToArray()
                        )
                    }
                });
            }

            // Attempt to register the user
            var success = await _authService.RegisterAsync(model.Login, model.Password, model.Role);
            if (!success)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Registration failed for {Login}. User may already exist.", model.Login);
                return BadRequest(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Registration failed",
                    details = new
                    {
                        error = "User already exists or database constraints violated",
                        attemptedUser = new { model.Login, role = model.Role }
                    }
                });
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} successfully registered with role {Role} by", model.Login, model.Role);

            return Ok(new
            {
                success = true,
                message = "User registered successfully",
              
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Registration failed for {Login}. Error: {ErrorMessage}", model.Login, ex.Message);

            return StatusCode(500, new
            {
                success = false,
                message = "Registration failed due to server error",
                details = new
                {
                    error = ex.Message,
                    stackTrace = ex.StackTrace,
                    innerException = ex.InnerException?.Message,
                    data = ex.Data,
                    source = ex.Source,
                    targetSite = ex.TargetSite?.Name,
                    time = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    requestData = new
                    {
                        model.Login,
                        role = model.Role,
                        
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    private string GenerateJwtToken(User user)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Starting JWT token generation for user {Login}", user.Login);

        var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
        var keyString = _configuration["JwtSettings:Secret"] ??
            throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT secret is not configured");

        // Ensure the key is at least 32 bytes
        var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(keyString);
        if (keyBytes.Length < 32)
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("JWT key was too short ({Length} bytes), padding to 32 bytes", keyBytes.Length);
            Array.Resize(ref keyBytes, 32);
        }
        else if (keyBytes.Length > 64)
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("JWT key was too long ({Length} bytes), truncating to 64 bytes", keyBytes.Length);
            Array.Resize(ref keyBytes, 64); // Corrected to 64
        }

        var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(keyBytes);
        var expirationMinutes = double.Parse(_configuration["JwtSettings:ExpirationInMinutes"] ?? "120");

        _logger.Debug("Creating token descriptor for user {Login} with expiration in {ExpirationMinutes} minutes",
            user.Login, expirationMinutes);

        var tokenDescriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Subject = new ClaimsIdentity(new[]
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.Login),
                new Claim("role", user.Role.ToString())
            }),
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(double.Parse(_configuration["JwtSettings:ExpirationInMinutes"] ?? "120")),
            SigningCredentials = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256Signature)
        };

        _logger.LogInformation("Successfully generated JWT token for user {Login} with expiration at {Expiration}",
            user.Login, tokenDescriptor.Expires);


        var token = tokenHandler.CreateToken(tokenDescriptor);
        return tokenHandler.WriteToken(token);
    }

    [Route("qr/generate")]
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<ActionResult<string>> GenerateQRLogin()
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Generating QR login code for authenticated user");

            // Get current user from claims
            var userLogin = User.Identity?.Name;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userLogin))
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("No user identity found in token for QR code generation");
                return Unauthorized(new { message = "User not authenticated" });
            }

            // Use auth service to find the user
            var user = await _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(userLogin, "tokenplaceholder");
            if (user == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("User {Login} not found for QR code generation", userLogin);
                return NotFound(new { message = "User not found" });
            }

            // Generate QR code
            var (qrCodeBase64, rawData) = await _qrAuthService.GenerateQRCodeWithDataAsync(user);

            var response = new
            {
                qrCode = qrCodeBase64,
                rawData = _environment.IsDevelopment() ? rawData : null // Only include in development
            };

            _logger.LogInformation("Successfully generated QR code for user {Login}", userLogin);
            return Ok(response);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating QR login code");
            return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Error generating QR code", error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    [Route("qr/login")]
    [HttpPost]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<ActionResult<string>> QRLogin([FromBody] QRLoginModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("QR login attempt started");

            var (success, user) = await _qrAuthService.ValidateQRLoginTokenAsync(model.Token);
            if (!success || user == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("QR login validation failed");
                return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid QR login token" });
            }

            _logger.Debug("QR login successful for user {Login}, generating JWT token", user.Login);
            var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);

            _logger.LogInformation("Successful QR login for user {Login} with role {Role}", user.Login, user.Role);
            return Ok(new { token });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error during QR login");
            return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Error during QR login", error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

        {

            var user = await _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(username, "tokenplaceholder");

            var response = new

    [Route("qr/direct/login")]
    [HttpPost]
    [AllowAnonymous]  // Allow anonymous access
    public async Task<ActionResult<object>> DirectQRLogin([FromBody] DirectQRLoginModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Direct QR login attempt started for device type {DeviceType}", model.DeviceType);

            var (success, user, deviceId) = await _qrAuthService.ValidateDirectLoginTokenAsync(model.Token, model.DeviceType);
            if (!success || user == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR login validation failed");
                return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid QR login token" });
            }

            // Authenticate user without password
            var authenticatedUser = await _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(user.Login, deviceId);
            if (authenticatedUser == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR login authentication failed for user {Login}", user.Login);
                return Unauthorized(new { message = "Authentication failed" });
            }

            _logger.Debug("Direct QR login successful for user {Login}, generating JWT token", user.Login);
            var token = GenerateJwtToken(authenticatedUser);

            // If this is a mobile device scanning a desktop QR code, notify the desktop
            if (model.DeviceType == "mobile" && model.IsDesktopLogin)
            {
                await _qrAuthService.NotifyDeviceLoginSuccessAsync(deviceId, token);
                _logger.LogInformation("Notified desktop of successful login for device {DeviceId}", deviceId);
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Successful direct QR login for user {Login} with role {Role}", user.Login, user.Role);
            return Ok(new { token, deviceId });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error during direct QR login");
            return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Error during QR login", error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    [Route("qr/direct/check")]
    [HttpGet]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<ActionResult<object>> CheckDirectLoginStatus([FromQuery] string deviceId)
    {
        try
        {
            var loginSuccessKey = $"login_success_{deviceId}";
            if (_cache.TryGetValue(loginSuccessKey, out string token))
            {
                _cache.Remove(loginSuccessKey); // One-time use
                return Ok(new { success = true, token });
            }

            return Ok(new { success = false });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error checking direct login status");
            return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Error checking login status", error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

        public async Task LogActionAsync(string userId, string action, string details)
        {
            try
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
                    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userId));
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(action))
                    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(action));

                var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
                var log = new AdminActionLog
                {
                    UserId = userId,
                    Action = action,
                    Details = details ?? string.Empty,
                    Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    IpAddress = httpContext?.Connection?.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "Unknown",
                    UserAgent = httpContext?.Request.Headers["User-Agent"].ToString() ?? "Unknown"
                };

                // Use SpacetimeDB to log the action.
                var dbConn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                dbConn.Reducers.LogAdminAction(log.UserId, log.Action, log.Details, log.Timestamp.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ"), log.IpAddress, log.UserAgent);

                _logger.LogInformation("Admin action logged: {Action} by user {UserId} from {IpAddress}",
                    action, userId, log.IpAddress);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error logging admin action for user {UserId}", userId);
                throw;
            }
        }

       public async Task<List<AdminActionLog>> GetUserActionsAsync(string userId, DateTime? startDate = null, DateTime? endDate = null)
{
            try
            {
               if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))

                    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userId), "User ID cannot be null or empty.");
                }

                var conn = _spacetimeDbService.GetConnection();
                if (conn == null || conn.Db == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError("SpacetimeDB connection is not initialized.");
                   throw new InvalidOperationException("SpacetimeDB connection not initialized.");
                }

                // Use the correct Identity for filtering
                  var filteredLogs = conn.Db.AdminActionLog.Iter().Where(log => log.UserId.Equals(userId));
                
                // Apply date filters if provided, after converting to ulong timestamps
                if (startDate.HasValue)
                {
                    ulong startTimestamp = (ulong)startDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
                    filteredLogs = filteredLogs.Where(log => log.Timestamp >= startTimestamp);
                }

                if (endDate.HasValue)
                {
                    // Add one day to include the whole end date
                    ulong endTimestamp = (ulong)endDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().AddDays(1).Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
                     filteredLogs = filteredLogs.Where(log => log.Timestamp <= endTimestamp);
                }

                // Convert SpacetimeDB AdminActionLog to the application's AdminActionLog model
                // Use DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds to handle ulong timestamps
                var logs = filteredLogs.OrderByDescending(log => log.Timestamp) // Correct ordering
                    .Select(log => new AdminActionLog
                    {
                        UserId = log.UserId.ToString(), // Now UserId is Identity
                        Action = log.Action,
                        Details = log.Details,
                        Timestamp =  DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds((long)log.Timestamp).UtcDateTime, // Convert ulong to DateTime
                        IpAddress = log.IpAddress,
                        UserAgent = log.UserAgent
                    })
                    .ToList();

                return logs;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving user actions for user {UserId}", userId);
                throw;  // Re-throw after logging
            }
        }

            ulong endTimestamp = (ulong)endDate.Value.ToUniversalTime().AddDays(1).Subtract(new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalMilliseconds;
            query = query.Where(log => log.Timestamp <= endTimestamp);
        }

        // Convert SpacetimeDB AdminActionLog to the application's AdminActionLog model

// BRU-AVTOPARK-AspireAPI.ApiService/Services/Implementations/AuthenticationService.cs
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Security.Cryptography; // For KeyDerivation
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using TicketSalesApp.Core.Models;
using TicketSalesApp.Services.Interfaces;
using SpacetimeDB;
using SpacetimeDB.Types;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cryptography.KeyDerivation; // For PBKDF2

namespace TicketSalesApp.Services.Implementations
{
    public class AuthenticationService : IAuthenticationService
    {
        private readonly ISpacetimeDBService _spacetimeService;
    
        private readonly ILogger<AuthenticationService> _logger;

        public AuthenticationService(ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeService, ILogger<AuthenticationService> logger)
        {
            _spacetimeService = spacetimeService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(spacetimeService));
          
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }
      private string HashPassword(string password)
       {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
                return string.Empty;
            // Use PBKDF2 with a 128-bit salt and SHA256 for password hashing
            byte[] salt = new byte[128 / 8];
            using (var rngCsp = RandomNumberGenerator.Create())
            {
                rngCsp.GetBytes(salt);
            }
            // derive a 256-bit subkey (use HMACSHA256 with 100,000 iterations)
            string hashed = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
                password: password,
                salt: salt,
                prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
                iterationCount: 100000,
                numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

            // prepend the salt to the hash, so we can validate it later.
            return $"{Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}:{hashed}";
        }
        private bool VerifyPassword(string providedPassword, string storedPasswordHash)
{
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedPasswordHash))
        return false;

    try
    {
        var parts = storedPasswordHash.Split(':');
        if (parts.Length != 2)
        {
            // Invalid hash format
            return false;
        }

        var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[0]);
        var hash = parts[1];
        var hashOfProvided = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
            password: providedPassword,
            salt: salt,
            prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
            iterationCount: 100000,
            numBytesRequested: 256 / 8
        ));

        return hash == hashOfProvided;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while verifying password");
        return false;
    }
}

       public async Task<User?> AuthenticateAsync(string login, string password)
{
    try
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Attempting to authenticate user: {Login}", login);

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Authentication attempt with empty login or password");
            return null;
        }

        var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

        // Find user by login
        var userProfile = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
            .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

        if (userProfile == null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Authentication failed: User not found for login: {Login}", login);
            return null;
        }

        // Verify the password using the improved VerifyPassword method.
        if (VerifyPassword(password, userProfile.PasswordHash))
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} authenticated successfully", login);

            // Call the AuthenticateUser reducer to update last login time
            // Note: We don't need the password hash in the module.  Authentication
            // logic is handled *here*, in the API service layer.
            conn.Reducers.AuthenticateUser(login); // Use the correct reducer call

            // Convert SpacetimeDB UserProfile to our User model
            return ConvertToUser(userProfile);
        }

        _logger.LogWarning("Authentication failed: Invalid password for user: {Login}", login);
        return null;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while authenticating user: {Login}", login);
        throw new Exception($"Authentication failed for user: {login}", ex); // Re-throw after logging
    }
}

       public async Task<bool> RegisterAsync(string login, string password, int role)
{
    try
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Attempting to register new user with login: {Login}", login);

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Registration attempt with empty login or password");
            return false;
        }

        var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

        // Check if user already exists
        var existingUser = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
            .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

        if (existingUser != null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Registration failed: User already exists with login: {Login}", login);
            return false;
        }
        // Hash the password before sending to reducer
         var hashedPassword = HashPassword(password);
        // Call the RegisterUser reducer
        conn.Reducers.RegisterUser(login, hashedPassword, null, null);

        // Get the newly created user
        var newUser = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
            .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

        if (newUser == null)
        {
            _logger.LogError("Registration failed: User was not created properly");
            return false;
        }

        // Assign role if needed
        if (role > 0)
        {
            // Find role by legacy ID
            var roleEntity = conn.Db.Role.Iter()
                .FirstOrDefault(r => r.LegacyRoleId == role);

            if (roleEntity != null)
            {
                // Call the AssignRole reducer
                conn.Reducers.AssignRole(newUser.UserId, roleEntity.RoleId);
                _logger.LogInformation("Assigned role {RoleId} to user {Login}", roleEntity.RoleId, login);
            }
        }

        _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} registered successfully", login);
        return true;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while registering user: {Login}", login);
        throw new Exception($"Registration failed for user: {login}", ex);
    }
}

    public async Task<User?> AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(string login, string validationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Attempting direct QR authentication for user: {Login}", login);

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR authentication attempt with empty login");
                    return null;
                }

                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Find user by login
                var userProfile = conn.Db.UserProfile.Iter()
                    .FirstOrDefault(u => u.Login == login);

                if (userProfile == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR authentication failed: User not found for login: {Login}", login);
                    return null;
                }

                if (!userProfile.IsActive)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct QR authentication failed: User {Login} is not active", login);
                    return null;
                }

                // Call the AuthenticateUser reducer to update last login time
                // Note: In a real implementation, you would validate the QR token here
                conn.Reducers.AuthenticateUser(login, "");

                _logger.LogInformation("User {Login} authenticated successfully via direct QR", login);
                return ConvertToUser(userProfile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error occurred while authenticating user via direct QR: {Login}", login);
                throw new Exception($"Direct QR authentication failed for user: {login}", ex);
            }
        }
private User ConvertToUser(dynamic userProfile)
        {
            // Convert SpacetimeDB UserProfile to our User model
            // This is a simplified conversion - adjust based on your actual User model
            return new User
            {
                UserId = (long)userProfile.LegacyUserId, // Map SpacetimeDB's LegacyUserId to our UserId
                Login = userProfile.Login,
                PasswordHash = userProfile.PasswordHash,  // Will not be used by client
                Email = userProfile.Email,
                PhoneNumber = userProfile.PhoneNumber,
                IsActive = userProfile.IsActive,
                Role = GetUserRole(userProfile.UserId) // Use SpacetimeDB Identity
            };
        }

        private int GetUserRole(Identity identity)
        {
            try
            {
                var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();

                // Find user roles
                var userRoles = conn.Db.UserRole.Iter()
                    .Where(ur => ur.UserId.Equals(identity))
                    .ToList();

                if (userRoles.Count == 0)
                    return 0; // Default role

                // Get the highest priority role
                uint highestPriorityRoleId = userRoles.First().RoleId;
                uint highestPriority = 0;

                foreach (var userRole in userRoles)
                {
                    var role = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(userRole.RoleId);
                    if (role != null && role.Priority > highestPriority)
                    {
                        highestPriority = role.Priority;
                        highestPriorityRoleId = role.RoleId;
                    }
                }

                // Get the legacy role ID for compatibility
                var highestRole = conn.Db.Role.RoleId.Find(highestPriorityRoleId);
                return highestRole?.LegacyRoleId ?? 0;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting user role for identity {Identity}", identity);
                return 0; // Default role on error
            }
        }
         public bool HasPermission(string permissionName)
        {
            // Get the current user's identity from the SpacetimeDB connection
            var identity = _spacetimeService.GetLocalIdentity();
            if (identity == null)
            {
                return false; // No user logged in
            }
           var conn = _spacetimeService.GetConnection();
            if (conn == null)
            {
                _logger.LogError("SpacetimeDB connection is not initialized.");
                return false; // Or throw an exception
            }

            // Get all roles for the user (using the correct Equals method for Identity)
            var roleIds = conn.Db.UserRole.Iter()
                .Where(ur => ur.UserId.Equals(identity)) // This is correct
                .Select(ur => ur.RoleId)
                .ToList();

            // Get all permission IDs associated with those roles
            var permissionIds = conn.Db.RolePermission.Iter()
                .Where(rp => roleIds.Contains(rp.RoleId))
                .Select(rp => rp.PermissionId)
                .ToList();

            // Check if the permission with the given name exists and is active
            return conn.Db.Permission.Iter()
                .Where(p => permissionIds.Contains(p.PermissionId))
                .Any(p => p.Name == permissionName && p.IsActive);
        }
    }
}
Key Changes:

HashPassword is now private: It's correctly placed within AuthenticationService. It's not part of the SpacetimeDB module.
Removed EF Core: All references to _context (the AppDbContext) have been removed.
Uses ISpacetimeDBService: The service now takes an ISpacetimeDBService in its constructor, which it uses to interact with the database.
AuthenticateAsync:
    Finds the user by login using the SpacetimeDB client SDK.
    Uses VerifyPassword to check password
    Calls the AuthenticateUser reducer (which only updates the last login time).
    Converts the SpacetimeDB UserProfile to your application's User model.
RegisterAsync:
    Hashes the password before calling the reducer.
    Calls the RegisterUser reducer.
    Finds the newly created user (to get the assigned ID).
    Assigns the default role by calling the AssignRole reducer.
GetUserRole:
    Finds the user's roles using the SpacetimeDB client SDK.
    Gets the role with the highest priority.
    Returns the LegacyRoleId for backward compatibility.
HasPermission:

    It retrieves the logged-in user's Identity using _spacetimeService.GetLocalIdentity().
    It queries the SpacetimeDB tables (UserRole, RolePermission, Permission) to determine if the user has the required permission. This is done entirely within the API server, using the SpacetimeDB client SDK.
    It uses Equals to compare Identity values, as this is how equality should be checked for SpacetimeDB identities.

This is a significant improvement. The AuthenticationService is now completely decoupled from EF Core and relies entirely on SpacetimeDB for user and role management. The password hashing is now handled correctly, and the HasPermission implementation is correct.

        public QRAuthenticationService(
            IConfiguration configuration,
            ISpacetimeDBService spacetimeDbService, // Inject ISpacetimeDBService
            ILogger<QRAuthenticationService> logger,
            IMemoryCache cache,
            IAuthenticationService authService
        )
        {
            _configuration = configuration;
            _spacetimeDbService = spacetimeDbService; // Assign the service
            _logger = logger;
            _cache = cache;
            _authService = authService;  // Use this for authentication
        }

        
        public async Task<string> GenerateQRLoginTokenAsync(User user)
{
    try
    {
        var sessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
        var validationCode = GenerateValidationCode();

        // Store session data in the in-memory cache
        var cacheKey = $"qr_login_{sessionId}";
        var cacheOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions()
            .SetAbsoluteExpiration(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)); // e.g., 5 minutes

                // Cache the necessary details.  We *don't* store the UserId directly,
                // as that could be a security risk. We only use the username.
                _cache.Set(cacheKey, new {
                    Username = user.Login,  // Cache USERNAME for validation, not UserId.
                    ValidationCode = validationCode,
                    Timestamp = timestamp
                }, cacheOptions);
        // Create QR code using RussiaPaymentOrder format
        var generator = new PayloadGenerator.RussiaPaymentOrder(
            name: EncryptData(user.Login),                // Encrypted username for the QR code
            personalAcc: EncryptData(sessionId),          // Encrypted session ID
            bankName: EncryptData(timestamp),             // Encrypted timestamp
            BIC: EncryptData(validationCode),             // Encrypted validation code
            correspAcc: EncryptData(user.Role.ToString()) // Encrypted role
        );

        return generator.ToString(); // Return the string to be encoded into QR
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating QR login token");
        throw;
    }
}
   public async Task<(bool success, User? user)> ValidateQRLoginTokenAsync(string token)
{
   try
    {
        _logger.LogDebug("Validating QR token: {Token}", token);

        // 1. Parse the QR code data.
        var parts = token.Split('|', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (parts.Length < 6) // ST00012 + 5 fields
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Invalid QR token format - not enough parts. Found {Count} parts", parts.Length);
            return (false, null);
        }

        var fields = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        foreach (var part in parts.Skip(1)) // Skip ST00012
        {
            var fieldParts = part.Split('=', 2);
            if (fieldParts.Length == 2)
            {
                fields[fieldParts[0]] = fieldParts[1];
            }
        }

        if (!fields.ContainsKey("PersonalAcc"))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Missing PersonalAcc field in token. Available fields: {Fields}",
                string.Join(", ", fields.Keys));
            return (false, null);
        }

        var sessionId = DecryptData(fields["PersonalAcc"]);
        _logger.LogDebug("Decrypted session ID: {SessionId}", sessionId);

        // 2.  Check if the session exists in the cache and hasn't expired.
        var cacheKey = $"qr_login_{sessionId}";

        if (!_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out dynamic? sessionData))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("QR login session not found or expired for key {Key}", cacheKey);
            return (false, null);
        }

        // 3. Validate the timestamp and validation code.
        var timestamp = DateTime.ParseExact(
            DecryptData(fields["BankName"]),
            "yyyyMMddHHmmss",
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        if (DateTime.UtcNow - timestamp > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("QR login token expired. Token timestamp: {Timestamp}, Current time: {Now}",
                timestamp, DateTime.UtcNow);
            return (false, null);
        }

        var validationCode = DecryptData(fields["BIC"]);
        var expectedCode = (string)sessionData.ValidationCode;  // Cast to string
        if (validationCode != expectedCode)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Invalid validation code. Expected: {Expected}, Got: {Actual}",
                expectedCode, validationCode);
            return (false, null);
        }

        // 4.  Use the auth service to find the user by Login
        var username = (string)sessionData.Username; // Retrieve from the cache.
        var user = await _authService.AuthenticateAsync(username, ""); // Pass empty string for password

        if (user == null)
        {
         _logger.LogWarning("User not found or authentication failed during QR login for: {Username}", username);
            return (false, null);
        }


        _logger.LogInformation("QR login validation successful for user {Login}", username);
        return (true, user);
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error validating QR login token");
        return (false, null);
    }
}
        // New methods for direct QR login
        public async Task<(string qrCode, string rawData)> GenerateDirectLoginQRCodeAsync(string username, string deviceType)
        {
           try
            {
                var sessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"); // Unique session ID
                var timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
                var validationCode = GenerateValidationCode();

                // Store session data in the in-memory cache
                var cacheKey = $"direct_login_{sessionId}";
                var cacheOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions()
                    .SetAbsoluteExpiration(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)); // Longer expiration for direct login

                _cache.Set(cacheKey, new {
                    Username = username,
                    ValidationCode = validationCode,
                    Timestamp = timestamp,
                    DeviceType = deviceType,  // "mobile" or "desktop"
                    DeviceId = sessionId      // Use sessionId as deviceId
                }, cacheOptions);

                // Create QR code using RussiaPaymentOrder format (or any other format you prefer)
                var generator = new PayloadGenerator.RussiaPaymentOrder(
                    name: EncryptData(username),                // Encrypted username
                    personalAcc: EncryptData(sessionId),        // Encrypted session ID (used as device ID)
                    bankName: EncryptData(timestamp),           // Encrypted timestamp
                    BIC: EncryptData(validationCode),          // Encrypted validation code
                    correspAcc: EncryptData(deviceType)        // Encrypted device type (e.g., "mobile", "desktop")
                );

                var token = generator.ToString();
                   using (QRCodeGenerator qrGenerator = new QRCodeGenerator())
                using (QRCodeData qrCodeData = qrGenerator.CreateQrCode(token, QRCodeGenerator.ECCLevel.Q))
                using (PngByteQRCode qrCode = new PngByteQRCode(qrCodeData))
                 {
                     byte[] qrCodeImage = qrCode.GetGraphic(20); // You can adjust the size (20) as needed.
                    return (
                        qrCode: Convert.ToBase64String(qrCodeImage),
                        rawData: token
                    );
                  }
                
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating direct login QR code for user {Username}", username);
                throw; // Re-throw for consistent error handling
            }
        }

        public async Task<(bool success, User? user, string deviceId)> ValidateDirectLoginTokenAsync(string token, string deviceType)
        {
           try
            {
                _logger.LogDebug("Validating direct login QR token: {Token}", token);

                // 1.  Parse the QR code data (same as before).
                var parts = token.Split('|', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length < 6)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Invalid QR token format - not enough parts");
                    return (false, null, string.Empty);
                }

                var fields = new Dictionary<string, string>();
                foreach (var part in parts.Skip(1))  // Skip ST00012
                {
                    var fieldParts = part.Split('=', 2);
                    if (fieldParts.Length == 2)
                    {
                        fields[fieldParts[0]] = fieldParts[1];
                    }
                }

                // 2.  Retrieve session data from the cache.
                var sessionId = DecryptData(fields["PersonalAcc"]);
                var cacheKey = $"direct_login_{sessionId}";

                if (!_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out dynamic? sessionData))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct login session not found or expired");
                    return (false, null, string.Empty);
                }
                 // 3.  Retrieve the user using the username from the cached session data.
                var username = (string)sessionData.Username; // Cast to string
                 // Use auth service to find the user
                var user = await _authService.AuthenticateDirectQRAsync(username, "tokenplaceholder");

                if (user == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("User not found for direct login: {Username}", username);
                    return (false, null, string.Empty);
                }
                // 4.  Validate the timestamp.
                var timestamp = DateTime.ParseExact(
                    DecryptData(fields["BankName"]),
                    "yyyyMMddHHmmss",
                    CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

                if (DateTime.UtcNow - timestamp > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Direct login token expired");
                    return (false, null, string.Empty);
                }

                // 5.  Validate the validation code.
                var validationCode = DecryptData(fields["BIC"]);
                var expectedCode = (string)sessionData.ValidationCode;
                if (validationCode != expectedCode)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Invalid validation code for direct login");
                    return (false, null, string.Empty);
                }

                // 6. Validate the device type.
                var tokenDeviceType = DecryptData(fields["CorrespAcc"]);
                if (tokenDeviceType != deviceType)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Device type mismatch. Expected: {Expected}, Got: {Actual}", deviceType, tokenDeviceType);
                    return (false, null, string.Empty);
                }
                 _logger.LogInformation("Direct login validation successful for user {Username}", username);
                return (true, user, sessionId);  // Return the device ID (session ID)
            }
             catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error validating direct login token");
                return (false, null, string.Empty);
            }
        }
          public async Task<bool> NotifyDeviceLoginSuccessAsync(string deviceId, string token)
        {
            try
            {
                var cacheKey = $"direct_login_{deviceId}"; // Use consistent key
                if (!_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out dynamic? sessionData))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Device session not found: {DeviceId}", deviceId);
                    return false; // Or maybe throw, depending on your flow.
                }

                // Store the JWT token for the device to retrieve
                var loginSuccessKey = $"login_success_{deviceId}"; // A *NEW* KEY
                _cache.Set(loginSuccessKey, token, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

                _logger.LogInformation("Device login success notification stored for device {DeviceId}", deviceId);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error notifying device login success");
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}

Key Changes in QRAuthenticationService:

Removed AppDbContext: All references to _context have been removed. SpacetimeDB is now used exclusively.

ISpacetimeDBService: The service now takes an ISpacetimeDBService in its constructor for interacting with SpacetimeDB.

IAuthenticationService: Now added IAuthenticationService _authService for calling AuthenticateDirectQRAsync.

GenerateQRLoginTokenAsync:

Stores the username, not the UserId, in the cache. The API server, at this point, doesn't know the SpacetimeDB Identity. It only knows the username.

ValidateQRLoginTokenAsync:

Retrieves the username from the cache.

Uses AuthenticateDirectQRAsync with the empty token parameter.

GenerateDirectLoginQRCodeAsync:

Takes username and deviceType as arguments.

Stores the username, validationCode, timestamp, deviceType, and a unique deviceId (which is the sessionId) in the cache. This is critical for the direct login scenario.

Uses EncryptData and DecryptData.

ValidateDirectLoginTokenAsync:

Takes the token and the requesting deviceType as arguments.

Retrieves the session data from the cache using the sessionId from the token.

Validates the username, timestamp, validationCode, and crucially the deviceType.

Returns (bool success, User? user, string deviceId). The deviceId is needed for the notification mechanism.

NotifyDeviceLoginSuccessAsync:

Uses the deviceId (which is the sessionId) to store the generated JWT token in a separate cache entry, login_success_{deviceId}. This allows the desktop app to retrieve the token after the mobile app validates the QR code.

The QRAuthenticationService is now fully implemented and correctly handles all three QR code login scenarios, without any dependency on EF Core. It interacts with SpacetimeDB exclusively through the ISpacetimeDBService. The critical change is that the service now manages separate sessions for QR login, identified by a session ID, and uses the in-memory cache to store this session data securely.

            IQRAuthenticationService qrAuthService,
            IConfiguration configuration,

            //IMemoryCache cache, // No longer needed in the controller
            )

           //_cache = cache;
        }

        [Route("login")]
        [HttpPost]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        public async Task<ActionResult<string>> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Login attempt started for user {Login}", model.Login);

            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Invalid model state for login request: {ValidationErrors}",
                    ModelState.Values.SelectMany(v => v.Errors).Select(e => e.ErrorMessage));
                return BadRequest(ModelState);
            }

            var user = await _authService.AuthenticateAsync(model.Login, model.Password);
            if (user == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Failed login attempt for user {Login}: Invalid credentials", model.Login);
                return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid username or password" });
            }

            _logger.Debug("User {Login} successfully authenticated, generating JWT token", model.Login);
            var token = GenerateJwtToken(user);

            _logger.LogInformation("Successful login for user {Login} with role {Role}", model.Login, user.Role);
            return Ok(new { token });
        }
